title: Pendekatan Tafsir Inklusif dalam Menjawab Persoalan Kesetaraan Gender di Madura
journal: REVELATIA Jurnal Ilmu al-Qur`an dan Tafsir
abstract: Traditional gender roles persistently position men as primary breadwinners and decision-makers, while relegating women to domestic and caregiving responsibilities, thereby reinforcing systemic gender inequality and restricting women’s access to equitable education and employment opportunities. This study employs an inclusive hermeneutical approach to Qur’anic exegesis—integrating textual analysis, contextual considerations, and principles of openness—to reconceptualize gender dynamics in Madurese society, where patriarchal interpretations remain entrenched. Through descriptive-analytical methodology, the research demonstrates that an inclusive interpretive framework, responsive to contempora…

title: Perbedaan Qira’āt Menurut Sarjana Orientalis dan Muslim dan Implikasinya terhadap Penafsiran
journal: REVELATIA Jurnal Ilmu al-Qur`an dan Tafsir
abstract: One of problem discussed among scholars including orientalists is the difference in qira'at which has implications for interpretation in various aspects. This study aims to explain some opinions of orientalist scholars and Muslim scholars in response to the difference in qira'at. In addition, the study aims to see and analyze the implications of the difference in qira'at in several interpretations. The research method used is a qualitative method based on library research data with a descriptive-analytical approach. The findings of this study state that according to orientalists, the difference in qira'at will cause contradiction and chaos in determining the law. Meanwhile, according to Musl…

title: Prinsip Etik dalam Al-Quran tentang Profesi Notaris di Indonesia
journal: REVELATIA Jurnal Ilmu al-Qur`an dan Tafsir
abstract: The notary profession plays an important role in maintaining the credibility of notarial practice. The existence of Law No. 2 of 2014 concerning the Position of Notary has not yet been able to fully uphold this credibility, as in reality, issues related to improper recording practices in Indonesia often referred to as bogus records are still frequently encountered. This study aims to interpret notarial practice based on principles from the Qur'an, which emphasize the actualization of notaries as professionals. A qualitative-interpretative method was used, guiding the researcher to interpret the professional conduct of notaries. In conducting this interpretation, the researcher refers to QS. …

title: Kritik terhadap Unsur Tafsir Ad-Dakhil:
journal: REVELATIA Jurnal Ilmu al-Qur`an dan Tafsir
abstract: The study of Qur’anic exegesis is generally divided into two categories: interpretations considered sound (al-ashil) and those regarded as deviant (ad-dakhil). Every exegete’s work inevitably reflects this distinction. This study aims to investigates al-‘Uthaymīn’s interpretation of Surah al-Mā’idah verse 64 in Aḥkām min al-Qur'ān al-Karīm. In interpreting this verse, he does not employ ta’wīl (figurative reinterpretation). Instead, he prioritizes a textual reading, avoiding taḥrīf (distortion of meaning), ta‘ṭīl (negation), takyīf (describing the modality of God’s attributes), tamthīl (likeness), or tashbīh (anthropomorphism). Al-‘Uthaymīn is a follower of the teachings of Muḥammad ibn ‘Abd…

title: FILM ANIMASI ‘RIKO THE SERIES: EPISODE TANAMAN BERTASBIH’ (Kajian Living Qur`an)
abstract: This article intends to identify the form of the reception of the Qur'an contained in the 20th episode of the animated film Riko The Series entitled "Tanaman Bertasbih". This episode aired on the YouTube channel and received a positive response from its viewers who had reached 3,941,335 views. This study uses the theory of al-Qur'an reception which was popularized by Ahmad Rafiq. The results of this study indicate that the animated film Riko The Series is an animated film that contains educational, creative and Islamic content that also accepts the Qur'an in it. There are two forms of reception in this episode entitled “Tanaman Bertasbih”, namely exegesis reception, namely QS. al-Isra verse …

title: Pondasi Utama dalam Mempelajari Al Qur-An
authors: Muhammad Alfin Hasan Al Goni, Ummi Kultsum
abstract: Qur’an sebagai petunjuk utama bagi umat Islam mempunyai peran yang sangat besar dalam membentuk keyakinan, akhlak, dan cara hidup manusia. agar kita benar-benar bisa memahami isi dan pesan di dalamnya, tentu kita butuh dasar atau waktu yang kuat dalam mempelajarinya. Dasar ini mencakup tiga hal penting: bahasa, metode, dan kesiapan hati.Pertama, dari segi bahasa, kita sebagai ummat islam perlu menguasai dan memumpuni bahasa Arab karena itu bahasa Al-Qur’an. Dengan memahami kosakata Bahasa arab, seperti struktur kalimat, dan gaya bahasanya, kita bisa mempelajari makna ayat secara lebih tepat dan jelas. Kedua, dari segi metode, kita perlu wajib mempelajari ilmu-ilmu yang berkaitan dengan Al-Qu…

title: POLA PEMBINAAN KECERDASAN EMOSIONAL PADA SANTRI MELALUI KEGIATAN ASRAMA DAYAH INSAN QUR`ANI ACEH BESAR
journal: At-Tajdid : Jurnal Pendidikan dan Pemikiran Islam
abstract: Pendidikan adalah proses terencana yang bertujuan menciptakan suasana belajar untuk mengembangkan potensi peserta didik secara optimal. Dalam konteks pembangunan bangsa, pendidikan berperan penting dalam membentuk generasi yang unggul dalam pengetahuan dan matang secara emosional. Undang-Undang Nomor 20 Tahun 2003 menegaskan bahwa pendidikan harus mengembangkan kemampuan dan membentuk watak bangsa. Namun, banyak lembaga pendidikan yang masih fokus pada aspek akademik, mengabaikan pengelolaan emosi. Goleman menyatakan bahwa kecerdasan emosional berkontribusi besar terhadap keberhasilan hidup. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif untuk memahami pola pembinaan kecerdasan …

title: Implementasi Pendekatan Saintifik dalam Kurikulum 2013 pada Mata Pelajaran Al-Qur`an Hadist di MAN I Sumbawa Besar
authors: Muji Agus Sofiyandi, Romelah Romelah, Muh. Nurhakim
abstract: The implementation of the scientific approach in Indonesia’s 2013 Curriculum is intended to promote student-centered learning, critical thinking, and meaningful knowledge construction, including in Islamic Religious Education. However, its application in Al-Qur’an Hadith learning still presents practical challenges, particularly in adapting scientific learning principles to religious subject matter. Previous studies have largely focused on normative descriptions of curriculum implementation, with limited attention to classroom-level dynamics and teacher strategies in specific local contexts. This study aims to analyze the implementation of the scientific approach in Al-Qur’an Hadith learning…

title: Implementasi Metode Talaqqi dan Mutaba’ah dalam Menghafal Al-Qur`an di Rumah Tahfizh Madani Tanjung Bonai Aur
journal: Lathaif: Literasi Tafsir, Hadis dan Filologi
abstract: This study aims to examine and describe the implementation of the talaqqi and mutaba’ah methods in Qur’an memorization at Rumah Tahfizh Madani Tanjung Bonai Aur. The research questions focus on: (1) how the talaqqi and mutaba’ah methods are applied in the memorization process, (2) the advantages and disadvantages of each method, and (3) their influence on students’ memorization outcomes. This research employed a qualitative method with a descriptive approach. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, and analyzed using data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. The findings reveal that the talaqqi method is implemented by having the teacher recite ver…

title: Jami` Al-Bayan Fi Ta`Wil Al-Qur`An Karya Ibnu Jarir Ath-Thabari
authors: Indah Permata Sapihak, Nurul Fadillah Hasanah, Elviani
abstract: Al-Qur’an sebagai sumber utama ajaran Islam memerlukan pendekatan penafsiran yang komprehensif dan bertanggung jawab agar kandungan maknanya dapat dipahami secara tepat. Salah satu karya monumental dalam tradisi tafsir klasik adalah Jāmi‘ al-Bayān fī Ta’wīl al-Qur’ān karya Ibnu Jarir Ath-Thabari yang memiliki pengaruh besar terhadap perkembangan ilmu tafsir. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji latar belakang penulisan, karakteristik metodologi, serta corak penafsiran yang digunakan Ath-Thabari dalam karyanya tersebut. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif melalui studi pustaka dengan menelaah kitab utama dan literatur pendukung terkait. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa tafsi…

title: Problematika Guru dalam Melaksanakan Sistem Pembelajaran Kurikulum Merdeka Belajar di SD Takhassus Al-Qur`An Wonosobo
authors: Yeslin Tania Putri, Nasokah Nasokah, Chairani Astina
abstract: The implementation of the Merdeka Learning Curriculum is a national policy that requires teachers’ readiness to plan, implement, and evaluate learning in a more flexible and student-centered manner. In the context of Islamic-based elementary schools, the implementation of the Merdeka Curriculum also demands teachers’ ability to integrate Qur’anic values into the learning process without eliminating the institution’s distinctive characteristics and identity. This study focuses on the issues surrounding the implementation of the Merdeka Learning Curriculum at SD Takhassus Al-Qur’an Wonosobo. The research problems are formulated as follows: (1) how the Merdeka Learning Curriculum is implemented…

Adapun tujuannya untuk menjelaskan dan menganalisis makna dan manfaat qana’ah dalam Al-Qur`an. Jenis penelitian ini adalah penelitian kepustakaan (library research). Metode pengumpulan data yang digunakan dalam penelitian ini adalah metode tematik atau maudhu’i. Sedangkan metode analisis data yang digunakan adalah content analysis. title: Perkembangan Mun?sabah al-Qur’?n Era Klasik-Modern
journal: At-Ta'wil: Jurnal Pengkajian al-Qur'an dan at-Turats
abstract: The existence of the mun?sabah al-Qur'?n is disputed among the scholars, between the pros and cons. The majority of scholars agree that there is a mun?sabah in the Qur'an. This research produced several important points: 1] mun?sabah al-Qur'?n is a useful science to find out the systematic reasons for the placement of parts of the Qur'an, 2] periodization…

title: Tradisi Mangaji Pusaro Pada Masyarakat Nagari Lurah Ampalu di Kecamatan VII Koto Sungai Sarik Sumatra Barat (Studi Living Al-Qur`an) / Living Al-Qur’an dalam Tradisi Mangaji Pusaro: Studi pada Masyarakat Nagari Lurah Ampalu VII Koto Sungai Sarik
authors: Rahmat Ridho Illahi, Aulia Fitri, Syamsurizal Syamsurizal, Erwin Saputra Andika
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji fenomena Living Al-Qur’an yang terwujud dalam tradisi mangaji pusaro pada masyarakat Nagari Lurah Ampalu, Kabupaten Padang Pariaman. Tujuan penelitian ini adalah untuk mengungkap sejarah, prosesi pelaksanaan, serta nilai-nilai spiritual dan sosial yang terkandung dalam tradisi tersebut. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif deskriptif dengan pendekatan antropologis, melalui teknik pengumpulan data berupa observasi, wawancara mendalam, dan dokumentasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa tradisi mangaji pusaro bukan sekadar ritual ziarah kubur bersama, melainkan sebuah ekspresi spiritual komunal yang memadukan pembacaan ayat-ayat suci Al-Qur’an dengan nilai-nilai bud…

title: THE INFLUENCE OF POLITENESS SRATEGIES AND MAXIMS IN RELIGIOUS TEXTS: A LINGUOPRMATIC STUDY BASED ON QUR`AN TRANSLATIONS
abstract: This study investigates the presence and function of politeness strategies and maxims in selected translations of the Qur`an. Religious texts such as the Qur`an employ highly respectful, emotionally balanced and ethically guided communication aimed at instructing, comforting and guiding the believers. By applying a linguopragmatic approach the research examines how translators employ positive and negative politeness strategies to convey respect, humility and social norms inherent the source text. The study also investigates the influence of Leech`s and Brown & Levinson`s politeness theories on translation choices. Findings suggest that translator`s decisions significantly impact reader`s per…

title: Modal Logic, the Qirāʾāt , and Qur ʾ ānic Exegesis: Burhān al-Dīn al-Biqā ʿ ī on Sūrat al-Ṭāriq Verse 4
journal: Journal of Islamic and Muslim Studies
abstract: Abstract: The present article explores the application of modal logic to Qurʾānic exegesis ( tafsīr ). This is attempted through closely examining Burhān al-Dīn al-Biqāʿī's (d. 1480 CE) commentary on a short Qurʾānic verse, Qurʾān 86:4 ( Sūrat al-Ṭāriq , verse 4). The article provides a detailed exposition of al-Biqāʿī's commentary which pays particular attention to the two canonical readings in this verse. The article also outlines in detail the background logical theory behind al-Biqāʿī's treatment of Qurʾān 86:4. It is shown that while there is a general indifference to modal logic among Qurʾān exegetes, al-Biqāʿī's commentary on Qurʾān 86:4 presents a notable exception. His analysis, I s…

title: Thaharah dalam Perspektif Al-Qur`an: Fondasi Kebersihan Jasmani dan Rohani Muslim serta Membangun Budaya Bersih
authors: Cintana Balkis Habibah, Tiara Dewinta Aditya, Assyifa Azzahra, Triana Srisantyorini, Ayunda Larasati Sekarputri, Andriyani
journal: Karakter : Jurnal Riset Ilmu Pendidikan Islam
abstract: Thaharah represents a core principle within Islamic teachings, encompasses both bodily cleanliness and spiritual sanctity, and functions as an essential requirement for the proper observance of acts of worship, including prayer, tawaf, and the recitation of the Qur’an. This concept extends beyond ritual practice, reflecting a manifestation of faith that encourages Muslims to maintain personal hygiene, environmental cleanliness, and spiritual closeness to Allah SWT. This study aims to explore and critically examine the concept of thaharah in a comprehensive manner, clarify its role within Islamic religious practices, and assess its relevance in fostering clean lifestyle behaviors and appropri…

title: TELAAH AWAL ATAS TAFSIR JĀMI’ AL-BAYĀN MIN KHULĀṢAH SUWAR AL-QUR`ĀN KARYA KH. MUHAMMAD BIN SULAIMAN (1329-1412 H/ 1911-1991 M)
abstract: Jāmi’ Al-Bayān min Khulāṣah Suwar Al-Qur`ān by KH. Muhammad bin Sulaiman (1329 - 1412 H) Solo, Central Java, is one piece of exegesis work among the others in Indonesia which is not well-known by public. This study is aimed at introducing this exegesis work, through some topics raised here, namely the background or history of the writing, the exegesis methods, sources, systematics, and the contribution of Jāmi’ Al-Bayān min Khulāṣah Suwar Al-Qur'an in Indonesia. This study is relevant as to bring this work to the surface to be known by the public. This study concludes that Jāmi’ Al-Bayān min Khulāṣah Suwar Al-Qur'an is considered unique. The style of exegesis which KH. Muhammad initiated is …

title: Baca al-Qur`an sebagai Sanksi Pelanggar Lalu Lintas: Integrasi Nilai Religius dan Penegakan Hukum di Lombok Tengah Perspektif Hifzh al-Din
journal: Al Muhkam: Journal of Islamic Law and Jurisprudence

title: Urgensi Belajar Dalam Perspektif Al Qur-An Surat Al Alaq Ayat 1-5 Menurut Tafsir Al Misbah dan Tafsir Ibnu Katsir
authors: Abdul Kadir Jaelani, Fatma Muji Safitri, Muhammad Fahrurrozi
abstract: Belajar merupakan pilar utama dalam Islam yang pertama kali ditegaskan melalui wahyu pertama kepada Nabi Muhammad SAW. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengungkap urgensi perintah belajar dalam ajaran Islam serta menganalisis bagaimana Tafsir Al-Misbah dan Tafsir Ibnu Katsir memberikan pemahaman mendalam tentang makna ayat-ayat tersebut. Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah studi kepustakaan (library research) dengan pendekatan analisis isi (content analysis) terhadap kedua kitab tafsir sebagai sumber primer, serta literatur pendukung sebagai sumber sekunder. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Tafsir Al-Misbah menekankan aktivitas membaca (iqra') tidak hanya untuk memperoleh pengetahuan obj…

title: Sakinah Inklusif: Membaca Ulang Makna Sakinah dalam Perspektif Al-Qur`an Kontemporer
journal: Istinarah: Riset Keagamaan, Sosial dan Budaya
abstract: This study re-examines the concept of sakinah in Islam, which has traditionally been understood as something that can only be achieved through marriage. Using library research methods, combined with Fazlur Rahman’s contextual hermeneutics and a comparative analysis of classical and contemporary exegeses, the study finds that sakinah in the Qur’an possesses a broader spectrum of meanings than mere domestic tranquillity. An analysis of Surah Al-Fath verse 4, Surah At-Taubah verses 26 and 40, and Surah Ar-Rum verse 21 indicates that sakinah is a spiritual condition stemming from closeness to Allah that can be experienced in various life contexts without the mediation of the institution of marri…

title: Struktur Kebahasaan dan Fungsi Retoris Uslūb Nidā’ dalam Al-Qur`an: Kajian Balāgah dan Tafsir
authors: Musfirah Musfirah, Andi Miswar, Mardan Mardan
journal: Lathaif: Literasi Tafsir, Hadis dan Filologi
abstract: This study examines uslūb nidā’ (the rhetorical vocative style) in the Qur`an, addressing two research questions: (1) what are the linguistic structural forms of uslūb nidā’ in the Qur`an, and (2) what are the rhetorical functions of uslūb nidā’ from the perspectives of balāghah and Qur`anic exegesis? The study adopts a qualitative approach through library research. Seven verses were purposively selected from a total of 527 nidā’ verses in the Qur`an based on three criteria: representativeness of nidā’ particles, variety of munādā (addressees), and diversity of rhetorical functions. Primary data were drawn from Qur`anic verses and major exegetical works, including al-Tahrīr wa al-Tanwīr, Rūh…

title: Peran Budaya Belajar dalam Membentuk Kemuliaan Santri di Pondok Pesantren Tahfidzul Qur-An Assalam Riyadlul Jannah Bogor
abstract: The education system often emphasizes administrative achievements and knowledge transfer, while the internalization of values and character building receives less attention. This issue is also evident in Islamic boarding schools (pesantren), where traditional learning culture plays a crucial role in shaping students’ moral excellence. However, contemporary challenges such as digital disruption and changing learning behavior among Generation Z students have affected traditional learning practices. This Community Service Program (Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat/PKM) aims to strengthen the role of learning culture in shaping the noble character of students at Pondok Pesantren Tahfidzul Qur-An Assa…

title: PERBEDAAN PENGETAHUAN DAN SIKAP ANAK SEKOLAH DASAR TENTANG KARIES GIGI MELALUI MEDIA BOARD GAME “TOOTH TACTIC” DI SD QUR-AN ARRISALAH KOTA PADANG / Differences in Knowledge and Attitudes of Elementary School Students Regarding Dental Caries Through the “Tooth Tactic” Board Game at SD Qur-an Arrisalah, Padang City
authors: Cantika Verinaanwar, Rapitos Sidiq, Evi Maria L Silaban, John Amos, Novelasari Novelasari
abstract: Latar Belakang : Karies gigi merupakan salah satu masalah kesehatan umum pada anak usia sekolah yang dapat memengaruhi kualitas hidup mereka. SKI 2023 menyebutkan 56,9% penduduk Indonesia mengeluh masalah kesehatan gigi dan mulut. Hasil data penjaringan Puskesmas Air Dingin karies gigi terbanyak terdapat di SD Qur-an Arrisalah. Tujuan Penelitian : Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui perbedaan pengetahuan dan sikap anak sekolah dasar tentang karies gigi mealui media board game "Tooth Tactic" di SD Qur-an Arrisalah Kota Padang. Metode : Penelitian ini menggunakan metode mixed method dengan pendekatan kuantitatif quasi-experimental one-group pretest-posttest dan pendekatan kualitatif eksp…

title: Bibliander’s Understanding of Islam : With Special Reference to the Preface of the 1543 Latin Qur an Edition
journal: The Journal of Korean Evangelical Missiological Society

title: Pengamalan Al-Masurat di Kalangan Santri Pesantren Darul Arafah Raya
abstract: This study examines the practice of Al-Ma’tsurat among students at Darul Arafah Raya Islamic Boarding School from the perspective of the Living Qur’an approach. The research focuses on the forms of implementation, meanings, objectives, and the influence of Al-Ma’tsurat practice on the spiritual and social lives of the students. A qualitative method with a Living Qur’an approach was employed. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation. The findings reveal that Al-Ma’tsurat is not merely understood as a collection of daily remembrances (dhikr) and supplications, but also serves as a religious culture that shapes students’ character, enhances discipline in worship, p…

title: Eksistensi Tuhan dalam Psikologi: Analisis Psikologi dalam Ayat-Ayat Al-Qur`an / “The Existence of God in Psychology Analysis of Qur’anic Verses on Psychology”
authors: Khoirul Ibad, Artani Hasby, M Ziyad Ulhaq
journal: Jurnal Muria Research Guidance and Counseling
abstract: This study appears from the crisis of meaning and spiritual emptiness in modern psychology, which raises fundamental questions about the existence of God in psychological discourse. Rooted in the secular scientific tradition of the West, modern psychology tends to marginalize transcendence and religion in understanding the human being. Major schools—psychoanalysis, behaviorism, humanism, and transpersonal—focus on biological, behavioral, and cognitive aspects while neglecting spirituality and divinity. Employing a qualitative descriptive-analytical method with comparative analysis between modern psychological theories and Qur’anic texts, this research reveals that secular psychology denies d…

title: No Change in God’s Creation!
abstract: This article deals with Sûrah 30,30, one of the better known, more famous, Sûrates of the Qur ́ān. It follows this specific Sûrah’s direction into the heart of the Islamic monotheistic faith, including the mystery of creation (fitrah), of humankind. One of the most important announcements of Sûrah 30,30 is that the creation mystery coincides with the instauration of the very first ritual or religion (dīn) of humankind. The next step the Sûrah takes is to reveal in whose name the process unfolds itself, namely in the name of the Prophet Ibrahīm. His name is not mentioned by 30,30. However, the primordial ritual of prayer and adoration that emerges from the act of creation is called “h…

title: Development of an Educational Model for Taḥfīẓ al-Qur´ān Based on the "asy-Syakhṣiyyah al-Mujāhidah" for University Students
authors: Hadil Ismail Hasan, Abas Mansur Tamam, Akhmad Alim, Ahmad Abdel Hady
abstract: Current Qur'an memorization (tahfidz) practices in higher education urgently require reconstruction because the dominance of a quantitative orientation often neglects character building, thereby producing memorizers who are psychologically vulnerable and lack self-regulation. This study aims to develop and test the feasibility of the "Mujahid Character-Based Qur'an Tahfidz Educational Model" as an integrated curriculum for university students. This research employs the Research and Development (R&D) method based on the ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development) model, utilizing questionnaires, Focus Group Discussions (FGD), and expert validation (Expert Judgment). The results formulated the "MUJA…

title: Towards a Typology of Tafsir Al-Qur`an by Al-Qur`an and by Sunnah; Exegetical Patterns in Aqīdah and Ibādah Verses
abstract: This study aims to describe the various tafsir of the Qur'an by Qur'an and by Sunnah as applied to verses on Aqidah and Ibadah, while also analyzing their contribution to producing a comprehensive understanding that aligns with Sharia principles. The diversity of interpretation methodologies provides a positive contribution by enriching the treasure trove of Islamic knowledge, but it can also lead to differences in understanding if not based on true methodologies like the Qur'an and Sunnah as primary sources of tafsir. Data was obtained through a descriptive-analytical qualitative approach by analyzing verses on Aqidah and Ibadah using the theoretical foundations of Ulum Qur'an and Usul Tafs…

title: The Principles of Farid Esack’s Liberation Hermeneutics and Their Implications for the Interpretation of Qur`anic Verses on Male Leadership
authors: Sara Ayusti, Risman Bustamam, Hafizzullah Hafizzullah
journal: Proceedings of International Conference on Religion, Social and Humanities
abstract: This research is driven by the polemics over the interpretation of the Qur`anic verses on male leadership that are often used as a basis for legitimizing patriarchy, especially QS. al-Baqarah [2]:228 and QS. an-Nisa [4]:34. The focus of this research is to analyze the two verses through Farid Esack’s liberation hermeneutics approach to see their relevance to the issue of gender justice In the digital age, patriarchal narratives are increasingly easy and quick to spread in the digital space, thus requiring the presence of strong and transformative theological counter narratives. The method used is a qualitative approach based on literature study with tafsir maudhu’i, which collects relevant v…

title: Implementasi Pembelajaran Tahfidzul Qur???an dengan Metode Ma???ani di Pesantren Darussalam Bone
abstract: This study aims to examine the application of the Ma???ani method in the Tahfidzul Qur???an program at the Darussalam Bone Islamic Boarding School. The Ma???ani method is an innovative approach that integrates memorization of the Qur'an with an understanding of the meaning and context of its verses. This approach not only helps students memorize the Qur'an but also provides a deep understanding of the mufradat, Arabic language structure, and the messages contained in the verses of the Qur'an. This method is used as a strategic step to increase students' interest in studying Islamic knowledge, including yellow books, in a relevant and applicable manner. The research employed a descriptive qua…

title: التَّماسُكُ النَّحْوِيُّ المعرفِيُّ بوجاهِ محمولَي اليقينِ والظنِّ، بعض آي التنزيل أنموذجًا / Cognitive grammatical cohesion by interface binding of certainty and suspicion, some verses of Qur,an as an example
abstract: الأهداف: تقوم الدراسةُ على وِجاهٍ نحويٍّ معرفيٍّ متماسكٍ رابطٍ بين دلالاتِ الضدِّ ذي المحمول النفسيِّ، بتضافرِ المفهومِ والتصوُّرِ والفضاء حيث التمثُّلُ الذهنيُّ بنيةً ووظيفةً، مؤولًا بعمليات التركيب والإكمال والبلورة والتوسيع، فرزها التداخل والتهجين والمزج والإحالة؛ فكان ذلك هدفًا قائمًاٍ على مناويلَ من آي التنزيل. وتتمثَّلُ إشكاليَّة الدراسة في استظهار الوجاه الرابط بين ضدين بنيةً عميقةً قائمةً على موازنةِ تَبْريزٍ حَذِرةٍ بين البَلْوَرَةِ والتَّوْسيعِ. المنهجية: تتَّخِذُ الدراسةُ من المعرفية أساسًا للتحليل وفق منهج علمي موحَّدٍ واصلٍ بين اللسانيات وعلم الأعصاب والنفس والفلسفة والاجتماع والسلوك والأنثروبولوجيا. النتائج: خَلصَت الدراسةُ إلى أنه بالعلاقات المتقابلة بين محمولي اليقين والظن يم…

title: Urutan Turun Surah-Surah Al-Qur-an
MANHAJ AL-KHĀṢ TAFSIR AL-ḤAYĀH AL-ṬAYYIBAH AND ITS IMPLICATIONS FOR SANTRI RECEPTION
authors: Fitri Meliani, Wildan Taufiq, Ahmad Izzan
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis manhaj al-khāṣ Tafsir Al-Ḥayāh al-Ṭayyibah Ma‘a al-Qur’ān: Ḥāsyiyah ‘Aṣriyyah ‘alā Tafsīr al-Jalālain karya Syekh ‘Alā Muṣṭafā Na‘īmah serta implikasinya terhadap resepsi santri di Pondok Pesantren Jamanis Pangandaran. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan studi kasus yang memadukan kajian teks dan penelitian lapangan. Analisis teks menggunakan pendekatan manāhij al-mufassirīn, sedangkan resepsi santri dianalisis melalui teori Hans Robert Jauss, khususnya konsep horizon of expectations. Data diperoleh dari kitab tafsir, wawancara, observasi, dokumentasi, dan literatur yang relevan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa manhaj al-khāṣ ta…

title: Integral Terhadap Pemikiran Hermeneutis Nasr Hamid Abu Zayd: Atas Tafsir Kontekstual QS. An-Nisā’ [4]:3” / HERMENEUTIKA KONTEKSTUAL NASR HAMID ABU ZAYD: ANALISIS KRITIS DAN KOMPARATIF TERHADAP TAFSIR KLASIK QS. AN-NISĀ’ [4]:3
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini membahas pemikiran hermeneutik Nasr Hamid Abu Zayd yang menempatkan Al-Qur’an sebagai teks budaya (muntaj tsaqāfī) yang hidup dalam konteks sejarah, bahasa, dan sosial manusia. Permasalahan utama penelitian ini adalah bagaimana konsep, integrasi, dan penerapan hermeneutika Abu Zayd dalam kajian tafsir Al-Qur’an. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk menguraikan paradigma hermeneutika kontekstual dan humanistik yang ditawarkannya sebagai pembaruan terhadap metode tafsir tradisional yang cenderung literal dan statis. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode analisis kualitatif berbasis kajian pustaka dengan pendekatan deskriptif-analitis terhadap karya-karya Abu Zayd dan literatur pendukungnya. …

title: TAṬFĪF DAN MISLABELLING DALAM PERDAGANGAN MODERN: ANALISIS MAʿNĀ-CUM-MAGHZĀ QS. AL-MUṬAFFIFĪN [83]:1–6
authors: Muhammad Hasdin Has, Aminudin Aminudin, Faisal Saleh Julian Saputra
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Mislabelling is a form of food fraud that has become increasingly prevalent in modern trade systems and has the potential to harm consumers through the manipulation of product information. This study aims to examine the relevance of the concept of taṭfīf in Q.S. al-Muṭaffifīn [83]:1–6 to the phenomenon of mislabelling using the Maʿnā-cum-Maghzā hermeneutical approach. This research employs a qualitative library research method with a descriptive-analytical framework. Primary sources consist of Q.S. al-Muṭaffifīn [83]:1–6 and classical to contemporary Qur’anic commentaries, while secondary sources include literature on food fraud, Islamic business ethics, and Information Asymmetry theory. The…

title: Tawasul dalam Tradisi Islam: Analisis Komprehensif Tafsir, Hadis, dan Praktiknya di Indonesia / REINTERPRETASI WASILAH DAN KONSTRUKSI MODERASI TAWASUL DALAM ISLAM INDONESIA
authors: Afif Kholidin, Muhammad Syahrul Mubarak, Nabila Umayrah, Saifudin Zuhri, Natasya Fakhira Sukma
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Tawasul atau praktik perantaraan dalam berdoa kepada Allah dengan menyebut nama, sifat, atau kedudukan orang saleh, telah lama menjadi bagian dari tradisi Islam. Namun, praktik ini sering menjadi perdebatan di antara umat Muslim terkait keabsahan dan batasannya. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis konsep tawasul berdasarkan hadis dan tafsir Al-Qur'an serta penerapannya dalam konteks umat Islam di Indonesia. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode studi pustaka, data diperoleh dari sumber primer seperti kitab tafsir dan hadis, serta sumber sekunder berupa artikel ilmiah, kemudian dilakukan analisis secara deskriptif-analitik untuk mengevaluasi berbagai perspektif yang ada terkait konsep taw…

title: AMINA WADUD’S FEMINIST HERMENEUTICS ON GENDER VERSES AND ITS IMPLICATIONS FOR ISLAMIC EDUCATION
authors: Khoirul Umam Addzaky, Ilzam Hubby Dzikrillah Alfani, Masyhuri Rifai
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: This study examines Amina Wadud’s feminist hermeneutics of gender-related verses in Sūrah al-Nisā’ through a comparative analysis with the classical exegesis of al-Ṭabarī, Ibn Kathīr, and al-Qurṭubī. The research employs a qualitative library-based method using a critical feminist hermeneutical approach. The analysis focuses on Q. 4:1 concerning creation, Q. 4:34 on qawwāmah, and Q. 4:11–12 on inheritance. The findings reveal that Wadud interprets these verses through contextual, linguistic, and ethical approaches emphasizing justice, equality, and relational responsibility. In contrast to classical interpretations that tend to frame gender relations hierarchically, Wadud distinguishes betwe…

title: Etika Praktis Penggunaan Artificial Intelligence (AI) dalam Studi Hadis Berlandaskan Nilai Islam dan Asas Etika Digital / MODEL ETIKA ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE DALAM STUDI HADIS INTEGRASI PRINSIP ETIKA DIGITAL DAN NILAI ISLAM
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Abstrak Tradisi keilmuan memasuki fase Artificial Intellegence (AI) yang berimplikasi pada ranah verifikasi, klasifikasi, hingga analisis matan. Dengan kemajuan ini, peneliti hadis dapat melakukan elaborasi matan hadis melalui pendekatan berbasis data dan membantu penelitian hadis secara umum. Namun, kajian hadis yang semata-mata dilakukan dengan AI memiliki resiko kesalahan seperti distorsi sanad dan matan hadis. Fase ini juga memunculkan potensi penyalahgunaan AI dalam studi hadis. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk memberikan gambaran tentang etika praktis yang perlu dipegang oleh para pengkaji hadis dalam pemanfaatkan AI. Metode yang digunakan dalam penelitian ini adalah deskriptif kualitati…

title: Gaya Hidup Elit Politik Dalam Perspektif Al Qur-an / ETIKA GAYA HIDUP ELIT POLITIK DALAM AL-QUR’AN: STUDI TAFSIR KOMPARATIF ATAS IBNU KATSIR, HAMKA, DAN M. QURAISH SHIHAB
authors: Miftakhu Nuril Khodijah, Miftara Ainul Mufid, Amir Mahmud, Wiwin Ainis Rohtih
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis konsep gaya hidup elit politik dalam perspektif Al-Qur’an melalui pendekatan tafsir maudhui antara Tafsir Ibnu Katsir, Tafsir Al-Azhar, dan Tafsir Al-Misbah. Metode yang digunakan adalah metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan tafsir tematik terhadap beberapa ayat. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Al-Qur’an menekankan prinsip keseimbangan, kesederhanaan, serta larangan berlebih-lebihan sebagai dasar etika kepemimpinan. Ketiga tafsir memiliki perbedaan pendekatan, namun sama-sama menolak gaya hidup boros dan menegaskan tanggung jawab moral pemimpin. Gaya hidup elit yang berlebihan dapat menurunkan kepercayaan publik dan meningkatkan kesenjangan sosial, sehingga nilai…

title: KONSTRUKSI KESIAPAN MENTAL ORANG TUA DALAM PERSPEKTIF TAFSIR AL-MISHBAH: ANALISIS INTEGRATIF QS. LUQMAN 13–19 DAN QS. AN-NISA’ 9
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: This study examines parental mental readiness from a Qur’anic perspective through an integrative analysis of Surah Luqman (13–19) and Surah An-Nisa’ (9) based on Tafsir Al-Mishbah. The research is motivated by the dominant emphasis on financial readiness in family formation, which often neglects the mental and spiritual preparedness of parents. This study employs a qualitative approach using library research and thematic exegesis analysis. The findings reveal that parental mental readiness is a multidimensional construct consisting of five main dimensions: monotheism, reciprocity, emotional regulation, social morality, and responsibility. The model aligns with modern parenting theories, such…

title: Transformasi Naratif Kisah Nabi Sulaiman dalam Relasi Al-Qur’an–Bible: Analisis Intertekstual Julia Kristeva / TRANSFORMASI NARATIF NABI SULAIMAN DALAM AL-QUR’AN DAN AL-KITAB PERSPEKTIF PENDEKATAN INTERTEKSTUAL JULIA KRISTEVA
authors: Muhammad Rasyidin, Nur Aeni Putri Gafar, Mar'atun Nabila, Dian Nur Anna, Arbain Arbain
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji transformasi naratif kisah Nabi Sulaiman dalam Al-Qur’an dan Al-Kitab melalui teo ri intertekstualitas Julia Kristeva dengan penekanan pada produktivitas teks dan transposisi makna. Berangkat dari keterbatasan pendekatan deskriptif dan berorientasi sumber, artikel ini memandang keterlibatan Al-Qur’an terhadap tradisi sebelumnya sebagai proses pembacaan ulang yang bersifat transformatif dalam horizon teologis yang berbeda. Penelitian ini menggunakan analisis teks kualitatif terhadap ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an dan narasi Al-Kitab dalam 1 Raja-raja dan 2 Tawarikh. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Al-Qur’an secara sistematis menata ulang kisah Sulaiman melalui …

title: Rekonstruksi Makna Qiwāmah dalam Qs An-Nisā’ [4]:34: Pendekatan Sosio-Historis / REKONSTRUKSI MAKNA QIWĀMAH DALAM QS AN-NISĀ’ [4]:34: ANALISIS SEMANTIK QUR’ANI DAN PENDEKATAN SOSIO-HISTORIS
authors: Muh. Nasruddin A, Achmad Abubakar, Sohrah Sohrah
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penafsiran QS An-Nisā’ [4]:34 tentang konsep qiwāmah selama ini kerap dipahami sebagai legitimasi kepemimpinan laki-laki atas perempuan dalam ranah domestik. Pembacaan tersebut umumnya bersifat tekstual dan kurang mempertimbangkan konteks sosio-historis turunnya ayat serta dimensi etis yang lebih luas dalam Al-Qur’an. Artikel ini bertujuan untuk merekonstruksi makna qiwāmah melalui pendekatan sosio-historis yang integratif dengan menggabungkan analisis linguistik, semantik Qur’ani dan konteks sosial masyarakat Arab awal. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif berbasis studi kepustakaan dengan menelaah sumber-sumber tafsir klasik dan kontemporer serta literatur akademik terkait. Hasil p…

title: Analisis Al-Wujūh wa al-Naẓā’ir terhadap Keragaman Makna Lafaz Hudā dalam Al-Qur’an / HUDĀ DALAM AL-QUR’AN: KAJIAN AL-WUJŪH WA AL-NAẒĀ’IR TERHADAP VARIASI MAKNA DAN RELASI SEMANTIK
authors: Misdah Misdah, Andi Miswar, Hamkah Ilyas
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Kajian terhadap keragaman makna lafaz dalam Al-Qur’an merupakan bagian penting dalam studi semantik Qur’ani karena satu lafaz dapat memiliki makna berbeda sesuai konteks penggunaannya. Salah satu lafaz yang memiliki dimensi semantik luas adalah hudā, yang tidak hanya bermakna petunjuk secara umum, tetapi juga berkaitan dengan konsep agama, iman, wahyu, dan hidayah ilahi. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis keragaman makna lafaz hudā dalam Al-Qur’an melalui pendekatan al-wujūh wa al-naẓā’ir, mengidentifikasi ayat-ayat yang memuat lafaz tersebut, mengklasifikasikan variasi maknanya berdasarkan konteks ayat, serta mendeskripsikan implikasinya dalam penafsiran Al-Qur’an. Penelitian ini m…

title: STRUKTUR DIALOGIS AL-QUR’AN DALAM KAIDAH AS-SU’ĀL WA AL-JAWĀB: ANALISIS RETORIKA DAN IMPLIKASI HERMENEUTIS
authors: Sukmawati Sukmawati, Andi Miswar, Hamka Ilyas
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: This study examines the dialogical structure of the Qur’an in the principle of as-su’āl wa al-jawāb through rhetorical analysis and its hermeneutical implications in Qur’anic interpretation. The research employs a qualitative method with a library research approach by integrating thematic exegesis, Qur’anic rhetoric, and pragmatic linguistics. Primary data consist of Qur’anic verses containing patterns of questions and answers, while secondary data are derived from classical and contemporary tafsir literature and related scholarly works. The findings reveal that the pattern of as-su’āl wa al-jawāb functions not merely as a linguistic communication device, but also as a rhetorical strategy wi…

title: Kaghombo sebagai Pendidikan Pra-Nikah Masyarakat Muna: Kajian Tafsir-Kultural atas Konsep Keluarga Sakinah dalam QS. Al-Rum [30]:21 / PENDIDIKAN PRA-NIKAH MASYARAKAT MUNA: KAJIAN TAFSIR-KULTURAL ATAS KONSEP KELUARGA SAKINAH DALAM QS. AL-RUM [30]:21
authors: Abid Muhaimin, Muh. Susen Latujajuli, Nasri Akib
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi

Sumber primer meliputi Al-Qur’an, Tafsir al-Mishbah, dan Tafsir al-Munir, sedangkan sumber sekunder mencakup literatur mengenai pendidikan pra-nikah, keluarga sakinah, ‘urf shahih, maqasid al-syariah, serta kajian tentang tradisi Karia atau kaghombo masyarakat Muna. Analisis dilakukan melalui empat tahapan,…

title: POLA KOMUNIKASI KELUARGA DALAM NARASI TEKS KISAH AL-QUR’AN; ANALISIS FAMILY COMMUNICATION PATTERNS THEORY
authors: Anggy Rayhana Haswy, Ni'matu Zuhrah, Safrudin
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis pola komunikasi keluarga dalam narasi Nabi Ibrahim melalui kerangka Family Communication Patterns Theory (FCPT). Menggunakan metode kepustakaan kualitatif dan analisis tekstual terhadap ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an, penelitian menelaah interaksi Ibrahim dengan ayahnya, Azar, istrinya, Hajar, serta putranya, Ismail. title: KONSTRUKSI IDEOLOGI MUHAMMADIYAH DALAM TAFSIR AL-AZHAR: SEBUAH ANALISIS WACANA KRITIS
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis bagaimana ideologi Muhammadiyah mempengaruhi penafsiran Buya Hamka dalam Tafsir Al-Azhar melalui Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA) Fairclough. Menggunakan metode library research dengan pendekatan kualitatif, penelitian ini menganalisis tiga ayat pilihan: QS. Ali 'Imran :104 (dakwah terstruktur), QS. Al-Baqarah :170 (rasionalisme dan anti-taklid), dan QS. Al-Ma'un :1-7 (amal sosial konkret). title: ANALISIS WACANA FOUCAULT TENTANG OTENTISITAS AL-QUR’AN: PERSPEKTIF TOSHIHIKO IZUTSU
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis wacana dominan otentisitas al-Qur’an dalam perspektif Toshihiko Izutsu dengan menggunakan pendekatan semantik dan kerangka teori kekuasaan–pengetahuan Michel Foucault. Penelitian ini merupakan studi kepustakaan dengan metode kualitatif, menggunakan karya-karya utama Izutsu sebagai sumber data primer serta literatur Orientalisme dan studi al-Qur’an kontemporer sebagai data sekunder. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Izutsu membangun wacana dominan yang menegaskan otentisitas al-Qur’an melalui analisis relasi makna internal yang konsisten, sehingga menghasilkan counter-discourse terhadap hegemoni pandangan skeptis orientalis klasik. title: KONSEP ISTIṬĀ’AH DALAM AL-QUR’AN DAN IMPLIKASINYA TERHADAP KESIAPAN IBADAH HAJI DI KENDARI / ISTIṬĀ'AH DALAM AL-QUR'AN DAN IMPLIKASINYA TERHADAP KESIAPAN IBADAH HAJI: STUDI KENDARI
authors: Muh Rezky Alsyah Ananta, Irdawati Saputri, Mir'atul Hasanah
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Ibadah haji merupakan rukun Islam kelima yang mensyaratkan istiṭā’ah (kemampuan) sebagai syarat wajib bagi calon jemaah. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis makna istiṭā’ah dalam Al-Qur'an dan implikasinya terhadap kesiapan ibadah haji calon jemaah Kendari, Sulawesi Tenggara. Menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif-interpretatif, penelitian mengintegrasikan library research dengan analisis semantik kognitif pada tafsir Ibnu Katsir dan Al-Qurthubi, wawancara semi-terstruktur dengan 15 calon jemaah haji dari Kendari, dan analisis dokumen kebijakan haji. title: DIALOG RESEPSI JAMĀ’AH TABLĪGH TERHADAP QS. ALĪ-IMRĀN [3]: 104 DENGAN QS. AL-AHZĀB [33]: 33 TENTANG PERAN PEREMPUAN DALAM DAKWAH / DIALOG RESEPSI JAMĀ’AH TABLĪGH TERHADAP QS. ALĪ-IMRĀN [3]: 104 DENGAN DAN QS. AL-AHZĀB [33]: 33 TENTANG PERAN PEREMPUAN DALAM DAKWAH
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: This study examines the reception dialogue of Jamā'ah Tablīgh regarding QS. Āli-'Imrān :104 concerning the obligation to preach and QS. al-Ahzāb :33 regarding women's roles at home. Using a qualitative approach with the Living Qur'an method, this research was conducted from February to May 2024 at Al-Markaz Jamā'ah Tablīgh, Bombana District, Southeast Sulawesi. Data were collected through in-depth interviews with 8 informants (5 women, 3 men), participatory observation, and document study, then analyzed using the Miles & Huberman model. The findings reveal that Jamā'ah Tablīgh does not experience contradiction in understanding the two verses. QS. Āli-'Imrān :104 is understood as a universal …

title: NUSYŪZ SUAMI DALAM QS. AN-NISĀ’ [4]:128: ANALISIS TAFSIR AL-MUNĪR WAHBAH AZ-ZUHAILI DAN IMPLIKASINYA TERHADAP HUKUM KELUARGA ISLAM
authors: Trisni Nur Azzahroni, Fatirahwahidah, Syahrul Mubarak, Nasri Akib
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan mengkaji konsep nusyūz suami dalam QS. An-Nisā’ [4]:128 melalui analisis terhadap penafsiran Wahbah Az-Zuhaili dalam Tafsir al-Munīr, serta membandingkannya dengan penafsiran al-Qurṭubī, Ibnu Katsīr, dan Quraish Shihab. title: Respon Q.S At-TakasuHEDONISME GENERASI Z DALAM SOROTAN Q.S. AT-TAKATSUR: ANALISIS KOMPARATIF TAFSIR SAYYID QUTHB DAN QURAISH SHIHABr Terhadap Hedonisme di Kalangan Generasi Z (Analisis Penafsiran Sayyid Quthb dan Quraish Shihab) / HEDONISME GENERASI Z DALAM SOROTAN Q.S. AT-TAKATSUR: ANALISIS KOMPARATIF TAFSIR SAYYID QUTHB DAN QURAISH SHIHAB
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi

title: KONSEP SAKĪNAH MAWADDAH WARAḤMAH DALAM QS. AR-RŪM/30:21: STUDI PERSEPSI ORANG TUA TUNGGAL DI PASARE APUA
authors: Sukmawati Sukmawati, Abdul Gaffar, Masyhuri Rifai
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Artikel ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan persepsi orang tua tunggal terhadap konsep sakīnah mawaddah wa raḥmah, dan menentukan korelasi antara persepsi orang tua tunggal dengan tafsir ulama mengenai sakīnah mawaddah wa raḥmah pada QS. title: TINJAUAN SEMANTIK TERHADAP LAFAZ NAZALA DAN HABAṬA DALAM AL-QUR’AN
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Artikel ini bertujuan untuk menjelaskan relevansi makna kata nazala dan habaṭa dalam konteks kajian semantik Al-Qur’an, serta mengkaji penggunaan kata-kata tersebut dalam konteks ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an. Data primer dalam penelitian ini adalah ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an yang berkaitan dengan kata nazala dan habaṭa, sedangkan data sekunder diperoleh dari kitab tafsir, jurnal, kamus, dan literatur relevan lainnya. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui studi kepustakaan, dan analisis data dilakukan dengan menggunakan metode analisis isi deskriptif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa tidak terdapat…

title: NILAI-NILAI SPIRITUALITAS ANAK DALAM KISAH KELUARGA IMRAN: TELAAH TEMATIK PERSPEKTIF TAFSIR BIL MA’TSUR
authors: Rani Rahmadani. M Rani, Masyhuri Putra, Salmaini Yeli
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Penulisan ini bertujuan untuk menemukan nilai-nilai pengembangan spiritualitas anak dalam kisah keluarga Imran melalui pendekatan tafsir bil ma’tsur, serta sekaligus menggali pandangan mufassir mengenai hal tersebut. Temuan dari studi ini menunjukkan bahwa keluarga Imran merupakan keluarga istimewa yang mendapatka…

title: PRAKTIK MAGIS QS. ṬĀHĀ: 39 DENGAN BULU PERINDU: STUDI LIVING QUR’AN DI KABUPATEN KOLAKA
authors: Nur Aeni Putri Gafar, Fatirawahidah, Akbar, Hasdin Has
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: This article examines the practice of implementing QS. Ṭāhā: 39 using bulu perindu as a medium of attraction in Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi, which aims to explore the form of practice, the process of transmission and transformation, and its impact on the function of the Qur'an as a guide (hudan). It was found that this practice varies, combining the reading of verses with the use of bulu perindu and water, and is influenced by religious stories. authors: Rizki Ramadhan Sitepu, Moh Firdaus HN, Muhammad Falihul Anam
journal: El-Maqra Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur an Hadis dan Teologi
abstract: Pemahaman terhadap al-Qur’an di era kontemporer mengalami pergeseran metodologis dari pendekatan tradisional menuju pendekatan yang lebih kontekstual dan rasional. Salah satu tokoh penting dalam gelombang ini adalah Abid al-Jabiri, filsuf asal Maroko yang menawarkan pendekatan epistemologis dalam memahami al-Qur’an. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengkaji kontribusi al-Jabiri terhadap studi Qur’an dengan menekankan pentingnya penafsiran berdasarkan urutan kronologis turunnya wahyu serta kritiknya terhadap pendekatan ideologis dan dogmatis dalam tafsir klasik. journal: Jurnal Yudistira : Publikasi Riset Ilmu Pendidikan dan Bahasa
abstract: This study aims to describe the implementation of Al-Qur’an Hadith learning through the hadith tadabbur approach at Madrasah Aliyah Laboratorium UINSU and to analyze its impact on students’ understanding and practice of Islamic values. title: pengaruh lingkungan terhadap perserta didik dalam meningkatkan hafalan tahfidz al-qur`an
journal: Journal of Education Informatic Technology and Science
abstract: Kitab suci al-Qur'an berfungsi sebagai sumber hukum agama Islam. Da'i dan ulama' menggunakannya saat berdakwah. Selain itu, Al-Qur'an sangat penting untuk mengarahkan perilaku manusia; jika diajarkan kepada anak-anak sejak dini, itu akan berdampak positif. Belajar Al-Qur'an membantu anak-anak belajar dan meningkatkan otak mereka. Mempelajari dan memahami Al-Qur'an akan menghasilkan penerapan akhlak yang baik. Salah satu keuntungan bagi mereka yang menghafal Al Qur'an adalah mereka akan diberi posisi tertinggi di surga. Peneliti menggunakan studi kepustakaan, dengan mengumpulkan data dan membaca banyak buku dan majalah sebagai sumber data tambahan. Tidak ada penelitian lapangan yang menunjukk…

title: Al-Qur`an Tahfidz Learning Management For Early Childhood
abstract: Abstract. General Background: Tahfidz Al-Qur’an learning for early childhood requires structured management to support a quality learning process. Specific Background: Markaz Tahfidz Al-Firdaus Sidoarjo applies management through planning, organizing, implementation, and evaluation. Knowledge Gap: Previous studies have mainly examined tahfidz management in pesantren settings, while early childhood requires closer assistance and age-appropriate learning methods. Aims: This study examines tahfidz learning management at Markaz Tahfidz Al-Firdaus. authors: Mochammad Rochmat, Eko Surbiantor, Dedih Surana
abstract: Abstract. The low level of Qur’an reading proficiency among some parents, particularly in fluency, makhraj (pronunciation), and tajwid (rules of recitation), is influenced by limited religious education in the past, age-related factors, and the lack of learning methods appropriate for adult learners. This study aims to examine the concept, stages, outcomes, as well as the supporting and inhibiting factors in the implementation of Qur’an reading instruction for parents at Ar-Rahmah Mosque, Sukapada, Bandung. This research employed a descriptive qualitative approach with field research as its design. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation involving instructors, …

title: PERAN HIDAYAH DALAM KEHIDUPAN MANUSIA MENURUT AL-QUR`AN
abstract: Hidayah merupakan konsep fundamental dalam ajaran Islam yang berfungsi sebagai petunjuk dan bimbingan Allah Swt. bagi manusia dalam menjalani kehidupan menuju kebenaran dan keselamatan. Al-Qur'an sebagai sumber utama ajaran Islam menegaskan bahwa hidayah mencakup pedoman dalam aspek keimanan, ibadah, akhlak, dan kehidupan sosial, sehingga memiliki peran yang sangat penting dalam membentuk arah dan tujuan hidup manusia, terutama di tengah tantangan moral dan krisis nilai pada era modern. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis peran hidayah dalam kehidupan manusia menurut perspektif Al-Qur'an dengan menggunakan metode kualitatif melalui pendekatan studi kepustakaan (library research) dan …

title: Baca Al-Qur`an dengan Mushaf Madinah untuk Jama`ah Musholla Ar-Rahman Kramat Jati - Jakarta Timur
authors: Ahmad Mujib, Muhammad Akrom, Yoseph Salmon Yusuf, Siti Fuadah
abstract: Membaca Al-Qur`an dengan tartil atau sesuai dengan kaidah ilmu tajwid merupakan suatu kebutuhan dan juga kewajiban bagi umat Islam. Mushaf Madinah telah banyak dipergunakan oleh masyarakat Indonesia secara luas. Terdapat banyak kekeliruan yang dijumpai pada jama`ah Musholla Ar-Rahman ketika membaca Al-Qur`an dengan menggunakan mushaf Madinah. Pelatihan Baca Al-Qur`an Dengan Mushaf Madinah bertujuan untuk memberikan pelatihan membaca Al-Qur`an dengan Mushaf Madinah bagi jama`ah Musholla Ar-Rahman Batu Ampar, Kramat Jati – Jakarta Timur. Pelatihan ini berhasil meningkatkan kemampuan serta motivasi jama`ah dalam membaca Al-Qur`an dengan baik dan benar sesuai kaidah ilmu tajwid.

title: Pendampingan Pembiasaan Muroqobah untuk Penguatan Literasi Al-Qur an Peserta Didik di PKBM PNF KBRI Kuala Lumpur
authors: Muhammad Tohir Haqiqi, Ahmad Ihwanul Muttaqin, Dwi Apriliana, Alifan Firmansyah Putra, Tsamrotus Salwa, Nurhafid Ishari
abstract: Limited access to religious education among the children of Indonesian migrant workers in Malaysia remains an important issue, particularly with regard to their ability to read the Qur’an. Some students at the Pusat Kegiatan Belajar Masyarakat (PKBM) PNF of the Embassy of the Republic of Indonesia (KBRI) in Kuala Lumpur continue to experience difficulties in reading Juz Amma, including fluency, accurate pronunciation of Arabic letters, proper observance of vowel length, and confidence in reading in front of teachers and peers. abstract: The ability to read and write the Qur'an is a fundamental competency for every Muslim, serving as the foundation for understanding and practicing Islamic teachings. However, the Qur'anic literacy of the community in Kauman Village, Ngoro District, Jombang Regency, still requires improvement, particularly in recognizing the Arabic alphabet (hijaiyah), pronouncing letters according to their correct articulation points (makhārij al-ḥurūf), applying basic rules of tajwid, and writing Arabic letters accurately. authors: Nur Halidza Sangko, Hasyim Mahmud Wantu, Habibie Yusuf

abstract: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh pentingnya motivasi peserta didik dalam menghafal Al-Qur’an Juz 30 di MAN 1 Kotamobagu. Dalam pelaksanaannya, masih ditemukan peserta didik yang kurang konsisten dalam menyetor hafalan, mudah jenuh, mengalami kesulitan menjaga hafalan, serta terganggu oleh penggunaan handphone yang berlebihan. authors: Muhammad Fadhil Wathani, M. Ikram Idris
abstract: The burning of the Quran in Scandinavia since July 2023 has triggered a significant escalation of Islamophobia in Europe, creating social polarization and increasing discrimination against Muslim communities. abstract: An-Nisa’ [4]:34 is one of the most debated verses in gender studies because it contains the concepts of qiwāmah, al-faḍl, woman’s piety (ṣāliḥāt), nusyūz, and waḍribūhunna, which are often viewed as legitimizing the subordination of women. This article aims to analyze how Sayyid Quthb constructs a gender narrative in his exegesis of QS. title: How did the quranic pagans make a living?
journal: Bulletin of the School of Oriental and African Studies
abstract: This article examines the information given in the Quran, as distinct from the exegetical tradition, on the livelihoods pursued by the mushriku¯n to whom the Messenger was preaching. It finds them to be uniformly described as agriculturalists and seafarers. The purpose of their maritime activity is not usually specified, but on one occasion it is said to be for fishing. The believers, too, are agriculturalists in some passages, but they are more commonly described as traders. There is a wealth of passages depicting them as such, and preaching to them in commercial imagery, in the suras classified by the tradition as Medinese.

abstract: The Bornu quranic manuscripts with interlinear ajami glosses in a Kanuri dialect were discovered by A. D. H. Bivar in the late 1950s. abstract: In this article I will focus upon authors who have suggested basic methodological challenges to the assumptions of Wansbrough's approach to the Muslim interpretative tradition found in part IV of his book, Quranic Studies. A common objection arises to Wansbrough's insistence on having textual evidence for historical claims and his seeing those texts which do provide historical evidence as complex expressions of several generations of editors. Two works, one an article by Issa Boullata and the other, a book by C.H.M. Versteegh, will be dealt with in some detail in this paper in order to clarify the issues which are at stake.

The Behavior of Noon Sakinah and Nunation in Quranic Recitation: An Optimality Account
abstract: “Natural classes” refer to the set of sound patterns that go together in phonological processes. This paper provides an analysis of the phonological behavior of noon sakinah and nunation /n/ in Quranic recitation based on natural class generalization within the framework of Optimality Theory (OT). In some instances, the OT account may be accurate than traditional analysis. It provides evidence that natural classes derive from the nature of the set of markedness constraints, and that gutturals must constitute a natural class. The principal source of evidence for these proposals is that gutturals, unlike other places of articulation, do not induce nasal assimilation.

title: Beyond the Cairo Edition
journal: Journal of the American Oriental Society
abstract: This essay reviews two recent volumes containing editions of important early quranic codices. One of these is the so-called Sanaa Palimpsest, whose lower text at present remains our only known material witness to a recension of the quranic text that is different from the canonical one; the other is the Codex Amrensis. The essay devotes particular attention to the question of the textual relationship between the Quran’s standard text and that documented by the lower layer of the Sanaa Palimpsest, and to Asma Hilali’s claim that the Sanaa Palimpsest never constituted a full quranic codex but only “a collection of disparate leaves.”

abstract: This paper focuses on the wisdom of Banjar culture, namely pamali. title: The Digraph اى in the Quranic Consonantal Text and the Identification of a New Letter Shape for Final Hē in the 7th to 8th Century Arabic Script
abstract: This paper proposes a hitherto unrecognized orthographic practice in the Quranic consonantal text: use of the digraph اى ,that is, alif + denticle, to represent the noninitial glottal stop, most often adjacent to the high vowels i/ī and less commonly in other environments. This feature leads to the identification of a new letter shape for the final hē in the early Islamic Arabic hand, originating in the Nabataeo-Arabic script, which in turn can explain a number of previously enigmatic spellings in the Quranic consonantal text.

The Bible and Quran similarly encourage their followers to build harmonious relations with the natural world.

title: Notes on the Functions of the L-Stem (Stem III) in Quranic Arabic
journal: Journal of the American Oriental Society
abstract: In this article it is argued that the L-stem (stem III) in Quranic Arabic is a pluractional derivation of the G-stem (stem I) and that it expresses distributive participant plurality. With direct objects that refer to a plurality of nonvolitional entities, the verb form describes a plurality of situations conceptualized distributively among the objects. With direct objects that refer to volitional participants, the situations are typically conceptualized as inversely distributed between the subject participant and the object participant. When the verb form is used antipassively, the object participant is syntactically omitted but semantically implied.

abstract: This article examines the Qur'anic verses about the environment and the Islamic legal understanding of it (fiqh al-bī’ah) in the view of the ulama of Lombok. abstract: This article expresses how the Qur’an responds to the reality of cultural society by examining the multiculturalism aspects within the revelations. This study applied a thematic interpretation method through four steps: a description of the themes, data compilation, data organization, and data analysis. The compiled data were the verses of the Qur’an, asbāb al-nuzul and hadiths related to the theme. abstract: The main guidelines for Muslims in living life are the Qur'an and Hadith. Therefore, Islamic teachings contained in the Qur'an and Hadith must be taught from an early age. The research method used is a qualitative method with a descriptive approach. abstract: Technological advances that continue to develop make information accessible and consumed by the public quickly through social media. However, the impact of the use of social media needs to be considered by various groups of people, including Muslims. This study aimed to explore the value of Islamic teachings from the Quran and Hadith, which can be used as the ethics of da’wa on social media. abstract: The differences in qira'at al-Qur'an have become a primary object of debate if they are not understood thoroughly. Sourced from the Prophet, Muhammad then narrated by the companions to the tabi'in and continued to the Muslims from generation to generation. authors: Nur Robaniyah, Wahdatun Nusrah, May Lita Wardiya Ningsih

abstract: This scientific article discusses the analysis of human characteristics in the Qur'an through a comparative study between two interpretations of Al-Mishbah and Ibn Kathir. title: A Quranic Concept with Universal Appeal: The Innate Monotheistic Disposition (Fitra)
abstract: The aim of this article is to present some of the main issues relating to fitra -a term generally understood as designating an innate monotheistic disposition in humans - in the Qur’an alone, without any subsequent exegetical or traditional contribution1. On the other hand, it gives pride of place to the intertextual approach, which allows us to situate this notion in a thematic line going back to Ancient Greece, and which gave rise to theories developed in various monotheistic circles of Late Antiquity, particularly Jewish, Judeo-Christian and Christian.

abstract: The research concluded with a satisfactory and sufficient definition of sin in language, idiomatically and in application of the linguistic and terminological differences of this concept. Then the research stopped at the Glorious Qur’an to stand on the proofs of the concept of sin in it, and tackled the study of the specific topic of research, which is Surat Al-Tawbah (Innocence). abstract: This study investigates the significance of using word-by-word translations of the Qur’an to enhance Arabic language learning and expand students’ vocabulary.
