title: Fenomena laki-laki Gen Z takut menikah akibat standarisasi finansial tinggi oleh calon wanita (Analisis Tafsir Q.S An -Nur ayat 32)
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: The phenomenon of reluctance or fear of marriage (marriage phobia) among Generation Z men in Indonesia is increasingly on the rise. One of the main determining factors is psychological pressure due to the high financial standards set by prospective female partners or their families. This often clashes with the economic reality of Gen Z, who are at the early stages of their careers, causing anxiety about their inability to meet material expectations. This study uses a qualitative method with a library research approach. Analysis was conducted using interpretative and thematic methods on Q.S. An-Nur verse 32 as an analytical tool to address the issue of financial anxiety. Data were collected f…

title: Metode Tafsir An-Nasafī dalam Penafsiran Ayat-Ayat Syariat dan Akhlak Serta Sikapnya Terhadap Riwayat Isrā’īliyyāt
authors: Aina Lestari Okika Sinaga, Muhammad Rusdi
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the exegetical method of Imam An-Nasafī in interpreting Qur’anic verses related to sharīʿah and ethics (akhlāq), as well as to examine his stance toward Isrā’īliyyāt narrations in the work Madārik al-Tanzīl wa Ḥaqā’iq al-Ta’wīl. The research employs a qualitative approach with a library research design. Primary data are derived from An-Nasafī’s tafsīr, while secondary data consist of classical and contemporary tafsīr books, academic journals, and relevant previous studies. Data were collected through documentation techniques, and analysis was conducted using content analysis and descriptive-analytical methods to identify the characteristics of An-Nasafī’s interpret…

title: Konsep Nafkah dalam Tafsîr Asy-Sya’rawî
authors: Sadad Robith Adani, Ibnu NB At-Thoriq, Akhmadiyah Saputra
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study examines the concept of nafāqah (living) in the interpretation of Sheikh Muhammad Mutawalli Asy-Sya’rawi through the thematic interpretation approach of figures (tafsīr maudhu‘ī al-shakhṣī). This study focuses on the verses of the Qur’an related to financial responsibility in the family, especially QS. An-Nisa’ : ​​34 and QS. At-Talaq : 6-7. Using qualitative library research methods, data were collected from the book Tafsir Khawatir Ash-Sya’rawi Haul Al-Qur’an Al-Karim and analyzed through thematic content analysis. The results of the study show that Asy-Sya’rawi interprets living not only as a legal obligation but as a comprehensive responsibility that includes social, moral, an…

title: Studi Tafsir Tematik Tentang Penciptaan Manusia Dalam Tafsir Al-Munir Karya Wahbah Az-Zuhaili
authors: Muhammad Muhyiddin Ahsan Sumarsono, Muhammad Amrulloh, Indri Astuti
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study examines the process and purpose of human creation in the Qur’an based on Tafsir Al-Munir by Wahbah Az-Zuhaili. The focus of the study is directed at the characteristics of Az-Zuhaili’s interpretation, the stages of human creation, and the objectives of human creation, which include worship (‘ibādah), vicegerency (khalīfah), and trust (amānah). This research employs a qualitative method with a thematic (maudhu‘i) tafsir approach by analyzing Qur’anic verses related to human creation, particularly QS. Al-Mu’minun [23]: 12–16 and QS. Al-Insan [76]: 2, with Tafsir Al-Munir as the primary source. The findings indicate that Wahbah Az-Zuhaili interprets the verses of human creation in a…

title: Penafsiran Fenomena Flexing Dalam AL-Qur’an
authors: Amir Jihad, Arif Firdausi Nur Romadlon, Edy Wirastho
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study aims to analyze and compare the interpretations of Qur’anic verses related to the phenomenon of flexing, namely ostentatious behavior motivated by the desire to gain praise and recognition from others, as discussed in Tafsir al-Misbah by M. Quraish Shihab and Tafsir al-Maraghi by Ahmad Musthafa al-Maraghi. This research employs a qualitative approach using a library research method. The research data consist of selected Qur’anic verses containing moral values and messages related to ostentation, riya’, ujub, and arrogance, which were selected selectively based on the mapping of relevant verses in Mu‘jam al-Alam wa al-Maudhu‘at fi al-Qur’an al-Karim. Data were collected through doc…

title: Kajian Kritis Al-Dakhil Dari Jalur Tafsir Bathiniyah
authors: Rolan Nasution, Zubaidah Nasution, Mina Sari Siregar, Hary Sahputra
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study examines the challenge of ad-dakhil (foreign elements) in Qur’anic interpretation, particularly through the Baṭhiniyah interpretive approach, which prioritizes inner meanings while neglecting the apparent (ẓāhir) meaning and established exegetical methodologies. Such interpretations are considered to have the potential to distort Qur’anic meanings and undermine the normative foundations of Islamic law. The study aims to critically analyze the concept of ad-dakhil within Baṭhiniyah exegesis and identify its methodological deviations, as well as scholarly perspectives on its legitimacy in Qur’anic studies. Employing library research with a qualitative-descriptive and analytical-crit…

title: Tafsir dan Hadis Zakat: Analisis Normatif dan Relevansi Terhadap Keadilan Sosial-Ekonomi
authors: Widya Purnama Sari, Nurhayati, Yenni Samri Juliati Nasution
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: Zakat is a pillar of Islam that has both worship and socio-economic dimensions. This article discusses the basics of zakat through a study of verses from the Qur'an and the hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), accompanied by an analysis of classical and contemporary scholars of tafsir and hadith commentary. The research uses a literature study method with a focus on the tafsir of Ibn Kathir, al-Qurtubi, and Quraish Shihab, as well as authentic hadiths from Sahih Bukhari and Muslim. The results show that zakat is an instrument for wealth distribution that aims to create social justice, improve the welfare of the people, and strengthen social solidarity. This study also emphasiz…

title: Munasabah Akhlak Surah Al-Isra' Ayat 23-25 Terhadap Moral Islam dalam Kitab Tafsir Kontemporer
authors: Fauziah Nur Ariza, Nida Holita Nasution, Rafiah Dian Safitri, Risyda Luthfiyah, Abdul Rafi Alrasyid, Syafiq Hamdi Ahmad Lubis
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This research aims to examine the relationship (munasabah) between the moral verses in Surah Al-Isra', verses 23-25, and the Islamic moral values ​​reflected therein. The study was carried out using a contextual analysis approach by tracing the meaning and relationships between verses, in order to find moral messages that are thematically connected. Surah Al-Isra' presents the concept of morals which includes human relationships with Allah, with each other, and with oneself. The results of the analysis show that the arrangement of the verses in this surah is not random, but has a regular meaning that strengthens moral values ​​such as justice, responsibility, politeness and social concern. B…

title: Konsep Ukhuwah Islamiyah Dalam Al-Qur’an Studi Analisis Kompratif Tafsir Ibnu Kasir dan Tafsir Al-Misbah QS. Al-Hujurat Ayat 10
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: The establishment of ukhuwah is not only a normative text but must be applied in life, seeing the fact now that Muslims are stagnant due to the fading sense of brotherhood, it arises because of the frequent differences among Muslims that trigger divisions, the Qur'an has underlined that difference is the law that applies in this life, In addition to the difference is a divine will also for the sake of survival , at the same time in order to achieve the goal of life of beings on the stage of the earth. To establish ukhuwah Islamiah needed is not just an explanation of aspects of equality in religious views or just tolerance concerning differences of views. More important, however, are the joi…

title: Relevansi Kebijakan Fiskal Syariah dalam Mendorong Stabilitas Ekonomi Umat: Kajian Tafsir Tematik Ayat dan Hadis Berbasis Pendekatan Kontemporer
authors: Febi Alicia, Nurhayati, Yenni Samri Juliati Nasution
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the relevance of sharia fiscal policy to the economic stability of the Muslim community through a thematic interpretation of verses and hadiths and a contextual analysis of modern fiscal policy. The study employed qualitative methods, examining literature selected based on criteria such as academic credibility, publisher reputation, publication recency, and relevance to sharia fiscal issues. The analysis was conducted through thematic coding of key issues such as zakat distribution, the role of sukuk in macroeconomic stabilization, and strengthening ZISWAF regulations. The results indicate that sharia fiscal instruments such as zakat, infaq, sadaqah, waqf, and suku…

title: Green Sukuk dalam Perspektif Tafsir Tematik: Implementasi Prinsip Lā Tufsidu fil Arḍ dalam Ekonomi Syariah Kontemporer
authors: Nabila Aulia Putri Hrp, Nurhayati, Yenni Samri Juliati Nasution
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study examines the relevance of the principle of lā tufsidu fil ardḍ in the Qur'an to the development of green sukuk as a sustainable Islamic financial instrument. Using a maudhu'i tafsir approach and qualitative-descriptive analysis, this study finds that the prohibition of earth destruction and the mandate of the caliphate serve as the theological basis for green financial practices in Islam. Green sukuk has been proven to support the financing of environmentally friendly projects such as renewable energy, forest conservation, and public transportation and has the potential to be strengthened through the integration of digital technology. This study emphasizes the novelty of combining…

title: Konsep Israf dan Keseimbangan Konsumsi dalam QS. Al-A’raf Ayat 31: Tinjauan Tafsir dan Ekonomi Islam
authors: Luthfiah Al Asbin Ulyani, Nurhayati, Yenni Samri Juliati Nasution
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the concept of israf (extravagance) and consumption balance as stated in Surah Al-A’raf verse 31 through a comparative interpretation of classical and contemporary exegeses, and to integrate these insights with Islamic economic principles. This research employs a library-based qualitative method by examining Qur’anic texts, tafsir literature, and recent academic studies related to Islamic consumption ethics. The findings indicate that the verse highlights three essential principles: the command to adorn oneself properly when attending the mosque, the permissibility of eating and drinking within reasonable limits, and the firm prohibition of extravagance due to its …

title: Konsep Islam Rahmatān Lil ‘Alamīn Dalam Al-Qur’an (Perspektif Tafsir Kontekstual Abdullah Saeed)
authors: Nahwa Faadlil Basya, Muhammad Irfan Riyadi
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This research is motivated by the rise of violence committed in the name of religion, both in the real world and online. Such violence is driven by a misinterpretation of Qur'anic texts and certain ideologies that reject diversity. The main focus of this study is to explore the meaning and contextualization of the values of Islam rahmataān lil ‘alamīn as found in the Qur’an, using Abdullah Saeed’s contextual interpretation approach. This research employs a qualitative library-based method with descriptive and deductive analysis. The findings reveal that Islam rahmataān lil ‘alamīn encompasses values of compassion, justice, brotherhood, and noble character. The contextualization of these valu…

title: Pendekatan Hermeneutika Kontekstual Dalam Tafsir Al-Qur’an
authors: Tomi Satria, Duski Samad, Firdaus ST Mamad
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: The development of modern Qur’anic studies presents methodological challenges to the authority and interpretation of the Qur’an, thus requiring a scientific approach capable of integrating historical dimensions with contemporary contexts in a balanced manner. This research aims to analyze the concept of hermeneutics within Qur’anic studies and to examine its applicability through a contextual approach while maintaining the principles of Islamic epistemology. The study employs a library research method with a descriptive-analytical qualitative approach, involving a comparative analysis of the ideas of leading Qur’anic hermeneutic scholars such as Fazlur Rahman and Abdullah Saeed through prima…

title: Fiqh al-Lughah dalam Tafsir dan Ulum al-Hadits: Perannya dalam Pemahaman Makna Teks Keagamaan
journal: AL-MIKRAJ Jurnal Studi Islam dan Humaniora (E-ISSN 2745-4584)
abstract: This study explores the interrelation between Fiqh al-Lughah (the jurisprudence of language), Qur’anic exegesis (tafsir), and the sciences of hadith (‘Ulum al-Hadith) as three complementary disciplines in understanding Islamic religious texts. Using a qualitative library research approach, this research examines the works of M. Quraish Shihab (Tafsir al-Mishbah) and Shaykh Muhammad bin Salih al-‘Uthaymeen (Sharh Arba’in Nawawiyyah) to demonstrate how linguistic approaches are employed in the interpretation of the Qur’an and hadith. The findings reveal that Fiqh al-Lughah plays a crucial methodological role in uncovering the meanings of sacred texts through deep analysis of lafzh (lexical for…

title: Tafsir Imamat 10:1-7: Studi Eksegetis atas Konsep Kekudusan Radikal Allah dalam Peristiwa Api Asing
authors: Deventi Krislia Panggalo, Corina Tangdiombo, Rosalinda Samba’ Langi’, Mikael Randa Karaeng, Yulita Kombong
abstract: This study examines the concept of God’s holiness in Leviticus 10:1–7 through an exegetical approach to the event of the “strange fire” offered by Nadab and Abihu. The background of this research lies in the need to rediscover the true meaning of God’s holiness, which is often misunderstood in contemporary worship practices. The purpose of this study is to explore the theological meaning of the passage and its implications for faith and worship. The research uses a qualitative method based on literature study, focusing on historical, literary, and thematic analysis of the biblical text. The findings reveal that God’s holiness in this passage is absolute and cannot be violated without serious…

title: Dekonstruksi dan Rekonstruksi Tafsir-Hadis Kontemporer: Analisis Konseptual atas Kritik Sanad-Matan, Hermeneutika Hadis, dan Dekolonisasi Studi Islam
journal: Tanwiruna: Jurnal Pendidikan dan Sosial Keagamaan
abstract: Artikel ini bertujuan menganalisis dekonstruksi dan rekonstruksi tafsir-hadis kontemporer melalui empat medan kajian utama, yaitu kritik sanad dan matan modern, hermeneutika hadis, dekolonisasi studi Islam, dan rekonstruksi metodologi pemahaman teks. Kajian ini berangkat dari asumsi bahwa pendekatan klasik yang selama ini dominan dalam studi tafsir dan hadis perlu dibaca ulang secara kritis agar tetap relevan dengan dinamika intelektual kontemporer. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif berbasis studi kepustakaan dengan analisis deskriptif-kritis terhadap literatur klasik dan kontemporer yang berkaitan dengan epistemologi tafsir dan hadis. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa kritik san…

title: The Dimensions of Ḍarriyyāt, Ḥājiyyāt, and Taḥsīniyyāt in the Protection of Intellect: A Qur’anic Perspective and Its Implications for Tafsir Tarbawi Learning
authors: Radhiatul Hasnah, Nurfadhilah Nurfadhilah, Azhariah Fatia
abstract: The protection and fulfillment of intellectual needs are part of maqaṣid al-shari’ah, which encompasses three levels of importance: dharuri, hajji, and tahsini. This article aims to examine how this concept, from the perspective of the Qur’an, is implemented in the teaching of Tafsir Tarbawi at the Faculty of Tarbiyah. Using a qualitative approach and descriptive-analytical methods, this study combines a literature review of Qur'anic verses related to reason with observations of the curriculum and teaching practices of Tafsir Tarbawi in several PTKIN Tarbiyah Faculties. The results of the study show that the protection of reason in a dharuri manner includes the prohibition of intoxicants, in…

title: Kesadaran Ekologi dalam Perspektif Al-Qur’an: Kajian Tafsir Maudhū‘ī
journal: Tafshil: Journal of Quran and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This article explores ecological awareness in the Qur’anic perspective through the thematic interpretation (tafsīr maudhū‘ī) method. The global environmental crisissuch as climate change, pollution, and deforestation has become a serious threat to human sustainability. The Qur’an, as a divine guidance, provides normative principles regarding the human-nature relationship, particularly in the context of human responsibility as khalīfah fi al-ardh. This study collects several relevant verses, including QS. al-Baqarah: 30, QS. al-Rūm: 41, QS. al-A‘rāf: 56, QS. al-An‘ām: 141, and QS. al-Isrā’: 27. The analysis reveals that Qur’anic ecological awareness encompasses four main principles: the respo…

title: Konsep Ḥafīẓ dan ʿAlīm dalam Pendidikan Ekonomi: Tafsir Tahlili Kisah Nabi Yusuf
journal: Tafshil: Journal of Quran and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This article examines the concept of economic education in the Qur’an through a tafsir tahlili analysis of Surah Yusuf verse 55. The verse highlights Prophet Yusuf’s self-nomination as the treasurer of Egypt, emphasizing two key qualities: ḥafīẓ (trustworthy, possessing integrity) and ʿalīm (knowledgeable, competent). Using Tafsir al-Manar as the primary source, alongside classical and contemporary exegetical works, this study demonstrates that Qur’anic economic education prioritizes the integration of moral character and professional competence. The attribute of ḥafīẓ underlines honesty, integrity, and social responsibility, while ʿalīm stresses expertise, skills, and managerial capability.…

title: Korelasi Kapasitas Otak dan Arus Informasi Cepat: Analisis Tafsir Tahlili Surah Al-Mujadalah Ayat 11
journal: Tafshil: Journal of Quran and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This study aims to examine the rapid and massive flow of information in the digital age, but the human brain's capacity to absorb and process information has limits that cannot be ignored. This phenomenon causes cognitive fatigue, disorientation in thinking, and a decline in the quality of understanding. Surah Al-Mujadalah verse 11 provides a Qur'anic perspective that emphasizes the importance of knowledge, manners in learning, and the elevation of the status of knowledgeable people. The tafsir tahlili approach was used to comprehensively examine the meaning of the verse, while descriptive qualitative analysis was used to relate the meaning of the verse to contemporary reality. The results o…

title: Relasi Timbal Balik Orang Tua dan Anak Serta Relevansinya terhadap Krisis Moral Remaja Perspektif QS. AL-ISRĀ’ Ayat 24
journal: Tafshil: Journal of Quran and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This study explores the reciprocal relationship between parents and children and its relevance to the moral crisis among adolescents, based on QS. Al-Isrā’ verse 24. The increasing cases of domestic violence and the lack of parental role models indicate serious problems in parenting patterns that significantly affect the moral development of young generations. This research employs a qualitative library-based approach using the method of tafsīr muqāran (comparative exegesis), by analyzing classical and contemporary interpretations to uncover the verse’s meaning. The findings reveal that QS. Al-Isrā’ verse 24 emphasizes a two-way relationship: parents are obliged to nurture, educate, and prov…

title: Kesenjangan Literasi Al-Qur’an dan Tutur Kata Santriwati Gen-Z: Perspektif QS al-Jumu‘ah Ayat 5
journal: Tafshil: Journal of Quran and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This study examines the gap between Qur’anic literacy and verbal behavior among Gen-Z female students in a pesantren in Pati, Central Java, using QS al-Jumu‘ah verse 5 as a conceptual basis. Observations reveal that although the students have strong reading and memorization skills, some still use slang or harsh expressions such as “anjir”, “anjay”, and “tolol” in daily interactions. This indicates a misalignment between Qur’anic knowledge and internalization of ethical values. The study employs the tafsir tahlili method to analyze the verse, key vocabulary, and context, alongside qualitative descriptive analysis linking the text to contemporary student behavior. Findings highlight that unpra…

title: Bridging Salafi Tafsir and Modern Science: A Study of the Interaction of Religion and Science
authors: Deden Juansa Putra, Aminudin Shuib, Nurul Aulia, Farhan Suhada, Mufti Zevira
journal: Jurnal Ilmu Agama: Mengkaji Doktrin, Pemikiran, dan Fenomena Agama
abstract: This article aims to examine the interaction between the Salafi approach to religious interpretation and the development of modern science, focusing on their responses to the theory of evolution, cosmology, and other scientific phenomena. This study is motivated by the Salafi approach, which is known for its effort to preserve the purity of Islamic teachings through a literal understanding of the Qur'an and hadith. Using a qualitative method with an in-depth literature study of Salafi scholars’ writings, exegetical works, and academic sources, the data are analyzed through a thematic approach to understand the interaction with and responses to science within the Salafi doctrinal framework. T…

title: The Influence of Qur’anic Recitation on the Growth Process of Basil Plants: A Scientific Tafsir Analysis
authors: Sofiana Syajarotin Toyyibah, Abdul Fatah, Muhammad Masruri
journal: Jurnal Ilmu Agama: Mengkaji Doktrin, Pemikiran, dan Fenomena Agama
abstract: This article aims to explain and analyze the relationship between the recitation of Qur’anic verses and the physiological response of basil plants. Using an exploratory research type, this article examines the possibility of the influence of Qur’anic recitation on living beings other than humans, while also formulating a Qur’anic concept regarding this phenomenon within the framework of scientific interpretation (tafsir sains). The method used in this research is an experimental method by comparing two basil plant objects, namely one plant that is exposed to the recitation of the Qur’an and another plant that is not exposed to such recitation. The research process was carried out for 15 days…

title: Dialogical Communication in the Qur’an: A Thematic-Hermeneutic Study of Hiwār Verses in Tafsir al-Mishbah
authors: Muhammad Fauzal Ahdaa, Muhammad Syahrial Razali Ibrahim, Zaki Faddad Syarif Zain
journal: Jurnal Ilmu Agama: Mengkaji Doktrin, Pemikiran, dan Fenomena Agama
abstract: This study aims to examine the concept of hiwār (dialogue) in the Qur’an through the perspective of Tafsir al-Mishbah by M. Quraish Shihab. The main issue addressed is the decline of communication ethics in the modern era and how the principles of Qur’anic dialogue can serve as a reference for building harmonious communication. Using a thematic-hermeneutic approach, this study seeks to describe the forms, principles, and functions of hiwār based on verses containing dialogue, such as those in QS. al-Kahfi, al-Mujadalah, Ali Imran, Ghafir, al-Hajj, and al-Syura. The method employed is a descriptive-analytical qualitative approach through direct analysis of Tafsir al-Mishbah and other supporti…

title: Tafsir and Politics in Indonesia During the New Order Era: The Dialectic of Religious Texts and Power in an Authoritarian Regime
authors: Aldi Rifki Maulana, Ramadhan Safrudin, Edi Komarudin, Jajang A Rohmana, Tarek Yalouli
journal: Jurnal Ilmu Agama: Mengkaji Doktrin, Pemikiran, dan Fenomena Agama
abstract: This study aims to examine the dialectical relationship between Qur’anic exegesis and political authority during the New Order era in Indonesia. Studies on Qur’anic exegesis in Indonesia have largely highlighted the influence of the socio-political context on the interpretive process. However, systematic studies that map the diverse responses of exegetical works to political power within a specific authoritarian regime remain relatively limited. Using a qualitative library research method with a descriptive-analytical approach, the study analyzes three representative Indonesian commentaries: Al-Qur’an dan Tafsirnya, published by the Ministry of Religious Affairs, Al-Huda by Bakri Syahid, and…

title: Exploring Managerial Activation Based on al-Qur’an Insights from Hamka’s Tafsir al-Azhar
abstract: This study explores managerial activation within organizational contexts through the Qur’an, elucidating insights derived from Hamka’s Tafsir Al‑Azhar to conceptualize an Islamic framework for value-driven leadership. Although contemporary management research emphasizes efficiency and performance metrics, few studies integrate Qur’anic principles emphasizing collective moral action as a catalyst for organizational motivation and mobilization. Employing a qualitative, literature-based methodology, this research analyzes primary sources and supplementary secondary literature on Islamic management theory. Data collection involved systematic textual examination of selected Qur’anic verses interp…

title: Digitalisasi Pembelajaran Tafsir Al-Qur’an Dalam Meningkatkan Kualitas Pendidikan Agama Islam
authors: Hasan Nurdin, Habibah Siti Masruuroh, Zaid Muhammad Firdan
journal: Indonesian Journal of Islamic Education Studies (INJURIES)
abstract: This study aims to examine the use of digital technology in Qur’anic exegesis (tafsir) learning within Islamic Religious Education and its implications for improving learning quality. The research employs a qualitative approach using a library research method, which relies on various written sources as primary data, including books, scholarly journals, and relevant academic documents. Data collection was conducted through a systematic review of the literature by considering relevance, source credibility, and the recency of publications within the last five years. Data were analyzed using content analysis techniques to identify patterns, themes, and meanings from the reviewed literature. The …

title: Tradisi Penafsiran Pesantren Jawa Terhadap QS. Al-Anbiya’ [21]: 112: Kajian Komparatif Tafsir Al-Ibriz
abstract: This study focuses on the use of language, script, presentation format, and the contextuality of interpretation that reflects the intellectual tradition of Javanese pesantren. The research aims to analyze the tradition of Javanese pesantren interpretation of QS. Al-Anbiyā’ [21]: 112 in Tafsir Al-Ibrīz. The study uses library research methods with a qualitative-descriptive approach. Primary data was obtained from Tafsir Al-Ibriz by K.H. Bisri Mustofa, while secondary data came from books, journals, and research related to Nusantara interpretation and the Javanese pesantren tafsir tradition. Data analysis was conducted qualitatively with stages of data reduction, data presentation, and conclus…

title: استدلال الإمام الشافعي بالسياق في تفسيره آيات الأحكام-دراسة تطبيقية تحليلية / Imam Al-Shafi’i’s Argumentation based on the context in his Tafsir “interpretation” of the verses of rules Applied Analytical Study
abstract: عنوان البحث: استدلالُ الإمام الشافعي بالسياقِ في تفسيره آيات الأحكام-دراسة استقرائية تحليلية تطبيقية. تم في البحث -بعون الله-: ذكر تعريف السياق، وبيان أهميّته وحُكمه، وذِكرُ أمثلةٍ عليه، وأنه قد اهتم به المفسرون قديمًا وحديثًا. ولقد حاولتُ في هذا البحث: إبراز شيءٍ من أهميّة دلالةِ السياق، وأثرها في الاستنباط الصحيح من النصوص الشرعية، وكذا الكشف عن موقف الإمام الشافعي من دلالة السياق، واستثمارها في المناظرات العلمية والمحاورات الفقهية، وذلك من خلال كتبه المنسوبة إليه -رحمه الله-. وقد خلص البحث في نهايته إلى نتائج كان من أبرزها: 1- مكانة الإمام الشافعي -رحمه الله- العلمية؛ حيث إنه من الأئمة المجتهدين في علم الفقه وأصوله، وهو أيضًا من الأئمة المحتج بهم في اللغة والبيان العربي. 2- للسياق أهميةٌ …

title: Makna Dzikr dan Nisyan Dalam al-Qur’an: Intregasi Tafsir dengan Ilmu Kognitif Modern
journal: Es-Syajar:Journal of Islam, Science and Technology Integration
abstract: This study discusses the meaning of dzikr (remembrance) and nisyan (forgetting) in the Qur'an by relating them to the concept of memory in modern cognitive science. This study shows that the Qur'an not only emphasizes spiritual aspects but also pays attention to the psychological mechanisms and cognitive processes that influence how humans remember and forget various life experiences. This study uses a library research approach by examining classical interpretations, cognitive psychology literature, and other scientific sources to find consistent and complementary relationships between the two. Dzikr is understood as a spiritual activity that aims to strengthen human awareness, focus, and re…

title: Analisis systematic literature review Tafsir Tarbawi: implementasi Tafsir Tarbawi pada pendidikan Islam
authors: Alwizar Alwizar, Syafaruddin Syafaruddin, Nurhasnawati Nurhasnawati, Darmawati Darmawati, M. Fahli Zatrahadi, Hakmi Wahyudi
abstract: In addition to the ever-changing conditions, Islamic education faces increasingly complex obstacles. The digital era shows that the implementation of tarbawi interpretation in Islamic education can provide great benefits to students and society. The purpose of this study is to analyze the implementation of tarbawi interpretation in Islamic education in 2021. The research method used is a systematic literature review. Data from the scopus database is considered primary data, while data from the dimensions database is considered secondary data. The data obtained were 110 in the Scopus database and 8 documents in Dimensions. In the analysis, however, only 20 documents were included in the crite…

title: PILIHAN DAN KEDAULATAN ALLAH: KAJIAN TAFSIR PREDESTINASI KARL BARTH DAN JOHN CALVIN DALAM ROMA 9: 1-29
authors: Robin A. Simanjuntak, Erna Triratna Gulo
journal: THEOSOPHIA: Jurnal Teologi dan Pendidikan Kristiani
abstract: Abstract In Romans 9: 1-29, The apostle Paul shows God’s comprehensive purpose in history, through His sovereignty in salvation. Through this comprehensive purpose, both all things that related to evil will be punished and all things related to justification by faith will be saved. This article wants to show God as a derivation (Greek: ‘drawing out’) of man and not man as a derivation of God so that God has purpose from His election of man. This study emphasized Paul’s theology from John Calvin’s perspective with the neo orthodox perspective of Karl Barth, through his principle of continuity that allows potential salvation for all humans, through Christ. This article will discuss who is mean…

title: Digitalisasi Keuangan Berbasis Pemberdayaan Santri di Pondok Pesantren Darut Tafsir Kabupaten Lebak Sebagai Upaya Mendorong Pertumbuhan Ekonomi Berkelanjutan
authors: Nugroho Heri Pramono, Jamaludin, Suripto, Mega Kusuma Citra, Eka Fitriani, Saddam Rasyidin Alfaruk
abstract: Program Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat ini bertujuan memperkuat kapasitas manajerial, literasi keuangan digital, dan kemandirian ekonomi santri melalui digitalisasi sistem keuangan unit usaha Darut Tafsir Mart di Pondok Pesantren Darut Tafsir, Kabupaten Lebak. Kegiatan dilaksanakan September–November 2025 melalui lima tahapan utama: sosialisasi, pelatihan manajemen dan digitalisasi keuangan, pelatihan pemasaran digital, penerapan teknologi, serta pendampingan dan evaluasi. Teknologi yang diimplementasikan berupa kombinasi hard technology (freezer, vacuum sealer, etalase) dan soft technology (aplikasi Santriqu.id untuk pencatatan keuangan dan manajemen stok). Hasil menunjukkan peningkatan kemam…

title: THE MEANING OF HAWĀ IN THE QUR'AN PERSPECTIVE OF TAFSIR FI ZHILALIL QUR'AN BY SAYYID QUTHB AND ITS RELEVANCE TO ADULTERY
authors: Saidatun Nisa, Zainal Arifin, Harun Al Rasyid
journal: SOSIOEDUKASI : JURNAL ILMIAH ILMU PENDIDIKAN DAN SOSIAL
abstract: This study examines the meaning of the word al-hawā in the Qur'an, the perspective of Tafsir Fi Zhilalil Qur'an by Sayyid Quthb and its relevance to Adultery. The phrase al-hawā is one of the important terms in the Qur'an that has various meanings and moral implications in human life. In the Qur'an, al-hawā is not only understood as a desire or impulse of the soul, but also as an inner tendency that if not controlled can drag people to moral deviations, including adultery. This study aims to analyze Sayyid Quthb's interpretation of the pronunciation of al-hawā, understand its implications on human behavior, and explain its relevance to the phenomenon of Adultery in the moral and spiritual pe…

title: قصة مؤمن سورة يس تفسير، ولطائف، وأحكام / The story of a believer of Surat Yassin tafsir (Interpretation), gueses, rulings
abstract: يتناول البحث: قصة مؤمن سورة يس، (تفسير، ولطائف، وأحكام). وتناول في المبحث الأول: التعريف بمؤمن سورة يس، والتعريف بالسورة، وتناول في المبحث الثاني: البيان التحليلي لآيات القصة؛ بذكر مناسبة الآيات لما قبلها، ومعاني المفردات الغريبة فيها، والقراءات الواردة، والأوجه البلاغية في القصة، ثم بيان المعنى العام للآيات في المبحث الثالث، في حين تناول المبحث الرابع: اللطائف والأحكام المستنبطة من القصة. وقد سار منهج الدراسة: على الدراسة الاستقرائية والتحليلية والاستنباطية، ونوع الدراسة: نظرية مكتبية، وأهم النتائج: حرص الرسل والدعاة إلى الله تعالى على تقديم الخير والنصح لقومهم، من أساليب قبول دعوة الداعي: الترفع عن طلب الأجر الدنيوي، ومن معاني القصة العظيمة الثبات على الإيمان والتضحية بكل غالٍ في سبيله، من…

title: Freedom Of Religion In The View Of The Qur'an: A Comparative Classical-Contemporary Interpretation / KEBEBASAN BERAGAMA DALAM PANDANGAN AL-QUR’AN: KOMPARASI TAFSIR KLASIK-KONTEMPORER
authors: Afrizal Galela, Umi Sumbulah, Ruma Mubarak
journal: AL QUDS : Jurnal Studi Alquran dan Hadis
abstract: Religious freedom is a crucial issue that continues to evolve in an increasingly complex global world. This study presents an in-depth analysis of spiritual freedom in the Qur’an through a comparative approach between the interpretations of classical scholars and contemporary exegetes. This study departs from the central question: how is the Qur’an’s view of religious freedom interpreted by classical and modern exegetes, and to what extent do differences in socio-historical contexts influence these interpretations?. Through a comprehensive literature study, we explore how classical interpretations, often considered rigid, interact with more progressive contemporary interpretations, creating …

title: Analisis Lughawi dalam Tafsir Al-Munir Karya Wahbah Zuhaili (W. 2015 M) / Linguistic Analysis in Wahbah Zuhaili’s Tafsir Al-Munir on the Verses of Religious Moderation
authors: Eka Prasetiawati, Dian Risky Amalia, Muhammad Irsad
journal: AL QUDS : Jurnal Studi Alquran dan Hadis
abstract: Artikel ini mengkaji pendekatan lughawi (kebahasaan), khususnya analisis nahwu, dalam Tafsir al-Munir karya Wahbah Zuhaili terhadap ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an yang berkaitan dengan moderasi beragama. Fokus utama penelitian ini adalah bagaimana aspek linguistik, seperti i’rab, makna mufradat, balaghah, serta struktur sintaksis dan morfologis dimanfaatkan Zuhaili untuk membentuk narasi moderat dalam konteks keagamaan dan kebangsaan. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif berbasis studi pustaka dengan pendekatan deskriptif-analitis. Data primer bersumber dari Tafsir al-Munir, sementara data sekunder diperoleh dari karya-karya tafsir dan linguistik Arab lainnya. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa…

title: Internalisasi Nilai Pendidikan Akhlak dalam Surat Al-Hujurat Ayat 11-13 Menurut Tafsir fi Zilalil Qur'an
abstract: This study examines the implementation of moral education in QS. Al-Hujurat verses 11-13 in Sayyid Qutb's Tafsir Fi Zilalil Quran. The purpose of this research is to describe the messages and values ​​of moral education as contained in the letter Al-Hujurat verses 11-13. The benefits of this research are theoretically expected to provide a small contribution of thought or input that is useful for Islamic education, while practically this research is expected to provide a little contribution of thought, especially for researchers and readers in general in understanding the contents of the content or values ​​in the letter. Al-Hujurat verses 11-13. The data collection method in this thesis res…

title: Konsep Respon Krisis dalam Al-Qur’an: Analisis Tafsir Tematik dan Relevansinya terhadap Praktik Triase Medis
journal: JURNAL ILMIAH KESEHATAN MASYARAKAT DAN SOSIAL
abstract: This study aims to examine the concept of crisis response in the Qur'an and its relevance to medical triage practices in contemporary healthcare settings. The method used is a qualitative approach with thematic interpretation (maudhu’i) of Qur’anic verses related to saving lives, emergency conditions (darurah), justice, responsibility, and human limitations. The analysis focuses on how Qur’anic ethical principles can provide guidance in situations where medical resources are limited and difficult decisions must be made. The results show that the Qur'an offers an ethical framework that emphasizes the priority of saving human life, flexibility in emergencies, justice in decision-making, propor…

title: التوجيه النحوي للأدوات في تفسير مفاتيح الغيب: سورة يوسف إنموذجًا / Grammatical Direction of Particles in Tafsir Mafaateeh al-Ghaib: Surat Yusuf as a Model
authors: أحمد خلف صالح عليوي, مجلة ضياء الفكر للبحوث والدراسات
abstract: يهدف هذا البحث إلى دراسة الأدوات النحوية التي لها توجيه نحوي في تفسير مفاتيح الغيب للرازي (606ه) في سورة يوسف لما لهذا التوجيه من معاني ودلالات متعددة في سياق الآية الواحدة وكل توجيه لهذه الأدوات له تفسير معين عند المفسرين أو النحويين، وبهذا التوجيه يعين على تفسير الآيات القرآنية وفهم المقاصد الشرعية لها، فنجده يذكر أكثر من توجيه للأداة (ما) في قوله عز وجل: ﴿ما جزاءُ من أرادَ بأهلكَ سوءًا﴾، أَنْ تَكُونَ نَافِيَةً، أَيْ لَيْسَ جَزَاؤُهُ إِلَّا السِّجْنُ، وَيَجُوزُ أَيْضًا أَنْ تَكُونَ اسْتِفْهَامِيَّةً يَعْنِي أَيُّ شَيْءٍ جَزَاؤُهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يُسْجَنَ وغيرها من الآيات التي ذكر فيها توجيه للأدوات النحوية في هذه السورة.

title: Israiliyat Sebagai Unsur Dakhil dalam Tafsir Al Quran
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Abstrak Israiliyat merupakan istilah yang merujuk pada riwayat-riwayat yang berasal dari Ahl Kitab (Yahudi dan Nasrani), mencakup cerita, penjelasan, atau nasihat yang disampaikan melalui tradisi lisan maupun kitab suci mereka. Dalam kajian tafsir Islam, periwayatan Israiliyat mulai dikenal pada zaman sahabat dan tabiin. Namun, hal ini tidak terjadi pada masa Rasulullah karena Al-Qur'an menjadi pedoman utama umat Muslim, dan para sahabat senantiasa merujuk langsung kepada Nabi Muhammad untuk mendapatkan penjela…

title: Telaah Metodologis dan Kontribusi Intelektual Aisha Abd al Rahman Dalam Tafsir al Bayan li al Quran al Karim
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Bintu Syathi’ merupakan seorang intelektual Muslimah asal Mesir yang dikenal luas sebagai akademisi, sastrawan, dan mufassir. Karyanya yang berjudul Tafsir al-Bayan li al-Qur’an al-Karim menandai kontribusi penting perempuan dalam bidang tafsir Al-Qur’an. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji dan menganalisis karakteristik tafsir al-Bayan karya Bintu Syathi’, termasuk metode penafsirannya, latar belakang pemikiran penulis, serta kontribusinya dalam khazanah tafsir modern. Penelitian ini merupakan penelitian perpustakaan (library research), dengan menggunakan metode deskriptif analisis. title: Pendidikan Karakter Qur’ani(Analisis Struktural-Fungsional terhadap Sistem Pelembagaan Al-Qur’an di Rumah Tahfiz Al-Fatih Tasikmalaya)
authors: Tasya Putri Nurhayat Tasya Putri Nurhayat
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Rumah Tahfidz Al-Fatih menjadikan hafalan Al-Qur'an tidak hanya berfungsi sebagai bentuk ibadah tetapi juga sebagai mekanisme sosial yang memperkuat kehidupan sehari-hari santri dengan menekankan pengembangan disiplin dan nilai-nilai akhlak yang kuat. Padahal, di banyak lembaga tahfidz, masih sering ditemui permasalahan akhlak dan kedisiplinan santri. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengeksplorasi pelembagaan Al-Qur'an di Rumah Tahfidz Al-Fatih dengan pendekatan struktural-fungsional. Fokus penelitian adalah memahami bagaimana proses pelembagaan hafalan Al-Qur'an membentuk disiplin dan akhlak santri, serta bagaimana institusi ini berperan dalam mendukung pembentukan perilaku moral. Metode pen…

title: Makna Istawa dalam Al-Qur’an Kajian Semantik Qur’ani Perspektif Toshihiko Izutsu
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: The writing before the readers describes the interpretation of the term "istawa" in Q. S Taha [20]: 5 using the semantics of Toshihiko Izutsu. To this day, the language contained in the Quran is characterized by being mushtarak, meaning that one term can encompass multiple meanings. The research approach in this writing is based on descriptive analysis adopted through library research, which includes credible and accountable references such as books, articles, journals, and others. To obtain a detailed interpretation, the author first describes the biography and theories of Toshihiko Izutsu's semantics. In the end, readers will gain an understanding of the interpretation of the term "istawa"…

authors: Fahmi Akhyar Al Farabi, Burhan Djamaluddin
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Perkembangan penafsiran ayat-ayat dalam al-Qur’an menyebabkan munculnya banyak kajian yang dapat dibahas. Kajian-kajian tersebut, antara lain kajian tematik, semantik, sains dan lain sebagainya. Salah satu tema yang dapat dibahas dalam kajian tematik adalah korelasi konsep syukur. title: Impact Of a Different Qira’at on Scientific Interpretation: (Focused Analysis Imam Nafi' Al-Madani's Qira’a Through the Riwayah of Qolun)
authors: Abdul Qudus Al Faruq, Selena Chayka Salsabilla, Ah. Nasich Hidayatullah, Ulfatul Halimah
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Differences in the qira’at of the Qur'an have a significant impact on interpretation, including within the context of modern science. Imam Nafi' Al-Madani’s qira’at in the riwayah of Qolun is a form of recitation rich in linguistic and interpretive value. This study aims to examine how the Qolun riwayah can contribute to the scientific interpretation of the Qur’an, while also building a bridge between religious and modern sciences. The method used is library research with a descriptive qualitative approach, incorporating historical and critical analysis of classical scholars’ works and their relevance to contemporary scientific discourse. title: ULAMA’ DALAM AL-QUR’AN
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Selama ini terjadi penyempitan makna ulama menjadi terbatas pada orang-orang yang dianggap mengerti ilmu agama, bahkan pada tataran fiqih saja. Penyempitan makna ini membuat disparitas dan dikotomi antara pengetahuan duniawi dan agama hingga politik praktis menjadi semakin lebar. Artikel ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui makna ulama menurut Al-Quran dan para sarjana Islam. Tulisan ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode deskriptif. Data primer diambil dari ayat Al-Quran yang mengandung kata ulama dan dari pendapat para sarjana Islam terhadap tafsir ayat-ayat tersebut. Penelitian ini menemukan bahwa pemaknaan atas kata ulama tidak hanya dibatasi pada pengetahuan kognitif atas ilmu-il…

title: STUDI TAFSIR DI INDONESIA GENEOLOGI TAFSIR AL-IBRIZ KARYA KH. BISRI MUSTHOFA
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Tafsir al-Ibriz adalah karya KH. Bishri Musthofa. KH. Bishri Mustofa lahir di kampung Pesawahan, Rembang, Jawa Tengah pada tahun 1915 M dengan nama asli beliau adalah Mashadi. Setelah kepulangannya dari ibadah haji pada tahun 1923 M, barulah namanya berganti menjadi Bisri Mustofa. Bisri Mustofa lebih akrab dikenal dengan panggilan mbah Bisri. Ayah Bisri bernama Djaja Ratiban, namun setelah menunaikan haji namanya berganti menjadi H. Zaenal Mustofa.

title: Implementasi Qira'at Riwayat Qalun Dalam Al-Qur'an (Surat al-Baqarah 3-5)
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Artikel ini membahas mengenai implementasi qira'ah riwayat qalun dalam al-Qur'an(surat al-Baqarah 3-5). Qira'at merupakan salah satu cabang ilmu al-Qur'an mengenai tata cara membaca dalam al-Qur'an, qira'at cabang ilmu al-Qur'an yang masih sedikit sekali yang mempelajarnya, sehingga terdengar asing dari kalangan umat muslim sendiri atau masyarakat umum lainnya. Dalam penelitian ini menggunakan deskriptif analisis yang diperoleh melalui library research, Dengan sumber yang relevan dan realibel, seperti buku, jurnal, skirpsi, tesis, disertasi, dan sebagainya. title: Kisah Nabi Adam dalam Al-Qur'an
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Kisah tentang nabi Adam yang berasal dari tanah dan sebagai manusia pertama pernah dibandingkan atau disangkal dengan teori evolusi darwin. Dimana dalam teori ini dikatakan bahwa nenek moyang manusia adalah kera. Tentu hal ini menjadi kebimbangan sendiri bagi para pembacanya. Namun jika kita lihat dalam Al-Qur’an yang datang jauh sebelum teori evolusi darwin ditemukan tentu kita kan mendapatkan jawabannya. Dimana di dalam Al-Qur’an telah dijelaskan secara jelas mengenai proses penciptaan nabi Adam sebagai manusia dan khalifah pertama dimuka bumi ini. Salah satunya penjelasan terkait nabi Adam ini adalah terdapat dalam kitab tafsir Ibnu Kathir. Dalam kitab ini dikupas secara jelas mengenai pe…

title: KONSEP JIHAD DAN PERDAMAIAN DALAM AL-QUR’AN
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Abstrak:. Jihad merupakan kewajiban umat Muslim untuk mempertahankan agamanya dari serangan lawan. Wujud dari serangan tersebut bukan hanya berupa fisik. tetapi, dapat juga berupa serangan pemikiran, keilmuan, teknologi, perekonomian dan lain sebagainya. Namun, tidak menyangkal pula apabila perang ialah salah satu dari bentuk jihad. Pembahasan jihad sering kali mengalami perdebatan apakah hal tersebut merupakan tindakan terorisme. Stigma ini muncul karena adanya segelintir orang yang salah memaknai kata jihad. Padahal, jihad dapat menjadi sarana terciptanya perdamaian antar umat. Penelitian ini termasuk dalam penelitian library research atau kajian pustaka. Informasi yang diperoleh diuji hip…

title: Musyawarah dalam al-Qur’an
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Kehidupan manusia yang beragam meniscayakan adanya perbedaan pendapat. Dalam rangka mencari titik temu dan menghindari perselisihan atau ketidakpuasan, manusia dianjurkan untuk bermusyawarah. Konsep musyawarah ini identik dengan salah satu prinsip dalam demokrasi. Al-Quran sendiri menyebutkan beberapa kali kata dan perintah untuk bermusyawarah. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengungkap bagaimana para mufasir memaknai musyawarah yang al-Quran sebutkan. title: Kritik Cendikiawan Muslim atas Pandangan Orientalis: Sejarah Penulisan dan Sosiohistoris Al-Qur’an
authors: Rahman_Nur Anwar _Ahmad, Tabhan Syamsu Rijal, Abdul Ghany
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Orientalists generally seek to find errors in Islamic teachings through scientific means. However, what happens is that they show very sceptical results in theirresearch. This is evident when some Western scholars attempt to refute the arguments presented by the Quran regarding the historical creation of the earth and the history of human civilisation. The various names mentioned in the Quran indicate that the Quran itself is an interpretation of the revelations received over a period of twenty-three years. title: Analisis Termodinamika Merkuri (Hg) dalam Fenomena Sihir pada Q.S. al-A‘raf [7]: 103–126 : Kajian Terhadap al-Jawahir Fi Tafsir al-Qur’an al-Karim
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: This study explores the integration between scriptural exegesis and natural sciences by examining the phenomenon of the sorcery performed by Pharaoh’s magicians as narrated in Q.S. al-A‘r?f [7]: 103–126. The main focus of this research is an analysis of the possible involvement of the element mercury (Hg) in creating optical illusions during the event, using a thermodynamic approach. Tafsir al-Jaw?hir by Tantawi Jauhari is chosen as the primary source due to its scientific interpretive style, which combines divine revelation with empirical knowledge. The methodology employed in this study is qualitative, utilizing a scientify tafsir approach and literature review method. The findings indicat…

title: Anjing Sebagai Perumpamaan dalam Al-Qur’an: Studi Komparasi Tafsir Mafatih al-Ghayb dan Tafsir al-Sha’rawi
authors: Muhammad Abdul Muiz, Azzam Musoffa, Muhammad Arwani Rofi'i
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Anjing merupakan salah satu hewan yang disebut dalam al-Qur’an sebagai perumpamaan bagi manusia yang mendustakan ayat-ayat Allah, dengan ciri khas terengah-engah sambil menjulurkan lidah sebagai sifat alami yang dijadikan perbandingan. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengungkap perumpamaan tentang anjing dalam al-Qur’an melalui analisis komparatif terhadap penafsiran Fakhr al-Din al-Razi dalam Tafsir Mafatih al-Ghayb dan Muhammad Mutawalli al-Sha’rawi dalam Tafsir al-Sha’rawi. Metode yang digunakan adalah penelitian kualitatif dengan jenis kajian pustaka, serta pendekatan komparasi tafsir. title: Analisis Al-Qur'an Terhadap Gaya Hidup Childfree dalam Perspektif Tafsir Mafatih al-Ghayb
authors: Faiq El Meida, Rosydina Robi'aqolbi, Anis Ulfiyatin
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Fenomena gaya hidup childfree akhir-akhir ini menjadi sorotan publik karena dianggap bertentangan dengan nilai-nilai budaya, sosial, dan agama, khususnya dalam perspektif Islam. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji kritik Al-Qur’an terhadap gaya hidup childfree dengan menelaah ayat-ayat tentang anak keturunan melalui perspektif Tafsir Mafatih al-Ghayb karya Fakhruddin al-Razi. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan kepustakaan (library research), yakni mengumpulkan data dari sumber-sumber primer berupa tafsir klasik dan sekunder berupa literatur kontemporer yang relevan dengan isu childfree. Analisis data dilakukan dengan metode deskriptif-analitis, yaitu mendeskri…

title: Antropologi Al-Qur’an dan Tradisi Nusantara: Relevansi Nilai-Nilai Qur’ani dalam Pelestarian Budaya di Era Globalisasi
authors: Ayu Indah Nur Aisya, Masruchin, Kiki Muhammad Hakiki
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Abstrak Globalisasi membawa perubahan yang memengaruhi budaya Nusantara, sehingga tradisi lokal berisiko tergeser oleh budaya modern. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk memahami bagaimana prinsip-prinsip Al-Qur’an dapat dijadikan pedoman dalam menjaga dan melestarikan tradisi Nusantara sebagai warisan kearifan lokal. Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah kualitatif berbasis studi pustaka, melalui pengumpulan dan analisis literatur berupa Al-Qur’an, buku, jurnal, dan artikel terkait budaya, yang kemudian dianalisis secara tematik dan dikaitkan dengan praktik budaya masyarakat Nusantara. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa prinsip-prinsip Al-Qur’an seperti menghargai keberagaman, tolong-menolong,…

title: Relevansi Tafsir al-Maraghi atas Surah Al-Baqarah Ayat 233: Tanggung Jawab Orang Tua dalam Menjamin Hak Anak di Era Modern
authors: Yetri Nelda Maswita, Zulheldi, Azhariah Fatia, Sania Aniqa
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh fenomena meningkatnya kelalaian sebagian orang tua dalam menunaikan kewajiban terhadap anak, seperti penelantaran, kurangnya perhatian pada kebutuhan dasar, serta pengabaian hak-hak anak yang berdampak serius pada tumbuh kembang dan masa depan mereka. Kekhawatiran ini semakin relevan di tengah kondisi sosial masa kini, di mana modernisasi dan tekanan ekonomi sering membuat orang tua abai terhadap tanggung jawabnya. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji tanggung jawab orang tua terhadap anak berdasarkan penafsiran Tafsir al-Maraghi atas Surah al-Baqarah ayat 233, dengan fokus pada kewajiban penyusuan, pemenuhan kebutuhan pokok, dan pemberian yang terbaik…

title: Critical Historical Thinking dalam Bingkai Peradaban: Analisis Integratif QS. Ghāfir [40]: 21 dan 82 Perspektif Tafsir Klasik-Kontemporer dan Kontribusinya Bagi Ummah
abstract: This study aims to analyze the concept of critical historical thinking in the perspective of the Qur'an through a study of QS. Ghāfir [40]: 21 and 82. The study uses a library research method with a thematic-comparative approach that integrates classical and contemporary interpretations. The main data sources come from the works of the commentaries of al-Ṭabarī, Ibn Kathīr, Sayyid Quṭb, and al-Sha‘rāwī, while supporting data are obtained from relevant scientific literature. The analysis technique is carried out through the stages of data collection, reduction, comparative interpretation, and conceptual interpretation to find the construction of critical historical thinking in the Qur'anic pe…

title: Prinsip-Prinsip Bimbingan Keluarga Dalam Kisah Keluarga Imran (Studi Terhadap Pemikiran M. Quraish Shihab dalam Tafsir Al-Misbah)
authors: Nabila Annisa, Maimun Maimun, Ismiati Ismiati
journal: RIGGS: Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Business
abstract: Keluarga merupakan lingkungan sosial utama dalam membentuk generasi yang mampu berinteraksi dengan baik. Orang tua menjadi tempat pertama bagi anak untuk memperoleh bimbingan. Namun, fenomena saat ini menunjukkan banyak keluarga lebih berfokus pada urusan duniawi, seperti pekerjaan, serta kurang tepat dalam memilih pembimbing bagi anak. Di sisi lain, aspek ukhrawi juga penting untuk menjaga hubungan dengan Allah SWT. Kisah keluarga Imran dalam Al-Qur’an mengandung ibrah yang dapat dijadikan pedoman dalam membimbing anak. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan prinsip-prinsip bimbingan keluarga dalam kisah Ali Imran serta relevansinya dengan bimbingan keluarga masa kini. Penelitian ini meng…

title: Konsep Work-Life Balance dalam Surah Al-Jumu'ah Ayat 9-10 (Studi Komparatif Tafsir Al-Misbah dan Tafsir Ibnu Katsir)
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji konsep work-life balance dalam Surah Al-Jumu'ah ayat 9-10 melalui pendekatan komparatif (muq?ran) terhadap Tafsir Ibnu Katsir dan Tafsir Al-Misbah karya M. Quraish Shihab. Metode yang digunakan adalah analisis isi (content analysis) terhadap kedua tafsir sebagai sumber primer, didukung literatur sekunder berupa tafsir klasik dan kontemporer, hadis, serta artikel ilmiah yang relevan. Penelitian ini bertujuan memahami bagaimana dua mufassir dari periode yang berbeda memaknai perintah meninggalkan aktivitas ekonomi demi ibadah dalam ayat 9, serta perintah kembali bekerja dan mengingat Allah dalam ayat 10, dan bagaimana kedua penafsiran tersebut membentuk konsep keseimban…

title: Telaah Sejarah Metode Tafsir Komprehensif Dari Keunggulan, Keterbatasan, Hingga Cara Penerapan
authors: Lesni Unisa, Dwiraja Adinata, Habibi Hadi Holib
journal: Taqrib : Journal of Islamic Studies and Education
abstract: Artikel ini membahas metode tafsir Al-Qur’an dengan menganalisis kelebihan, kelemahan, dan penerapannya. Metode tafsir memiliki peran penting dalam memahami Al-Qur’an karena setiap pendekatan mencerminkan tradisi keilmuan dan kebutuhan konteks yang berbeda. Dengan pendekatan deskriptif-analitis, penelitian ini menjelaskan penerapan tafsir melalui analisis bahasa, konteks sejarah, dan relevansinya terhadap isu kontemporer. Penelitian ini bertujuan memberikan pemahaman singkat mengenai metodologi tafsir serta mendorong penafsiran yang kritis dan relevan sesuai prinsip keilmuan Islam.

title: Ethics of Qur’anic Communication in the Era of Artificial Intelligence: Perspectives from Ibn ʿAshur’s Tafsir
authors: Kauthar Binti Abd Kadir, Mesbahul Hoque, Uwaisu Babba Rafindadi
abstract: Background: Rapid AI growth and digital communication have intensified concerns regarding misinformation, algorithmic bias, and manipulation. Islamic ethical thought provides enduring principles to address these modern socio-technical challenges. Objective: This study examines Qur’anic communication ethics through Muhammad al-Tahir Ibn ‘Ashur’s Tafsir al-Tahrir wa al-Tanwir. It aims to develop a comprehensive, value-based framework that bridges classical exegesis with AI-mediated contexts, providing a moral foundation for digital governance and addressing systemic ethical gaps in automated systems. Methodology: Using a qualitative design, the study analyzed Qur’anic verses on speech and inte…

title: Memaknai Kesiapan serta Peran Perempuan dalam Perumpamaan Gadis Bijaksana dan Bodoh: Tafsir Sosio-Naratif Matius 25:6-13
abstract: The issue of gender inequality still persists today, where women's roles are often seen as limited to the domestic sphere, such as taking care of the household, while work in the public sphere is more often considered the responsibility of men, resulting in a significant separation of roles. This article aims to explore the meaning of readiness in awaiting the arrival of the Kingdom of Heaven and to analyze the role of women in the parable of the ten wise and foolish virgins who welcomed the arrival of the bridegroom through a socio-narrative interpretation of Matthew 25:6-13 and its relevance to the present context. title: Konstruksi Metodologi Dakwah dalam Al-Qur’an Berdasarkan Kajian Kitab Tafsir Ibnu Katsir
authors: Zuni Nurrochim, Sri Ningrum, Imam Nur Rahman
journal: Tabsyir: Jurnal Dakwah dan Sosial Humaniora
abstract: This study examines the construction of da'wah methodology in the Qur’an based on Imam Ibn Kathir’s interpretation in Tafsir Al-Qur’an Al-‘Azhim. The research focuses on Qur’anic verses that explain the commands, principles, and methods of da'wah practiced by the prophets and messengers. Using a library research method, this study places Tafsir Ibn Kathir as the primary source, supported by relevant tafsir works and academic literature. The findings show that the Qur’anic da'wah methodology, according to Ibn Kathir, follows a universal and consistent pattern grounded in tawhid, wisdom, good advice, and courteous dialogue. The da'wah of the prophets shares a common objective, namely inviting …

title: Metode Tafsir Al-Qur’an: Studi Perbandingan antara Pendekatan Tradisional dan Kontemporer
authors: Muhammad Naufal, Siti Fatimah Azzahra, Anisa
journal: Taqrib : Journal of Islamic Studies and Education
abstract: Penelitian ini membahas Memahami Metode Tafsir Al-Qur’an: Pendekatan Tradisional dan Kontemporer dalam Aliran Tafsir dengan menyoroti ruang lingkup metode tafsir, karakteristik pendekatan tradisional, serta pendekatan kontemporer dalam memahami teks suci. Ruang lingkup metode tafsir mencakup prinsip-prinsip dasar penafsiran, sumber-sumber yang digunakan, serta tujuan yang ingin dicapai oleh para mufasir. Pendekatan tradisional biasanya berfokus pada riwayat, bahasa Arab klasik, dan otoritas ulama generasi awal, sehingga penafsirannya cenderung literal dan mempertahankan pandangan salaf. Sementara itu, pendekatan kontemporer menawarkan pembacaan yang lebih kontekstual dengan mempertimbangkan …

title: Nilai-Nilai Pendidikan Perempuan dalam Kisah Maryam: Implementasi dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Arab Berbasis Qasas Qur’aniyyah
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: This study aims to examine in depth the educational values for women contained in the Qur’anic narrative of Maryam and to analyze their implementation in Arabic language learning through the Qasas Qur’aniyyah approach. Using a qualitative descriptive method with a library research approach, this study explores the Qur’anic accounts of Maryam in relevant surah ssuch as Ali Imran and Maryam to identify the core values of women’s education. title: Thematic Analysis of the Concept of Taghyir Khalqillah in the Ethics of Modern Genetic Engineering
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: This study aims to reconstruct the concept of taghyir khalqillah in the Qur'an and examine its ethical implications for modern genetic engineering, particularly CRISPR-Cas9 technology. This study uses a qualitative method based on literature study with the thematic interpretation approach of al-Farmaw?, which includes the collection of related verses, context analysis, and comprehensive synthesis of meaning. Primary data are verses of the Qur'an containing the root word gh–y–r, namely Q.S. Al-Anfal: 53, An-Nisa’: 119, and Ar-Ra’d: 11, while secondary data include classical and contemporary interpretations, the book asbab al-nuzul, hadith, and scientific literature on CRISPR-Cas9. title: Kepemimpinan dalam Perspektif Al-Qur’an: Analisis Tafsir Muqaran QS. al-Nisa’ [4]: 59 dan QS. Ali ‘Imran [3]: 26
authors: Fandi Erdiansah Fandi, Fahmi Akhyar Al Farabi
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Al-Qur'an merupakan pedoman utama bagi umat Islam dalam mengatur kehidupan, termasuk dalam persoalan kepemimpinan. Beberapa ayat Al-Qur'an memiliki latar belakang turunnya (asbab al-nuzul), sementara sebagian lainnya tidak disertai riwayat tersebut. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis kandungan makna kepemimpinan dalam QS. al-Nisa' [4]: 59 dan QS. Ali 'Imran [3]: 26 melalui pendekatan tafsir komparatif antara tafsir klasik dan kontemporer, dengan tetap mempertimbangkan aspek asbab al-nuzul sebagai kerangka kontekstual. title: Konsep Nutfah Amsyaj dalam Al-Qur'an: Analisis Linguistik dan Implikasinya terhadap Penyuntingan Genom Manusia
authors: Ishmaelasta Ghafrilla Al Azhmi, Niken Sylvia Puspitasari, Agung Wahyudi, Arifin Ilham
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Artikel ini membahas konsep Qur’ani tentang nutfah amsyaj melalui pendekatan linguistik dan tafsir dalam dialog kritis dengan isu penyuntingan genom manusia kontemporer. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk merumuskan makna kebahasaan dari istilah nutfah amsyaj dan ungkapan li-nabtalihi dalam QS. al-Insan [76]: 2, serta menjelaskan implikasinya secara mendalam terhadap konsep penciptaan manusia, agensi moral, dan batas otoritas manusia sebagai khalifah di bumi. title: Konsep Pendidik dan Transmisi Pengetahuan dalam Al-Qur’an: Studi Tafsir Tarbawi QS. al-Nahl (16): 43–44
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Artikel ini mengkaji konsep pendidik dan transmisi pengetahuan dalam Al-Qur’an melalui pendekatan tafsir tarbawi terhadap QS. al-Nahl (16): 43–44. Kajian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh krisis pendidikan kontemporer yang ditandai oleh melemahnya otoritas keilmuan, maraknya informasi tanpa sanad, serta reduksi peran pendidik menjadi sekadar penyampai informasi. Dalam situasi tersebut, ilmu cenderung terlepas dari nilai, adab, dan tanggung jawab etis. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis studi kepustakaan. Analisis dilakukan melalui metode tafsir tarbawi dengan tahapan analisis lughawi, tematik, dan sintesis tafsir terhadap pandangan mufasir klasik dan kontemporer, seperti a…

title: Tafsir ‘Ilmi Al-Qur’an: Genealogi Historis, Dinamika, dan Kritik Epistemologis
journal: Ayatuna : Jurnal Studi Ilmu Al-Qur’an dan Tafsir
abstract: Artikel ini mengkaji tafsir ilmi Al-Qur'an sebagai fenomena intelektual yang muncul dari interaksi kompleks antara wahyu, akal, dan tantangan modernitas dalam tradisi keilmuan Islam. Dengan menggunakan pendekatan historis-analitis dan epistemologis, penelitian ini menelusuri genealogi tafsir ilmi sejak akar konseptualnya dalam tafsir klasik hingga kemunculannya secara sistematis pada era modern, termasuk konteks sosial-intelektual, figur perintis, serta proyek tafsir mereka. Studi ini menyusun tipologi tafsir ilmi ke dalam tiga bentuk utama, yaitu tafsir ilmi klasik, tafsir ilmi modern, dan Bucailisme, untuk menunjukkan perbedaan karakter, tujuan, dan metodologi masing-masing arus. title: "منهجية التفسير الموضوعي عند الشيخ محمد اليعقوبي من خلال تفسيره (من نور القرآن)": دراسة تأصيلية تحليلية / The Methodology of Thematic Exegesis of Sheikh Muhammad Al-Yaqubi through His Tafsir “Min Noor Al-Qur’an" : A Foundational and Analytical Study
authors: عقيل حسن مطر البودراج, حسين ستار, صانعي بور, عباسي مقدم
journal: Journal Of Babylon Center for Humanities Studies

title: Teori Mazhab Tafsir: Sumber Penafsiran, Subjektifitas Mufassir, dan Sosio - Historis Mufassir
authors: Nakhwa Azkia, Rahmad Dzailani, Akhmad Dasuki
journal: Jurnal Studi Ilmu Alquran dan Tafsir
abstract: Keragaman mazhab tafsir menunjukkan bahwa pemahaman terhadap Al-Qur’an tidak pernah tunggal, karena selalu dipengaruhi sumber penafsiran, kapasitas mufassir, dan realitas sosial zamannya. Kajian terdahulu cenderung menempatkan mazhab tafsir sebagai klasifikasi corak, sehingga hubungan antara sumber, subjektivitas, dan konteks sosio-historis belum dibaca secara terpadu. Rumusan masalah diarahkan pada bagaimana ketiga unsur tersebut membentuk mazhab tafsir, sedangkan tujuannya ialah menganalisis konstruksi epistemologis mazhab tafsir secara konkret. authors: سمية حمودي ناصر الحسون, الدكتور حسين ستار, حميد رضا فهيمي تبار
journal: Journal Of Babylon Center for Humanities Studies
abstract: مفهوم التمكين أصبح ضرورة ملحّة تحتاج إلى معالجة دقيقة وفهم حدودها، خاصة في سياقات الخطاب القرآني، وخصوصاً فيما يتعلق بمكانة المرأة. إذ أخذت هذه المكانة تتلاشى في ظل التيارات الفكرية العاصفة بمقدراتها، وأصبحت المرأة أكثر عرضة للغرق في ويلات العولمة ودعوات التحضر وممارسة الترفيه أكثر من أي وقت مضى. لذلك، بات من الواجب تناول هذا الموضوع انطلاقًا من الركيزة الأساسية التي رسمت لنا منهج حياتنا الإيماني والسلوكي - القرآن الكريم. إن القرآن الكريم، باعتباره المصدر الأول للتشريع الإسلامي، قد أولى اهتماماً بالغاً بقضية المرأة، ووضع لها أسساً وقواعد راسخة تضمن لها حقوقها وتحدد واجباتها. وقد كرم الإسلام المرأة ومنحها مكانة مرموقة، وجعلها إحدى دعائم الأسرة التي هي نواة المجتمع وركيزة أساسية لبنائه. وتجلّى…

title: Nilai-Nilai Tawasul dalam Tafsir Al-Sya’rawi sebagai Landasan Spiritual MSDM Modern
authors: Mohamad Munib, Ahmad Kamaluddin, Ahmad Zulki
abstract: Manajemen Sumber Daya Manusia (MSDM) modern tidak hanya berfokus pada aspek teknis dan material, tetapi juga mulai memperhatikan aspek spiritual dan psikologis karyawan. Spiritualitas di tempat kerja telah terbukti meningkatkan makna kerja, komitmen organisasi, dan kesejahteraan mental karyawan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengkaji nilai-nilai tawasul dalam tafsir al-Sya‘rawi serta relevansinya sebagai landasan spiritual dalam manajemen sumber daya manusia (MSDM) modern. Al-Sya‘rawi dikenal sebagai mufasir kontemporer yang memadukan pendekatan linguistik, sufistik, dan sosial dalam tafsirnya. title: Bias Tafsir “Cacat” dalam Pasal 116 Kompilasi Hukum Islam Prespektif Perlindungan Pasangan Disabilitas
authors: Khusnul Khotimah, Ghufron Maksum, Nur Azizah
abstract: Divorce based on the ground of “physical disability or an incurable disease” as stipulated in Article 116(e) of the Compilation of Islamic Law potentially produces biased and discriminatory interpretations, particularly when disability is treated as a legitimate reason to terminate a marriage without considering the rights, capacities, and protection of spouses with disabilities. This study aims to analyze the meaning and interpretation of the term disability within the article from the perspective of protecting disabled spouses. The research employs a normative legal approach supported by humanistic and gender perspectives, using document analysis of legal texts, court decisions, and releva…

title: منهج أبي حفص النسفي في الإسرائيليات من خلال كتابه التيسير في التفسير
abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui klasifikasi Israiliyat dalam karya al- Taysir fi al- Tafsir, ragam metode al-Nasafī dalam menyajikan Israiliyat, serta cara beliau dalam memberikan komentar dan kritik. Pentingnya penelitian ini terletak pada keterkaitannya dengan tafsir ulama terdahulu, serta beragam pendekatan yang digunakan Abū Hafṣ dalam menangani riwayat Israiliyat, yang perlu dijelaskan dan diuraikan. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan adanya variasi metode al-Nasafī dalam meriwayatkan Israiliyat, baik dari segi penyebutan sumber riwayat, seperti menyebut riwayat tanpa sanad, menisbatkannya kepada salah satu mufasir dan ahlul kitab, atau menyebut riwayat tanpa sanad.
