title: Dekonstruksi Gender Perspektif Rasyid Ridha (Studi Analisis Ayat-Ayat Bias Gender Pada Kitab Tafsir Al-Manār)
abstract: The book of Tafsir al-Manar stems from the interpretation of the Qur'an lectures given by Muhammad Abduh al-Azhar University, Egypt, which lasted from 1899 until his death (1905). The lectures are always attended by Rashid Rida, Abduh's pupil, which each verse was delivered by her teacher on record in his mind. Then the records drawn up in the form of regular writing and submitted and known as Tafsir al-Manar. Rashid Rida using deconstruction theory in explaining the pattern of gender relations when interpreting the verses of gender bias. Deconstruction theory in general can be understood as a method of demolition to the reality that contains logic Binner opposition. Binary oppositions are t…

title: STUDI TAFSIR AL-QUR’AN SURAT AL-ALAQ 1-5 SEBAGAI SUMBER PENGETAHUAN DALAM PENDIDIKAN ISLAM
abstract: This Tafsir of the Quran is intended to explain the meanings of the terms found in the Quran with a more comprehensive approach, particularly regarding the parts of verses that may be confusing or unclear. Surah Al-'Alaq, specifically verses 1-5. The methodology used in this research involves the collection and analysis of texts from the Quran. This research also compares previous research findings with verses in the Quran that are related to the origins of knowledge. The study's findings indicate that many verses in the Quran relate to references used in Islamic education. The main objective of this…

title: Toward a Qur’anic Theory of Mindfulness: Integrating Consciousness, Spirituality, and Emotional Regulation in Tafsīr al-Kabīr and Tafsir al-Azhar
authors: Ermita Zakiyah, Abdul Kadir Riyadi, Ghozi Ghozi, Wardatun Nadhiroh
journal: Journal of Ushuluddin and Islamic Thought
abstract: Contemporary mindfulness research has been dominated by secular psychological paradigms, leaving the Qur’anic conception of consciousness insufficiently theorized. This article seeks to develop a Qur’anic mindfulness construct by integrating insights from classical and modern Qur’anic exegesis and examining its relationship with David R. Hawkins’ map of consciousness. Employing qualitative library research, the study analyzes two influential commentaries: Tafsīr al-Kabīr of Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī and Tafsir al-Azhar of Hamka. The findings demonstrate that Qur’anic mindfulness constitutes a psychospiritual model of consciousness grounded in divine awareness, emotional regulation, and moral tran…

title: KONSEPSI HADIS DALAM PENAFSIRAN MUHAMMAD HUSEIN ATH-THABATHABA’I DALAM TAFSIR AL-MIZAN
journal: Al FAWATIH:Jurnal Kajian Al Quran dan Hadis
abstract: This study examines the biography and exegetical thought of Muhammad Husain ath-Thabathaba’i, with a particular focus on the conception of Hadith in his Tafsir al-Mizan. He was born into a scholarly family deeply rooted in intellectual and spiritual traditions, which shaped his intellectual character from an early age. His formal and religious education began in Tabriz and continued in Najaf, a major center of Islamic learning, where he studied various disciplines such as jurisprudence (fiqh), principles of jurisprudence (usul), philosophy, and mysticism (irfan). His intellectual development was also influenced by the socio-political conditions of Iran during the Pahlavi era, marked by proce…

title: RELASI IBADAH DAN KEMAKMURAN NEGARA BERBASIS NILAI-NILAI AL-QUR’AN: KAJIAN TAFSIR TEMATIK TENTANG KESALEHAN KEADILAN, DAN KESEJAHTERAAN SOSIAL
journal: Al FAWATIH:Jurnal Kajian Al Quran dan Hadis
abstract: Abstract This study aims to analyze the relationship between worship and the prosperity of a country through the perspective of siyāsah tafsir. The methodology employed is literature review with a qualitative approach, examining classical and contemporary works that discuss the role of spirituality in national prosperity. The findings indicate that consistent worship can enhance morals, ethics, and social justice, which positively contribute to economic stability and national prosperity. Siyasah tafsir emphasizes that a country’s success depends not only on material aspects but also on the spiritual and moral integrity of its people. Therefore, strengthening worship plays a strategic role in…

title: DAKWAH POLITIK DI TIKTOK PERSPEKTIF TAFSIR MAUDHU’I: ANTARA AMAR MA’RUF, TABAYYUN DAN MANIPULASI INFORMASI
authors: Darania Anisa, Ahmad Sainul, Kholifatun Nur Mustofa
journal: Al FAWATIH:Jurnal Kajian Al Quran dan Hadis
abstract: Perkembangan media sosial TikTok telah menghadirkan ruang baru bagi praktik dakwah politik di Indonesia. Platform ini tidak hanya digunakan sebagai sarana penyebaran nilai-nilai keislaman dan pendidikan politik masyarakat, tetapi juga dimanfaatkan untuk membentuk opini publik melalui narasi keagamaan yang berpotensi mengandung disinformasi dan polarisasi sosial. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis fenomena dakwah politik di TikTok dalam perspektif tafsir maudhu’i dengan menitikberatkan pada konsep amar ma’ruf, tabayyun, dan etika komunikasi dalam Al-Qur’an. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan normatif dan studi kepustakaan melalui penelaahan ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an, …

title: Takabbur and Fakhr in the Qur'an: A Thematic Interpretation of Tafsir Al-Maraghi
journal: Urwatul Wutsqo: Jurnal Studi Kependidikan dan Keislaman
abstract: The rapid development of digital communication has transformed social media into a space for self-representation, giving rise to the phenomenon of flexing, which refers to excessive displays of wealth, achievements, or social status to gain recognition and validation. While this phenomenon has been widely discussed from the perspectives of communication and psychology, studies examining it through the lens of Qur'anic interpretation remain limited. This study aims to analyze the concepts of takabbur and fakhr in the Qur'an based on Tafsir Al-Maraghi and to examine their relevance to the phenomenon of social media flexing. This research employed a qualitative library research approach using t…

title: Nilai-Nilai Pendidikan Karakter dalam Konteks Kekinian (Analisis Tafsir Sya'rawi Surah Lukman)
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji nilai-nilai pendidikan karakter dalam Surah Luqman dan relevansinya dengan pendidikan kontemporer melalui analisis tafsir Muhammad Mutawalli Asy-Sya'rawi. Menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode penelitian kepustakaan, studi ini mengidentifikasi lima nilai fundamental dalam nasihat Luqman kepada putranya: syukur, tauhid, birrul walidain, muraqabatullah, dan istiqamah. Pendekatan adabi ijtima'i Sya'rawi mengkontekstualisasikan nilai-nilai tersebut dalam tantangan pendidikan modern, khususnya di era digital. Penelitian mengungkapkan bahwa metodologi pendidikan Luqman—hikmah, mau'idzah hasanah sejalan dengan pendekatan pedagogis transformatif. Model implementasi …

title: الخلافية الأصولية وآثارها الفقهية في التفسير المظهري: دراسة أصولية تطبيقية / Controversial Principles of Jurisprudence and Their Juridical Implications in Al-Tafsir al-Mazhari: An Applied Study in Usul al-Fiqh
authors: م.د. أسامة نجم عبد الله العيساوي
abstract: يمثل الكشف عن الصلة بين القواعد الأصولية والفروع الفقهية أحد أهم مسالك فهم أسباب الاختلاف بين الفقهاء، ومن هنا جاءت أهمية هذا البحث الذي يتناول الخلافيات الأصولية وآثارها الفقهية في التفسير المظهري. وتنبع مشكلة البحث من ملاحظة منهجية لافتة عند الإمام المظهري؛ إذ صرّح في مواضع متعددة من تفسيره بأن بعض الخلافات الفقهية إنما ترجع إلى «خلافية أصولية»، الأمر الذي يكشف إدراك العلاقة بين الأصول والفروع، ويجعل هذه المواضع جديرة بالدراسة والتحليل، ويهدف البحث إلى استقراء المواضع التي نصّ فيها الإمام المظهري على مباني الخلاف الأصولي وتحليلها للكشف عن أثرها في بناء الأحكام الفقهية واختلاف المذاهب. ولتحقيق ذلك، عرضت المسائل الأصولية محل النزاع، وبيّنت أقوال الأصوليين وأدلتهم فيها، ثم درست الفروع الفقهية…

title: AL-TAFSIR AL-TARBAWIY LI AL-QUR’AN AL-KARIM DAN DESIGN THINKING : KONSTRUKSI MODEL ENAM EVOLUSI SOSIAL PENDIDIKAN TAUHID ANAK USIA DINI
authors: Lidya Fahrika Syaputri, Abd Aziz, Aldomi Putra
abstract: Tawhid education in early childhood is an essential foundation in the formation of spiritual identity, moral orientation, and Islamic character. QS. Luqman 13 is one of the most representative verses in describing the process of monotheistic education because it features dialogical, affective, and transformative educational interactions between parents and children. On the other hand, the development of contemporary pedagogical theory shows the need for a learning approach that is not only normative but also constructive and experiential. Design thinking, grounded in the framework of 6 social evolution models, offers a new perspective on learning as a process of consciousness evolution that …

title: Islamofobia Dalam Perkembangan Kajian Teoritis Tafsir Di Indonesia
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji pengaruh Islamofobia sebagai tantangan sosial, politik, dan intelektual terhadap perkembangan kajian tafsir di Indonesia. Dalam konteks global yang sering memarjinalkan Islam melalui stigma dan stereotip negatif, tafsir Al-Qur’an dituntut untuk melampaui pendekatan normatif-tradisional menuju pendekatan yang inklusif, dialogis, dan kontekstual. Melalui studi literatur dan analisis wacana, makalah ini mengeksplorasi peran mufasir Indonesia—seperti Quraish Shihab, Sahiron Syamsuddin, serta lembaga seperti Lajnah Pentashihan Mushaf Al-Qur’an—dalam mereposisi tafsir sebagai medium klarifikasi dan resistensi terhadap citra negatif Islam di ruang publik global. Hasil kajian…

title: SEJARAH PERKEMBANGAN TAFSIR AL-QUR’AN DI INDONESIA MASA KOLONIAL
abstract: The tradition of writing Qur'anic interpretations in Indonesia in Indonesia has been ongoing since the 17th century, starting with the monumental work of Tarjuman al-Mustafid by Abd al-Rauf Singkili written in Malay Arabic. The development of interpretations in Indonesia experienced significant acceleration in the pre-independence period, especially after the 1928 Youth Pledge which established Indonesian as the language of unity. This study aims to examine the development of Qur'anic interpretations in Indonesia during the colonial period by tracing the history, methods, styles, and contributions of interpretation works during that period. The study uses a qualitative approach with a histor…

title: BAHASA SEBAGAI MEDIUM DAKWAH ISLAM LOKAL: KAJIAN STILISTIKA DAN SOSIOLINGUISTIK DALAM TAFSIR AL-IBRĪZ / LANGUAGE AS A MEDIUM OF LOCAL ISLAMIC PREACHING: A STYLISTIC AND SOCIOLINGUISTIC STUDY OF TAFSIR AL-IBRĪZ
authors: Muhammad Rusidi, Muhammad Taufiq, Dina Istiqomah
abstract: Artikel ini mengkaji dimensi stilistika dan sosiolinguistik dalam Al-Ibrīz li Maʿrifat TafsīrAl-Qur’an al-ʿAzīz karya KH. Bisri Musthofa, sebuah karya tafsir klasik berbahasa Jawa yangmemiliki pengaruh besar dalam pendidikan Islam dan dakwah di komunitas pesantren. Denganmenggunakan pendekatan kualitatif melalui analisis teks, penelitian ini menerapkan metodestilistika dan sosiolinguistik untuk mengeksplorasi bagaimana bahasa berfungsi tidak hanya sebagaimedia penafsiran, tetapi juga sebagai strategi sosial dan budaya dalam menyampaikan pesan -pesanal-Qur’an. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan metafora lokal, register bahasa Jawakrama, peribahasa, serta gaya naratif dalam Al-Ibrīz…

title: METODOLOGI TAFSIR AYAT-AYAT HUKUM K.H. AHMAD SANUSI (Studi Analisis Kitab Raudhatu al-’Irfân fî Ma’rifati Al-Qur‘an)
authors: Herliani -, Romlah Widayati, Ade Naelul Huda
abstract: K.H. Ahmad Sanusi, an early twentieth-century interpreter, wrote Raudhatu al-'Irfân fî Ma'rifati Al-Qur'an. In addition to being a prolific writer, he was well-known for his ability to argue and frequently served as a conflict arbitrator. Even in the political field, he entered the ranks of freedom fighters with his election as a member of BPUPKI. His activities and fiqh tendencies in his works encourage the writer to investigate how to interpret legal verses and the methodology of istinbath law in his tafsir. The author employs a descriptive analytical method in conjunction with a qualitative approach. Tafsir, which was also a form of contribution to the thoughts of K.H. Ahmad Sanusi on the…

title: The Human Concept in Qur’anic Education Based on Tafsir Tarbawi Study of Q.S. Al-‘Alaq 1–5 and Its Educational Implications
abstract: This study aims to explore and analyze the concept of human beings in Qur’anic education based on a tafsir tarbawi analysis of Q.S. Al-Alaq verses 1 to 5 and to formulate its educational implications for contemporary Islamic education. The research employs a qualitative design using a literature review approach. The primary data source is the Qur’an, specifically Surah Al-Alaq 1 to 5, supported by classical and contemporary tafsir tarbawi interpretations. Secondary data consist of scholarly books, peer-reviewed journal articles, and relevant academic studies related to Islamic education and the human concept in the Qur’an. Data were collected through documentation techniques and analyzed usi…

title: Tafsir Filosofis Iqra’: Integrasi Konsentrasi dan Kontemplasi dalam Epistemologi Islam
journal: Islam Universalia: International Journal of Islamic Studies and Social Sciences
abstract: The widespread phenomena of character crisis, moral disorientation, and ecological degradation in the modern era indicate a fundamental epistemological problem in how human beings understand, acquire, and apply knowledge. Within Islamic epistemology, sustainable character and civilization formation cannot be separated from the integration of concentration (the cognitive-rational dimension) and contemplation (the affective-spiritual dimension). This study offers a philosophical exegesis of the first Quranic revelation, Iqra' Bismi Rabbika al-Ladzī Khalaq, as an epistemic foundation affirming the unity of reason (aql), heart (qalb), and moral character (akhlaq) in knowledge acquisition. Using …

title: Women’s Dignity in the Qur’an: A Comparative Study of Classical and Modern Tafsir
journal: LECTURES: Journal of Islamic and Education Studies
abstract: The Qur'an established women as socially and spiritually independent people, in contrast to pre-Islamic societies that saw them as legal servants. However, its inherent dignity has frequently been overshadowed by cultural additions. In order to recover the genuine Qur'anic framework for historical rights and female empowerment, this study compares classical and current exegesis. A qualitative and comparative hermeneutical method is used in the study. It compares contemporary interpretations found in Tafsir Al-Misbah and Tafsir Al-Maraghi with classical sources like Tafsir al-Tabari and Tafsir Ibn Kathir. It also documents the actual use of female authority in Islamic history by incorporating…

title: Sumber, Ideologi, dan Corak Tafsir Populer PERSIS: Kajian Historis-Hermeneutis atas Majalah Al-Lisan Rubrik Roeangan An-Nisa
authors: Rahma Isdianawati, Roni Nugraha, Komarudin Saleh
journal: Journal of Ulumul Qur'an and Tafsir Studies
abstract: Kajian akademik mengenai praktik penafsiran Al-Qur’an dalam media massa Islam awal abad ke-20, khususnya Majalah Al-Lisan, media massa Persatuan Islam (PERSIS), masih sangat terbatas, sebab penelitian terdahulu lebih banyak berfokus pada karya tafsir individual seperti Tafsir Al-Furqan karya Ahmad Hassan ketimbang tafsir yang dipublikasikan secara berkala dalam rubrik keperempuanan. Kesenjangan inilah yang mendorong artikel ini untuk mengidentifikasi sumber, ideologi, dan corak penafsiran dalam rubrik Roeangan An-Nisa, Majalah Al-Lisan. Penelitian ini merupakan penelitian kualitatif dengan pendekatan historis-hermeneutis dan metode studi kepustakaan (library research), dengan memadukan Teori…

title: Kajian Tafsir Ayat Ekonomi dan Implementasi Fatwa DSN-MUI Tentang Musyarakah Mutanaqisah (MMQ) Di Pondok Pesantren Arrahman Cidadap
abstract: Islamic Boarding Schools (Pesantren) possess significant potential in developing the Sharia ecosystem, yet financial literacy, particularly regarding complex contracts like Musyarakah Mutanaqisah (MMQ), remains low among teachers (asatidz) and structural officials. This study aims to enhance Sharia financial literacy and empower the economic welfare of the Arrahman Cidadap Islamic Boarding School community through the deepening of economic verses exegesis (Tafsir) and DSN-MUI Fatwas. This community engagement research employs a qualitative approach with a Participatory Action Research (PAR) design. The process involves a cyclical phase of Planning, Action, Observation, and Reflection. Data w…

title: Infertilitas sebagai Sunnatullah dalam QS. Asy-Syūrā [42]: 49–50 dan Implikasinya bagi Pasangan Muslim (Studi Tafsir Maqāṣidī Abdul Mustaqim)
abstract: Infertilitas menjadi persoalan yang kompleks karena tidak hanya terkait aspek biologis, tetapi juga memengaruhi kondisi psikologis, sosial, dan spiritual pasangan Muslim, di mana anak sering dianggap sebagai simbol keberhasilan rumah tangga. QS. Asy-Syūrā ayat 49-50 menegaskan bahwa variasi keturunan, termasuk ketidakmampuan memiliki anak, adalah bagian dari sunnatullah yang mengandung hikmah, sekaligus menegaskan prinsip keadilan, kesetaraan, dan martabat individu. Masalah utama yang muncul adalah bagaimana pasangan infertil memahami ketetapan Allah tanpa terbebani stigma, tekanan sosial, atau gangguan psikologis. Penelitian ini bertujuan menafsirkan makna infertilitas melalui perspektif ta…

title: Studi Dalalah Terhadap Makna Kontekstual Surat Al-Fātiḥah dalam Bingkai Tafsir Modern
abstract: Dalam kehidupan umat Islam, surah Al-Fatihah memiliki kedudukan sentral dan merupakan inti ajaran Al-Qur’an, baik secara teologis maupun praktis. Surah Al-Fatihah tidak hanya berfungsi sebagai pembuka Al-Qur’an, tetapi juga memuat prinsip-prinsip dasar akidah, ibadah, dan etika. Kajian terhadap dalālah (penunjukan makna) Surah Al-Fatihah menjadi penting untuk memahami pesan Al-Qur’an secara komprehensif dan kontekstual. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis dalālah Surah Al-Fatihah dengan menempatkannya dalam bingkai tafsir modern. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif melalui pendekatan studi kepustakaan (library research), dengan sumber data utama berupa kitab tafsir modern Sh…

title: Children Education in Qur'anic Perspective: Al-Ghazali's Pedagogical Thought and M. Quraish Shihab's Tafsir Al-Misbah
abstract: Purpose This study compares the child education pedagogy of Abu Hamid Al-Ghazali, as articulated in Ihya' Ulumuddin and Ayyuhal Walad, with M. Quraish Shihab's Qur'anic exegesis of child education verses in Tafsir Al-Misbah, while clarifying the distinct exegetical status of each scholar's engagement with the Qur'anic text. Method Using a qualitative library research design, primary sources were analysed through thematic coding organised around the five pedagogical domains of QS. Luqman (31:13–19), then compared using content-analysis principles adapted for textual, hermeneutic data. Results/findings Al-Ghazali develops five methods—habituation, exemplary conduct, narrative and counsel, prop…

title: Konstruksi Akhlaq dalam Perspektif Tafsir Ibnu Katsir dan Al-Suyuthi: Relevansinya bagi Pendidikan Islam
journal: Indonesian Journal of Islamic Educational Review
abstract: Pendidikan akhlaq menghadapi kesenjangan antara norma moral yang bersumber dari wahyu dan proses internalisasinya dalam perilaku nyata peserta didik. Penelitian ini bertujuan merekonstruksi kerangka akhlaq Qur’ani-Nabawi secara integratif dengan menghubungkan nilai Al-Qur’an, fungsi penjelas dan keteladanan As-Sunnah, serta implementasinya dalam pendidikan Islam. Kebaruan kajian terletak pada penambahan lapisan tafsir dalam kerangka sumber-proses-konteks-evaluasi: prinsip Qur’ani dibaca secara tematik melalui Tafsir al-Qur’an al-‘Azim karya Ibnu Katsir dan Al-Durr al-Manthur karya Al-Suyuthi, kemudian dikorelasikan dengan Hadits yang relevan. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif mela…

title: Nilai-Nilai Pendidikan Akhlak dalam Surat Ali-Imran Ayat 159: Analisis Tafsir Ibnu Katsir dan Al-Misbah serta Implikasinya terhadap Pendidikan Islam Kontemporer
authors: Suparmi Suparmi, Muhammad Juni Beddu, Sumainti Sumainti
journal: Jurnal Riset Rumpun Agama dan Filsafat
abstract: The moral crisis in contemporary education demands a reconstruction of moral values derived from the Qur'an as the epistemological foundation of Islamic education. This study aims to identify and analyze the moral educational values found in Surah Al-Imran, verse 159, particularly through the perspectives of Ibn Kathir’s tafsir and Quraish Shihab’s Tafsir Al-Misbah, and formulate its implications for contemporary Islamic education practices. Using a qualitative approach with a library research method, this study analyzes primary data from Ibn Kathir’s tafsir and Tafsir Al-Misbah, confronted with secondary literature on moral education theory. The analysis technique used was content analysis …

title: Konstruksi Model Motivasi Kerja Islami: Pendekatan Tafsir Maudhu'i dan Analisis Komparatif dengan Teori Motivasi Barat
journal: EduTeach : Jurnal Edukasi dan Teknologi Pembelajaran
abstract: Motivasi kerja dalam komunitas Muslim kontemporer menampilkan paradoks yang kompleks, di mana orientasi nilai religius seringkali bertentangan dengan logika utilitarian yang mendominasi teori manajemen modern. Literatur manajemen Islam yang ada masih bersifat normatif-preskriptif tanpa menghasilkan konstruksi teori yang solid dan dapat diuji secara empiris. Kesenjangan teoretis ini menunjukkan kebutuhan mendesak akan model motivasi kerja yang bersumber langsung dari sumber primer Islam dan memiliki relevansi praktis dalam konteks organisasi modern. title: TUJUAN PENDIDIKAN ISLAM DALAM PERSPEKTIF AL-QUR’AN DAN HADIS: KAJIAN TAFSIR TEMATIK TENTANG PEMBENTUKAN INSAN KAMIL
journal: TARBIYA ISLAMIA : Jurnal Pendidikan dan Keislaman
abstract: Pendidikan Islam sering dibicarakan sebagai proses, kurikulum, atau kelembagaan, sementara arah yang hendak dituju kurang diperiksa secara mendalam. Artikel ini menelaah tujuan pendidikan Islam menurut Al-Qur’an dan hadis, lalu menautkannya dengan gagasan insan kamil sebagai orientasi pembentukan manusia. Penelitian memakai pendekatan kualitatif berbasis kajian kepustakaan dengan kerangka tafsir tematik (maudhu’i) model al-Farmawi, yang dilengkapi pembacaan tematik atas hadis-hadis pokok. Data berasal dari ayat, hadis, kitab tafsir, dan literatur ilmiah terbitan 2020–2026, kemudian dianalisis melalui inventarisasi tema, klasifikasi, analisis kebahasaan dan kontekstual, serta sintesis. title: MANAJEMEN SARANA DAN PRASARANA PENDIDIKAN DALAM PRESFEKTIF TAFSIR AL-QUR’AN DAN HADIST
authors: Salma Tiaz, Sri Andini, Rokhayani Yuslida Hanum Harahap, Amri Jamil Tanjung, Muhammad Fitriyadi
journal: TARBIYA ISLAMIA : Jurnal Pendidikan dan Keislaman
abstract: Artikel ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis konsep pengelolaan fasilitas dan infrastruktur pendidikan dari perspektif tafsir Al-Qur’an dan hadis. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode penelitian pustaka dengan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif. Data diperoleh dari ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an, hadis, karya-karya tafsir, serta literatur yang berkaitan dengan manajemen pendidikan Islam. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa prinsip-prinsip pengelolaan fasilitas dan infrastruktur pendidikan memiliki landasan yang kuat dalam ajaran Islam. Perencanaan tercermin dalam QS. title: Humanistic Da‘wah and Religious Freedom in QS. Al-Baqarah Verse 256: A Comparative Study of Quraish Shihab and Hamka’s Tafsir
authors: Nazaruddin Nazaruddin, Dwi Fitri, Muhammad Syahrial Razali Ibrahim
journal: Al-Mada: Jurnal Agama, Sosial, dan Budaya
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji konsep dakwah humanis yang terkandung dalam ayat 256 Surat Al-Baqarah melalui studi komparatif dua tafsir populer, yaitu Tafsir Al-Misbah karya Quraish Shihab dan Tafsir Al-Azhar karya Hamka. Penelitian bersifat kualitatif dengan pendekatan kepustakaan (library research), berupa analisis teks utama dan literatur pendukung untuk menggali pengertian, ruang lingkup, serta perbandingan penafsiran kedua mufassir terhadap ayat tersebut. Hasil analisis menunjukkan bahwa ayat 256 secara substantif menggambarkan prinsip dakwah humanis: penegakan ajaran Islam tanpa paksaan, bersikap santun, dan mengedepankan kebijaksanaan. Kedua tafsir sepakat menegaskan bahwa Islam menganjurka…

title: Nilai-Nilai Kecerdasan Sosial Dalam Al-Qur'an:Studi Tafsir Maudhȗ'i Terhadap Ayat-Ayat Relasi Antarmanusia
authors: Liia Ummu Rohmatul Ummah Sibghotallah, Salman Faris, Aldomi Putra
abstract: This article examines the values of social intelligence in the Qur'an through a thematic (maudhū'ī) tafsir approach to verses concerning human relations. The study is motivated by the contemporary crisis of social relations in the digital era polarization, disinformation, phubbing, and declining empathy which demands an ethical framework stronger than merely functional social skill. Using a qualitative, descriptive-analytical library research method, the study inventories verses on internal relations (family and kinship) and external relations (society, nation, and interfaith relations), traces their historical context and key semantic terms, and compares classical and contemporary exegetica…

title: توجيه القراءات في تفسير الصراط المستقيم في تبيان القرآن الكريم للإمام الكازروني (ت923ه) / Directing the Readings in AlKazruni’s “Tafsir AlSirat AlMustaqim fi Tibian AlQur’an Alkarim”
journal: مجلة القلم للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية (علميَّة - دوريًّة - محكَّمة)
abstract: يتناول هذا البحث: توجيه القراءات في تفسير الصراط المستقيم في تبيان القرآن الكريم للإمام الكازروني (ت923ه)، وقد جاء البحث في تمهيد ومبحثين وخاتمة، وقد جعلتُ التمهيد في الحديث عن علم التوجيه في تعريفه ونشأته، والمبحث الأول: في التعريف بالكازروني(ت 923ه) وتفسيره، ثم منهجه في توجيه القراءات، أما المبحث الثاني فكان في الدراسة التطبيقية حيث أوردت التوجيهات من تفسيره مرتبةً للآيات حسب ترتيب المصحف، وذكرتُ توجيه الكازروني للقراءة وبيانها من كتب التوجيه والتفسير، وقمتُ بعزو القراءات إلى أصحابها، وقد اتبعتُ في هذا البحث المنهج الاستقرائي التحليلي، وذلك باستقراء جميع المواضع التي ذكرها الكازروني في توجيه القراءة، وتخريجها وبيانها، ثم بيان منهجه في التوجيه. وقد توصل البحث إلى مجموعة من النتائج أبرزها: أ…

journal: مجلة القلم للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية (علميَّة - دوريًّة - محكَّمة)
abstract: مِن مصنفات الحافظ ابن الصلاح التي ذكرَتْها فهارس المكتبات كتابُ (التفسير الوجيز)، الذي لم يُطبع حتى ‏الآن، ويهدف هذا البحث لتحقيق نسبة هذا التفسير لابن ‏الصلاح، ويبيّن طرفًا من ملامحه، وذلك بعد تمهيد يسلّط فيه الضوء على النُّسَخ الخطية لهذا التفسير، ويشير لأسباب ‏عدم طبعه وعدم شهرته. ‏وقد اعتمدت في هذا البحث المنهج الاستقرائي، والمنهج الوصفي التحليلي.ومن أهم النتائج التي خرجت بها من هذا البحث:1. أثبتت الدراسة أن نسبة التفسير الوجيز لابن الصلاح ثابتة وقوية بناءً على عدة أدلة، منها: وجود اسم المؤلف على طُرَّة النسخة الخطية، كما أظهرت مقارنة مسائل التفسير الواردة في فتاويه مع ما ورد في التفسير الوجيز توافقًا دقيقًا.2. من المحتمل أن عدم شهرة التفسير يعود إلى كونه من مجالس الإملاء وليس عملًا تألي…

title: الفرق بين "المعنى" و"التفسير" عند الإمام الواحدي (ت:468هـ) في تفسيره "البسيط" / The Difference Between “Meaning” and “Interpretation” According to Imam al-Wahidi (d. 468 AH) in His Tafsir al-Basit
authors: أ. د. أحمد بن فارس السلوم
journal: مجلة القلم للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية (علميَّة - دوريًّة - محكَّمة)

title: تساؤلات الإمام القصّاب في تفسيره (نكت القرآن الدالة على البيان في أنواع العلوم والأحكام) وأجوبتها. / The Questions of Imam Al-Qassab in His Tafsir “Nukat Al-Qur’an Al-Dallah ‘ala Al-Bayan fi Anwa‘ Al-‘Ulum wa Al-Ahkam” and Their Answers
authors: أ. محمد بن عويد بن جزاع الظفيري

abstract: هدفت الدراسة إلى جمع ودراسة تساؤلات الإمام القصّاب وأجوبتها في تفسيره نكت القرآن الدالة على البيان، ودراستها، والوقوف على منهجه فيها، مع بيان صيغها ونوعها.وقد وقع الاختيار على تفسير الإمام القصّاب لما اتّسم به مؤلِّفه من رسوخ علمي وتضلّع في علوم التفسير، وفقه الأحكام، ودقائق اللغة العربية، وهي من الأسس اللازمة لإحكام فهم المعنى القرآني وصحّة الاستنباط.وقد احتوت الدراسة على مقدمة وتمهيد ومبحثين وخاتمة: احتوت المقدمة على الدراسات السابقة وأهداف البحث وأهمية الموضوع وأسباب اختياره، ومنهج البحث وهيكله.التمهيد ويشتمل على التعريف بالتساؤلات وأهميتها وأسباب إيرادها.وتحدث المبحث الأول عن أنواع التساؤلات وصيغها.وتحدث المبحث الثاني عن دراسة تطبيقية لبعض تساؤلات الإمام القصّاب وأجوبتها.وكان من أبرز نتا…

title: ترجيحات الإمام السبكي من خلال تفسيره " الدر النظيم في تفسير القرآن العظيم" في سورة الحديد، الآيات (1-10) جمعاً ودراسة / Imam Al-Subki's Preferences in His Tafsir "Al-Durr Al-Nazim fi Tafsir Al-Qur'an Al-Azim" in Surah Al-Hadid, Verses (1-10): Compilation and Study
authors: د. سميرة عبدالرحمن سعيد آل زاهب
journal: مجلة القلم للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية (علميَّة - دوريًّة - محكَّمة)
abstract: يهدف البحث إلى دراسة ترجيحات الإمام السبكي في تفسيره "الدر النظيم في تفسير القرآن العظيم" للآيات (1- 10) من سورة الحديد، اتبعت فيه المنهج الاستقرائي التحليلي، وقد انتظم البحث في مقدمة وثلاثة مباحث؛ الأول: للتعريف بالمؤلف وبكتابه، والثاني: لبيان منهج السبكي في الترجيح، والثالث: دراسة تطبيقية لترجيحات السبكي من خلال تفسيره لسورة الحديد (من الآية 1- 10).وقد توصلتُ إلى نتائج أهمها: أن منهج السبكي في ترجيحه للقول أن يذكر ألفاظ الترجيح الصريحة، أو يكتفي باستحسان القول، وأما عند تضعيفه للقول: فيصرح بالألفاظ الدالة على ذلك غالباً. وقد تناول البحث ثلاثة مواضع: الأول: رجح السبكي فيه أن سورة الحديد فيها مكي ومدني، والثاني: أن المراد بيوم الفتح هو فتح مكة، والثالث: أن معنى الميثاق الوارد في الآية: هو ما…

title: Implementasi Akad Murabahah pada BMT Artha Buana dalam Perspektif Tafsir Al-Ibriz tentang Ayat-Ayat Riba
authors: Fuad Ashari, M. Agus Mushodiq, Didik Kusno Aji Nugroho
journal: Lead Journal of Economy and Administration
abstract: This study was motivated by differing views regarding the practice of murabahah financing, which is considered by some members of the public to be similar to riba (usury). This study aims to analyze the implementation of murabahah financing at KSPPS BMT Artha Buana Metro, examine the interpretation of the Qur'anic verses on riba in Tafsir Al-Ibriz, and analyze the implementation of murabahah financing from the perspective of Tafsir Al-Ibriz. This research employed a qualitative approach using a field research design. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation. The research informants consisted of the Manager, Customer Service officer, and customers of KSPPS BMT Ar…

title: Analisis Tafsir Tarbawi terhadap Ketahanan Istri dalam Rumah Tangga dengan Suami Pecandu Narkoba
abstract: Ketahanan istri dalam rumah tangga dengan suami pecandu narkoba menjadi persoalan sosial yang kompleks karena melibatkan aspek psikologis, ekonomi, sosial, dan spiritual yang saling berkaitan. Kondisi suami yang mengalami ketergantungan narkoba sering menyebabkan ketidakharmonisan keluarga, beban ekonomi, serta tekanan emosional bagi istri, namun pada banyak kasus istri tetap memilih bertahan dalam rumah tangga. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis ketahanan istri dalam rumah tangga dengan suami pecandu narkoba melalui perspektif Tafsir Tarbawi, dengan menekankan nilai-nilai pendidikan Islam dalam keluarga seperti sabar, tawakal, tanggung jawab, dan kemaslahatan. Metode yang digunakan…

title: Hermeneutical Approaches to the Qur’an in Indonesia: A Normative and Socio-Cultural Analysis of Tafsir Methodologies
authors: Putris Salsabila Azkya, Siti Rif’atussa’adah Sitorus Pane, Rahmat Sholihin, Rahmat Shodiqin
journal: ASEAN Journal of Islamic Studies and Civilization (AJISC)
abstract: This article critically examines major hermeneutical approaches to the Qur’an in Indonesia traditional pesantren exegesis, Hamka’s contextual-nationalist tafsir, M. Quraish Shihab’s contextual-linguistic approach, and contemporary gender-sensitive hermeneutics through a normative framework combining bayāni, burhāni, and irfāni epistemologies and the maqāṣid al-sharīʿah. Using a normative library study and Gadamerian hermeneutical analysis, the paper evaluates methodological coherence, hermeneutical assumptions, and socio-cultural consequences of these approaches, particularly their implications for pluralism, religious moderation (wasāṭiyya), and gender justice in Indonesia. Findings indicat…

title: Justification by Faith in Romans 3:21–26: An Exegetical-Theological Study and Its Relevance to Legalism in the Indonesian Church
abstract: This study analyzes justification by faith in Romans 3:21–26 through an exegetical-theological approach and evaluates its relevance for addressing legalism in the Indonesian church. The study addresses tendencies to associate salvation with obedience to the Law, religious performance, and human works, thereby obscuring divine grace. It aims to elucidate Paul’s understanding of justification and demonstrate how this theological framework critically engages legalistic patterns in church life. Using a qualitative literature-based method and historical-grammatical analysis of the Greek text, supported by critical commentaries, the study finds that justification is grounded in δικαιοσύνη θεοῦ (th…

title: RELASI METODOLOGIS TADABBUR DAN TAFSIR KONTEMPORER: REFLEKSI, INTERNALISASI, DAN KONTEKSTUALISASI AL-QUR’AN
abstract: This study examines the methodological relationship between Qur’anic tadabbur and contemporary tafsir and clarifies their epistemological boundaries and contributions to understanding revelation. It employs qualitative library research. Primary sources include the Qur’an, Qawā‘id al-Tadabbur al-Amtsal li Kitābillāh, and works on tafsir methodology, while secondary sources comprise scholarly articles on tadabbur, maqāṣid al-Qur’an, Qur’anic pedagogy, and contemporary interpretation. The literature was classified into normative, conceptual-theoretical, and contemporary scholarly sources and analyzed through comparative content analysis across purpose, object, epistemic basis, analytical instru…

title: Kisah Israiliyyat dalam Tafsir Perspektif Ibnu Khaldun Pada Kitab al-Muqaddimah
abstract: This article discusses Israeliyyat's stories in Ibn Khaldun's perspective on the Muqaddimah book. Ibn Khaldun is an Islamic historian who is called the father of historiography, the father of economics, and also the father of sociology who has a monumental work entitled Muqaddimah. The thoughts of Ibn Khaldun are important treasures in unraveling various problems, including Israeliyyat's stories. Israeliyyat's stories is part of the ad-dakhil fi al-tafsir that reaps pro and contra. Studies of al-dakhil fi al-tafsir have been carried out by many scholars, which are generally carried out through a historical validation approach with a small portion of rational validation. Ibn Khaldun in his Mu…

title: Model Hermeneutika Friedrich Schleiermacher dan Relevasinya dengan Ilmu Tafsir Al-Qur’an
abstract: This article discusses the hermeneutics of F. Schleiermacher and its relevance to the science of interpretation of the Koran. The purpose of writing this article is to find out how explains Schleiermacher’s theory of hermeneutics with two theories namely grammatical and psychological hermeneutics and its relevances to the science of interpretation of the Koran. Writing this research using qualitative methods which is based on library research and is based on direct sources by Schleiermacher. The results obtained are that according to Schleiermacher hermeneutics should be applied to all disciplines and to get an objective meaning have to go two method its namely with the theory of grammatical…

title: Narasi Bias Gender Dalam Tafsir Nusantara
abstract: This paper departs from the interpretation of couples in heaven who are considered less friendly to women's groups. This paper discusses how the Nusantara interpreters interpret zauj as a partner in heaven. There are five books of interpretation chosen in this paper, namely Tafsir Marah Labid, Tafsir Al-Ibriz, Tafsir an-Nur, Tafsir Al-Azhar, and Tafsir Al-Misbah. To find out their views on the meaning of zauj as a partner in heaven, the author uses a historical approach. The results of this study conclude that the interpretation of Quraish Shihab in Tafsir Al-Misbah on the word zauj as a partner in heaven is much more gender-friendly than the previous commentators. If mapped, Nawawi al-Banta…

title: Makna Shihāb dalam Tafsir Kemenag
abstract: The interpretative paradigm occurs when the development of knowledge in various aspects. One of them happened in the interpretations issued by the Ministry of Religion. The discussion about the word shihāb provides a sharp spotlight for research. Even though it is still within the scope of the interpretation of the Ministry of Religion, it does not rule out the possibility of differences in interpretation because there are certain factors that surround it. The purpose of this paper is to dissect how the construction of interpretation and the dynamic process related to the word shihāb in the interpretation of the Ministry of Religion. Using the method of library research (Library Research) an…

title: Mendiskusikan Konstruksi Kritik Tafsir; Sejarah, Bentuk, Landasan Hukum, Prinsip dan Parameternya
abstract: This paper attempts to address the discourse of interpretive criticism; starting from the definition, history, legal basis to the principles and parameters of criticism. To get a clear description, a historical approach with descriptive-philosophical methods is used. This study comes to the conclusion that critique of interpretation is scientific and systematic steps to carry out analysis, and evaluation of the interpretation of the Qur'an. Normatively, the legal basis of interpretation criticism can be traced in the Qur'an, the Sunnah of the Prophet, the opinion of friends and scientific principles. As for the principles and parameters of interpretive criticism that need to be guided by bei…

title: Mendengar dalam Al-Qur’an: Studi Analisis tentang Keistimewaan As-Sam’u dalam QS. An-Nahl [16]: 78 Perspektif Tafsir al-Jawahir
abstract: This article talks about listening in the Al-Qur'an based on Tanthawi Jawhari's analysis of the privileges of as-Sam'u with al-Jawahir's interpretation. The potential of the five senses given by Allah Swt. to humans, even leading to the abyss of error. The sense of hearing plays a role in human life to reflect on this potential in order to create only goodness. This research method uses descriptive analysis obtained through library research, with relevant and reliable sources such as books, journals, theses, theses, dissertations, and so on. Before obtaining an understanding of the implications of this research, the author first describes the biography of Tanthawi Jawhari, and the profile of…

title: Tafsir Ilmi: Sejarah, Paradigma dan Dinamika Tafsir
abstract: Talking about science and technology, the presence of interpretation with a scientific style has become one of the interpretation trends in the modern and contemporary era. The spread of various interpretive works with a scientific style in the modern-contemporary era is often attributed to the widespread influence of the emergence of Tantawijauhari's (d. 1358 AH/1940 AD) magnum opus, al-Jawāhir fī Tafsīr al-Qur'an al-Karīm. Talking about the dynamics of scientific interpretation in Indonesia continues to develop. In the 1960s, Hasbi ash-Shiddieqiy's tafsir al-Nur began to use scientific discoveries in interpreting several verses of the Koran, although the number was still very small. The 19…

title: Meaning of Majnun in the Quran: A Socio-Historical Study through Tafsir al-Misbah
abstract: Prophet Muhammad is recognized as a figure of perfect moral character, even before being appointed as a prophet and messenger, yet during his mission he frequently faced opposition including accusations of being insane (majnun) which are recorded in the Quran as part of the polemics of the Quraysh disbelievers; a fundamental question arises as to how a man of the most exemplary character could be ridiculed as insane, while classical exegetes generally interpret majnun as mockery, semantic and socio-historical analysis reveals a more complex dynamic of meaning; the purpose of this article is to explore the meaning of majnun in the Quran through a socio-historical approach, emphasizing the dim…

title: Oral Tafsir and Household Harmony: The Perspective of Faizah Ali Syibromalisi
authors: Abdul Wahab Aladilissyafi, Farah Fauziyah Firdaus, Annisatul Luthfiyyah, Muhammad Uzaer Damairi
abstract: In the digital age, social media has become a new space for public figures to share their ideas including in the field of Quranic exegesis so that the authority over interpretation, which was previously dominated by male exegetes, has begun to shift with the emergence of female exegetes who are active in the digital public sphere. This study focuses on Faizah Ali Syibromalisi’s oral exegesis regarding the concept of domestic harmony, as presented through the YouTube channel Rumah Quran Amanah, with the aim of uncovering the contribution of women’s oral exegesis to the discourse on contemporary Muslim families. The research method employs a qualitative approach using Gadamer’s hermeneutic ana…

title: Penerapan Corak Tafsir Falsafi-Ontologis Terhadap Ayat Ketuhanan Dalam Surah Al-Ikhlas
abstract: Al-Qur’an was coming with two kinds of system, the textualizes system and contextualize system or Tafsir. While people tend to use Qur’anic Tafsir as what the hadith and shahabi said. Some of the Islamic scholar uses a new kind methodology to interpret the Qur’an. It leads us to a whole new kind of Tafsir in Islamic community and one of them is known as philosophical Tafsir. This methodology insists that Al-Qur’an can be interpreted with a philosophical view in it. After a while, this methodology is partially abandoned by the Islamic scholar and deemed as a wrong way to interpret the holy Qur’an. Within the century, the philosophical work gradually changes from rational skepticism to value f…

title: Catfishing as a Manifestation of Al-Khida: A Perspective from Tafsir al-Maraghi
authors: Ulfatunnisa Ulfatunnisa, Endang Saiful Anwar, Ina Salmah Febriani
abstract: The rapid expansion of digital communication has transformed patterns of social interaction while creating new opportunities for identity manipulation in cyberspace. One of the increasingly prevalent phenomena is catfishing, the use of fictitious online identities to deceive others for emotional, social, or personal gain. Despite extensive discussions on the psychological and social consequences of catfishing, its ethical and theological dimensions remain underexplored within Quranic studies. This article aims to examine the concept of al-khida’ in the Quran through the perspective of Tafsir al-Maraghi by Aḥmad Mustafa al-Maraghi and to analyze its relevance to contemporary catfishing practi…

title: KONSEP AZWĀJ DAN FENOMENA LGBT DALAM PERSPEKTIF AL-QUR’AN: STUDI KOMPARATIF TAFSIR AL-MISBAH KARYA M. QURAISH SHIHAB DAN TAFSIR AL-AZHAR KARYA HAMKA
abstract: This study aims to analyze the interpretations of M. Quraish Shihab in Tafsir Al-Misbah and HAMKA in Tafsir Al-Azhar regarding the concept of azwāj (pairs) and its correlation with the phenomenon of LGBT. This study employs a qualitative method using library research and a comparative Qur’anic exegesis approach. The findings indicate that both exegetes view the concept of azwāj as a divine principle of creation established by Allah, which serves as a foundation for understanding relationships between men and women. Quraish Shihab tends to adopt a contextual approach by considering linguistic, theological, and social aspects, whereas HAMKA places greater emphasis on a normative approach groun…

title: Reconstructing Islamic Financial Accountability through Thematic Qur'anic Interpretation / Membangun Kembali Akuntabilitas Keuangan Islam Melalui Tafsir Al-Qur’an Tematik
journal: Islamia: Jurnal Tradisi dan Masyarakat Islam Indonesia
abstract: This study reconstructs the normative foundations of Islamic financial accountability through thematic Qur'anic interpretation and proposes the Qur'anic Financial Accountability Framework. It uses qualitative library research to examine selected verses alongside classical and contemporary commentaries and scholarship on Islamic accounting and governance. The analysis relates tawḥīd as the theological foundation, amānah as entrusted responsibility, kitābah as documentary evidence, mīzān as justice and balance, ḥisāb as accountability, and maṣlaḥah as a welfare-oriented evaluative purpose. These dimensions form an order of normative justification, rather than an empirically demonstrated causal…

title: Rekonstruksi Makna Tradisi Bhan Ghiban dalam Pernikahan Madura Perspektif Tafsir Maudhu'i
abstract: This study aims to reconstruct the meaning of the Bhan Ghiban tradition in Madurese marriage through a thematic (maudhu'i) interpretation of Qur'anic verses concerning marital responsibility and maintenance (nafkah). Employing a qualitative library research design, the study combines thematic Qur'anic exegesis with socio-cultural analysis of the Bhan Ghiban tradition. Data were collected from the Qur'an, classical and contemporary tafsir literature, and scholarly works on Madurese marriage customs. The findings reveal that Bhan Ghiban, as the presentation of household goods from the groom's family to the bride, symbolizes the husband's readiness to fulfill his financial obligations and estab…

title: Validation of Indonesian Qur’anic Exegesis on Isrā’ Mi‘rāj
abstract: The difference in the ambition of sanctification is evident in the validation of the Isrā’ Mi‘rāj event between Tafsir Ilmi Kemenag and Nalar Ayat-Ayat Semesta, written by Agus Purwanto. Both share the same interpretive orientation but arrive at different conclusions in interpreting the events of Isrā’ Mi‘rāj. This study aims to analyze and elucidate the validation patterns and epistemological reasoning employed in Tafsir Ilmi Kemenag and Nalar Ayat-Ayat Semesta. This study employs a qualitative approach using a descriptive-comparative design to compare these two works. The research was analyzed using content analysis techniques with ‘Ābid al-Jābirī’s epistemological reasoning typology as th…

title: The Phenomenon of Abstaining from Voting (*Golput*) and the Responsibility of Choosing a Leader: An Analytical Study of Surah Al-Baqarah Verse 247 from the Perspective of Quraish Shihab / FENOMENA GOLONGAN PUTIH (GOLPUT) DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB MEMILIH PEMIMPIN
abstract: The phenomenon of the White Group (golput), referring to abstention from voting in general elections, is part of the dynamics of democracy in Indonesia. It reflects the decision of eligible voters not to exercise their voting rights. This phenomenon emerges as a manifestation of dissatisfaction with the existing political system, leadership candidates, and the democratic process. This article aims to analyze the phenomenon of golput from the perspective of the Qur'an through an examination of Surah Al-Baqarah (2:247), based on Tafsir Al-Misbah by M. Quraish Shihab. This study employs a library research method with a descriptive-analytical approach, examining relevant literature sources. The …

title: Ecological Values in the Quran: A Maqasidi Tafsir Perspective
authors: Maisaroh Siregar, Fauzi Nasrullah, Yoga Pratama, Novriadi Novriadi, M. Raffi Juliano
abstract: Environmental degradation and climate change have become global challenges that require strong ethical, moral, and spiritual foundations to support environmental preservation efforts. As the primary source of Islamic teachings, the Quran contains numerous principles that emphasize human responsibility in maintaining ecological balance and environmental sustainability. This article aims to analyze the ecological values embedded in the Quran through a maqasidi tafsīr perspective and to examine their relevance to contemporary environmental conservation. The study employs a qualitative method using a content analysis approach. Primary data consist of Quranic verses related to environmental issue…

title: Metodologi Tafsir al-Munir Karya AGH Daud Ismail
authors: Hasani Ahmad Said, Muh. Akbar Nasrulah, Desvia Nur Syafitri, Alif Ardianto
abstract: One of the interpretations of the Qur’an using the local language is Tafsir al-Munir by AGH. Daud Ismail who is a great scholar from the land of Bugis who first interpreted the Qur'an as a whole. He presents a Buginese Interpretation so that the divine messages contained in the Qur'an can be understood by the wider community, especially the Bugis community. This research is a qualitative research that is descriptive in nature, at least provides an overview regarding AGH. Daud Ismail and the characteristics of his interpretation and the application of his interpretation with the Tahlili method. The approach used in this research is linguistics, interpretation science approach, and social appr…

title: Sikap Sayyid Qutb terhadap Tafsir Ilmi
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: The modern era is a time when the interpretation of ilmi develops so rapidly. The appearance of this style of interpretation cannot be separated from the supporters or those who reject it. At this time also, many researchers and even scholars debated the views of Sayyid Qutb on the ilmi interpretation. This article seeks to examine and reveal how Sayyid Qutbs views on the tafsir ilmi style and how he interpreted the kauniyah verses. This type of research includes library research (library research) with a qualitative research approach. The main source of this research is his tafsir book Fi Zilal al Quran. This article then shows the conclusion that Sayyid Qutb is inconsistent between his the…

title: Transformasi Sosial dalam QS. ad-Duḥā [93]:4 dan Teori Peradaban Ibnu Khaldun:
authors: Khamim Jazuli Ahmad, Binti Khabibatur R.A, Lintang Dewi Fi’liya Putri
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Artikel ini berangkat dari kegelisahan akademik atas dikotomi studi Islam kontemporer, di mana tafsir Al-Qur’an sering berhenti pada dimensi normatif-spiritual, sementara teori sosial klasik seperti pemikiran Ibnu Khaldun cenderung dibaca secara historis-deskriptif tanpa integrasi dengan pesan teologis. Padahal, umat Islam saat ini menghadapi krisis multidimensi, seperti disintegrasi sosial, krisis kepemimpinan, dan melemahnya orientasi spiritual, yang menuntut pendekatan integratif. QS. ad-Duḥā [93]:4 dipilih karena memuat paradigma optimisme teologis dan janji ilahi tentang perbaikan pasca-krisis. Sementara itu, teori siklus peradaban dalam Al-Muqaddimah menjelaskan dinamika naik-turun per…

title: Ghadul Bashar (Menahan Pandangan) sebagai Strategi Preventif Konten Seksual terhadap Perilaku Remaja dalam Perspektif Al-Qur’an
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Paparan konten seksual di era digital telah menjadi tantangan serius terhadap psikologi remaja. Di sisi lain dari pesatnya perkembangan teknologi seperti media sosial tidak selalu memberikan dampak positif sepenuhnya, yang mana dapat menimbulkan peluang kejahatan seksual dan perilaku menyimpang di dunia maya berupa memperlihatkan aksi berlebihan guna menarik perhatian para penonton dari kalangan remaja. Namun sebaliknya jika remaja mampu memanfaatkan dengan bijak, maka juga akan berdampak baik bagi diri mereka sendiri maupun orang lain. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode literature review (kepustakaan). Data dikumpulkan dari berbagai artikel, fenomena di media sosial, dan referensi yang berka…

title: Implementasi Konsep Nāsikh Mansukh dalam Peradilan Pelaku Zina di Provinsi Nanggroe Aceh Darussalam
authors: Muhhamad zainal abidin, Vina Shonifah Al-Atqiya', Mega Nursanggita, Muhammad Thohir, Moch. Muwaffiqillah
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Nāsikh dan Mansukh merupakan salah satu konsep dalam studi Al-Qur’an yang memiliki peranan penting dalam perubahan hukum dari masa ke masa. Salah satu pembahasan yang cukup menarik dalam konteks negara Indonesia adalah usaha penerapan hukuman rajam bagi pelaku zina di Provinsi Nanggroe Aceh Darussalam (NAD). Nanggroe Aceh Darussalam (NAD) adalah provinsi yang menerapkan hukuman pidana Islam di Indonesia. Salah satu hukum yang dijalankan adalah peradilan bagi pelaku zina dengan cara dicambuk. Dikursus mengenai kemungkinan penerapan hukuman rajam di Aceh atau peradilan bagi pelaku zina yang telah dijalankan di Aceh menjadi bahan perdebatan di kalangan akademisi. Artikel ini bertujuan untuk men…

title: Analisis Tekstual Riwayat dalam Tafsir Al-Qummi:
authors: Sapriadi Sapri, Ahmad Ashfa Fakhrunnabil, Hanik Rosyida
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Literatur tafsir klasik tidak jarang mengandung unsur-unsur komponen infiltratif yang mendistorsi makna otentik teks Al-Qur'an. Studi ini meneliti penafsiran Ali ibn Ibrahim al-Qummi pada Surah Āli ʿImrān ayat 104 dalam Tafsir al-Qummi, salah satu karya penafsiran Syiah Imamiyya paling awal yang disusun pada abad ke-3 H. Penafsiran al-Qummi merujuk pada dua riwayat yang digunakan sebagai sumber penafsiran utama: satu dapat disandarkan kepada Imam al-Sadiq melalui al-Qummi, dan yang kedua dapat ditelusuri ke Imam al-Baqir melalui Abu al-Jarud, kompleksitas yang sangat penting untuk mengevaluasi kredibilitas riwayah pada ayat ini. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dan teori al-ashil…

title: Tafsir Tematik Al-Qur'an tentang Pelestarian Warisan Intelektual Islam melalui Digitalisasi Teks Keagamaan
authors: Muhammad Farrel Azka Suwito, Ida Novianti, Rismaya Ainul Masthuro, Robiah Sumayya, Muhammad Ali Mustofa Kamal
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Perkembangan teknologi digital telah mendorong transformasi besar dalam pelestarian dan transmisi warisan intelektual Islam. Namun, kajian tentang digitalisasi teks keagamaan masih jarang dikaitkan dengan konsep jihad dalam perspektif Al-Qur’an. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis digitalisasi teks keagamaan Islam sebagai bentuk kontemporer jihad al-‘ilm (jihad intelektual) berdasarkan pendekatan tafsir tematik Al-Qur’an. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif berbasis studi pustaka dengan pendekatan tafsīr maudhū‘ī serta teori transformasi digital keilmuan Islam untuk membaca relasi antara wahyu, transmisi ilmu, dan teknologi digital. Data diperoleh dari ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an, kitab tafsi…

title: Transformasi Sosial dalam QS. ad-Duḥā [93]:4 dan Teori Peradaban Ibnu Khaldun:
authors: Khamim Jazuli Ahmad, Binti Khabibatur R.A, Lintang Dewi Fi’liya Putri

title: Motif Sosio-Politik Az-Zamakhsyari Pada Penafsiran Al-Kasyaf:
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Pelabelan al-Kashshaf karya al-Zamakhsyari sebagai tafsir sektarian (Mu‘tazilah) selama ini didominasi oleh klasifikasi teologis-dogmatis Ignaz Goldziher yang cenderung mengabaikan konteks sosial-politik di mana karya tersebut diproduksi. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengungkap motif sosial-politik di balik penafsiran al-Zamakhsyari serta meninjau ulang validitas label sektarian tersebut. Dengan pendekatan kualitatif berbasis studi kepustakaan, penelitian ini menggunakan Analisis Wacana Kritis (Critical Discourse Analysis) dari Norman Fairclough yang mencakup tiga dimensi: analisis teks (fitur linguistik, pilihan kata, dan struktur argumentasi), praktik diskursif (produksi, distribusi, dan…

title: AL-DAKHIL FI AL-TAFSIR (Kajian Kritik atas Penafsiran Ustadz Syaiful Karim terhadap QS. Al-Qori’ah)
authors: Early Ferlyta Dian Anggraini, Auliya Hijriyati
journal: MAGHZA: Jurnal Ilmu Al-Qur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: Penafsiran Al-Qur’an di era kontemporer kerap diwarnai oleh berbagai pendekatan, termasuk penggunaan unsur-unsur asing (al-dakhil) yang dapat memengaruhi keotentikan tafsir. Penelitian ini mengkaji secara kritis penafsiran Ustadz Syaiful Karim terhadap Surah Al-Qari’ah, dengan fokus pada identifikasi potensi al-dakhil dalam penafsirannya. Kajian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif-deskriptif dengan metode analisis konten terhadap ceramah Ustadz Syaiful Karim di platform YouTube, serta pembandingan dengan kitab-kitab tafsir klasik seperti Jami' al-Bayan 'an Ta'wil Ayi al-Qur'an karya Imam al-Thabari, Tafsir al-Qur'an al-'Azhim karya Ibnu Katsir, hingga Mafatih al-Ghaib karya Fakhruddin al-R…

title: Analysis of the Impact of the Theory of Substantial Motion on the Interpretation of the Verses of Creation in Tafsir al-Qur’an al-Karim by Mulla Sadra
authors: Masoud Khazaei khalilabad, Abdolreza Jamalzadeh, Hossein Yazdi
abstract: In Tafsir al-Qur’an al-Karim by Mulla Sadra, the theory of Substantial Motion ( al-harakah al-jawhariyyah ) not only plays a key role in explaining the verses of creation but also exerts a fundamental influence on his interpretive approach toward these verses. This theory guides Mulla Sadra’s perspective away from a literal and static understanding of creation toward a dynamic and continuous conception of existence. Based on his understanding of Substantial Motion , which emphasizes “the continuous movement of existence, the intrinsic renewal of being, and the instability of essences,” Mulla Sadra interprets the Qur’anic verses related to “the emergence of human states and transformations” a…

title: The Meaning of “Messenger” in Verse 96 of Surah Taha According to Tafsir al-Mizan
authors: Ali Iranmanesh, Abbas Esmailizadeh, Mohammad Hassan Rostami
abstract: There are verses in the Holy Qur’an whose referents are not explicitly clear, leading commentators to present various interpretations. One such verse is: “He said, ‘I perceived what they did not perceive, so I took a handful from the trace of the Messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me.’” (Taha, 20:96). This verse records the response of the Samiri to the question of Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) regarding the calf worship practiced by the Children of Israel. The present study seeks to investigate the identity of “the trace of the Messenger” (athar al-rasul) from the perspective of exegetes—particularly ‘Allamah Ṭabāṭabā’ī—using a descriptive-analytical method. In addressi…

title: Simbol Dalam Al-Qur’an; Kajian Tafsir Semiologis tentang Cahaya dalam Al-Qur’an Surah An-Nur Ayat 35 dalam Kitab Misykat Al-Anwar Karya Imam Al-Ghazali
authors: Muhammad Kalamshah, M. Taufik, Abdul Karim
journal: Wathan: Jurnal Ilmu Sosial dan Humaniora
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji makna simbolik kata nur (cahaya) dalam QS. An-Nur [24]: 35 melalui pendekatan tafsir semiologis dalam kitab Misykat al-Anwar karya Imam al-Ghazali. Tujuannya adalah menjelaskan penggunaan nur sebagai tamtsil dalam Al-Qur'an, memetakan epistemologi tafsir sufistik al-Ghazali, dan menganalisis hubungan antara Tuhan, alam semesta, dan jiwa manusia dalam sistem simbol cahaya. Penelitian ini merupakan studi kepustakaan kualitatif dengan teknik deskriptif-analitis. Data utama berasal dari Misykat al-Anwar, dilengkapi literatur tafsir dan kajian tentang pemikiran al-Ghazali. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa al-Ghazali menempatkan Allah sebagai satu-satunya Cahaya Hakiki (a…

title: RECONSTRUCTING QUR’AN-BASED DIGITAL COMMUNICATION ETHICS: A THEMATIC TAFSIR ANALYSIS OF QS. AL-HUJURAT VERSES 11–13 FOR STRENGTHENING CHARACTER EDUCATION
authors: Sintong Tampubolon, Derri Adi Fernando, Afdhal Ilahi
abstract: The advancement of digital communication has generated a range of ethical challenges, including cyberbullying, insults, negative labeling, the dissemination of unverified information, privacy violations, digital ghibah (backbiting), polarization, and discrimination. These challenges call for an ethical framework that is not merely technical in nature but is also firmly grounded in Islamic values. This study aims to reconstruct a Qur’an-based digital communication ethics framework through a thematic analysis of Qur’anic interpretation of QS. Al-Hujurat verses 11–13 and to examine its relevance to strengthening character education. This qualitative study employs a library research approach usi…

title: Seven Earths in the Qur’anic Worldview: An Epistemological Study of Classical and Modern Tafsir
abstract: Purpose – Cosmological verses of the Qur’an have long been a point of convergence and tension between Qur’anic exegesis and modern scientific thought. Among these, QS. At-Talaq [65]:12 is unique in referring to the “seven earths” (wa mina al-arḍi mithlahunna). This study aims to compare the interpretations of the concept of the seven earths in the exegeses of Ibn Kathīr and Ibn ‘Āshūr and to examine their epistemological implications for contemporary studies of Qur’anic cosmology. Design/methodology/approach – This study employs a qualitative descriptive-comparative approach based on library research. Primary data consist of the exegetical works of Ibn Kathīr and Ibn ‘Āshūr, which are analyz…

title: TAFSIR DAN CYBERFEMINISM DI MEDIA SOSIAL
authors: Fuad Fansuri, Muhammad Fakih, Afita Nur Hayati, Misbahul Ramadhani, Rabi'atul Husni
journal: JURNAL DARUSSALAM: Pemikiran Hukum Tata Negara dan Perbandingan Mazhab
abstract: This article attempts to examine how feminist issues are disseminated through interpretation practices on virtual social media, a domain that has long been monopolized by men. Men are considered the primary actors in efforts to interpret holy verses. Consequently, there is a proliferation of gender-biased religious narratives promoted on social media. These narratives are predominantly dominated by a textual paradigm without regard for the context of the referenced verses, resulting in a biased delivery of the verses' core messages. This study employs a discourse analysis approach utilizing documentation techniques and library research. The primary data used as a reference in this study cons…

title: KOSMOLOGI QUR’ANI DALAM SURAH AL-NAḤL: ANALISIS TAFSIR ILMIAH PERSPEKTIF ZAGHLŪL AL-NAJJĀR
abstract: Abstract: Modern ecological crises indicate that environmental problems are not merely technical in nature, but are also closely related to humanity’s worldview toward the universe. In this context, the Qur’an, through āyāt kawniyyah, namely verses that contain signs of God’s power through natural and cosmic phenomena, offers a cosmological perspective that views nature as an orderly, meaningful, and functional system in sustaining life. This study aims to analyze the concept of Qur’anic cosmology in Surah al-Naḥl through the scientific exegesis approach from the perspective of Zaghlūl al-Najjār. This research is a qualitative study employing a descriptive-analytical method through library r…

title: FENOMENA API DI DASAR LAUT DALAM TAFSIR AL-JAWAHIR FI AL-QUR’AN AL-KARIM DAN AL-AYAT AL-KAUNIYYAH FI-AL-QUR’AN AL-KARIM
authors: Mohammad Fattah, Ike Syamsiah Arif Saputri, Wardatus Syarifah, Dwi Yuliani
abstract: Natural phenomena are extraordinary events that occur naturally without human intervention. They arise from various causes, such as changes in weather, movements of the Earth, or other natural processes. One such phenomenon that occurs on the seabed is the presence of flames on the ocean floor that cannot be extinguished, even though the temperature exceeds 1,000 degrees Celsius. This natural phenomenon is in harmony with the words of Allah SWT in Surah Al-Tur verse 6 and Surah Al-Takwir verse 6. The purpose of this study in examining the phenomenon of the seabed is to identify the similarities and differences in the interpretations of Tantawi Jauhari and Zaghlul Al-Najjar with reference to …

title: TAFSIR KEPEMIMPINAN KOLEKTIF DI PESANTREN MODERN: ANALISIS AYAT-AYAT KEPEMIMPINAN AL-QUR’AN
abstract: This study examines the application of collective leadership in modern Islamic boarding schools (pesantren) based on a thematic analysis of Qur'anic verses in Hamka's Tafsir Al-Azhar. Traditional Islamic boarding school leadership, centered on the Kyai (Islamic scholars), now faces the challenge of adopting a more participatory approach to respond to social and educational developments. This study aims to explore collective leadership values that align with Islamic principles, such as deliberation, justice, and shared responsibility. This study uses a qualitative approach with a literature review method, focusing on Hamka's interpretation of verses relevant to the concept of collective leade…

title: Sheikh Muhammad al-Khal's choices in his exegesis (Tafsir al-Khal) - Part One as a model
abstract: The Kurds and their scholars have made a significant contribution to serving Islam in all its aspects, especially the scientific and cognitive aspect. Among the prominent Kurds who have a long history in this service is the scholarly sheikh, social reformer, interpreter judge, and linguist: Sheikh Muhammad Ali Amin Al-Khal. His interpretation (Tafsir al-Khal) was one of the most important works of the Sheikh. He wrote it in the Kurdish language and interpreted eight parts of the Holy Qur’an. It was the first interpretation printed in the Kurdish language. Through it, he wanted to help the Kurdish reader understand the Book of God Almighty, contemplate it, and act upon it. In his interpretati…

title: Reflection The thought of the Islamic Reform School in Tafsir Khal (An analytical descriptive study)
abstract: The impact of the Islamic reform school on Sheikh Muhammad Al-Khal's understanding of Al-Khal is the subject of this study. The researcher describes the Islamic reform school and outlines the main tenets of its approach to Islamic reform and social transformation in the first part. The concepts of the reform school and their effect on Sheikh Muhammad Al-Khal's writings in general and Al-Khal's interpretation in particular are discussed in the second section. The final section highlights the key conclusions that the researcher came to after examining Al-Khal's interpretation and discusses Al-Khal's technique in social change and the rebirth of Islamic philosophy.

title: CONTEMPORARY SHIA TAFSIR STUDIES: AN ANALYSIS OF MUHAMMAD HĀDĪ MA'RIFAH'S THOUGHT ON NASAKH VERSE OF BEATING IN NUSYUZ / Contemporary Shia Tafsir Studies: an Analysis of Muhammad Hādī Ma'rifah's Thought on Nasakh Verse of Beating in Nusyuz
authors: Is'ad Durrotun Nabilah, Ahmad Fauzan Zahri
abstract: This study discusses Muhammad Hādī Ma'rifah's view on the permission to hit in Surah al-Nisāʾ verse 34 which he believes has undergone a gradual nasakh (abrogation). In the context of nusyuz, one of the solutions mentioned is beating, but with very strict limits so as not to injure and more intended as a symbol of warning, not a form of violence. According to Muhammad Hādī Ma'rifah, this permission to hit has been removed through a gradual approach, along with Islam's emphasis on the value of compassion and respect for women's dignity. The research method used is qualitative with the type of research applied is library research. The main source of literature in this research is the Book of S…

title: Rekonstruksi Tafsir Ayat Mut'ah dan Nafkah Iddah Bagi Perlindungan Hak Finansial Perempuan Pasca Cerai Gugat
authors: Misbahul Munir, M Sholahuddin Al Ayyubiy, Munirah
abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk merekonstruksi penafsiran ayat-ayat mut’ah dan nafkah iddah dalam Al-Qur'an guna merespons dinamika hukum keluarga Islam kontemporer di Indonesia, khususnya terkait perlindungan hak finansial perempuan pasca-gugat cerai (khuluk). Secara normatif-klasik, gugat cerai berimplikasi pada gugurnya hak finansial istri karena perceraian dianggap bersumber dari pihak perempuan. Namun, seiring meningkatnya kasus gugat cerai di Indonesia, posisi ekonomi perempuan pasca-perkawinan menjadi sangat rentan. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode yuridis-normatif dengan pendekatan konseptual dan hermeneutika tafsir maqashidi serta mubadalah. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pembat…

title: ABU LAYS SAMARQANDIYNING ILMIY FAOLIYATI VA TAFSIR ILMIGA QO‘SHGAN HISSASI
journal: Central Asian Journal of Academic Research
abstract: Mazkur maqolada buyuk alloma, hanafiy mazhabining yetuk faqihi, muhaddis va mufassiri Abu Lays Samarqandiyning hayoti, ilmiy faoliyati hamda tafsir ilmiga qo‘shgan ulkan hissasi yoritiladi. Maqolada allomaning to‘liq nomi, kunyasi, taxalluslari, tug‘ilgan va vafot etgan yillari, yashagan davr ijtimoiy-siyosiy muhiti, ustozlari va shogirdlari, ilmiy merosi, xususan, tafsir sohasidagi asarlari tahlil qilinadi. Abu Lays Samarqandiyning "Bahr al-ulum" tafsiri va boshqa asarlari orqali Qur'on ma'nolarini xalq ommasiga yetkazish, tafsir ilmini rivojlantirish, unda axloqiy-ma'naviy tarbiya masalalariga alohida e'tibor qaratish kabi jihatlar o‘rganiladi. Shuningdek, allomaning fiqh, aqoid, tasavvuf …

title: DEVELOPMENT OF THE SCIENCE OF FIQH AND TAFSIR IN ISLAMIC STUDIES
journal: Eurasian Journal of Social Sciences, Philosophy and Culture
abstract: The article talks about the processes of development of the science of fiqh, tafsir in Islamic teachings, official and unofficial attempts to systematize the rules of Sharia. The role of collective ijtihad in the development of Islamic law was also discussed.

title: Kinayah Dalam Al-Qur'an Studi Tafsir Asyamil Fi Balaghatil Qur'an / KINAYAH IN THE QUR'AN STUDY OF TAFSIR ASYAMIL FI BALAGHATIL QUR'AN
authors: Aulia Anggun, Muhammad Tauhid, Ahmad Muttaqin
abstract: Penelitian ini mengangkat tema tentang Kinayah Dalam Al-Qur'an Studi Tafsir Asyamil Fi Balaghatil Qur'an, Salahsatu aspek yang penting dikaji dalam ilmu balaghah adalah kinayah selain kerumitan dalam memahami maknanya kinayah juga berpotensi multitafsir bagi para pembaca. Tafsir yang dikaji adalah tafsir Asyamil Fi Balaghatil Qur'an yang khusus membahas tentang Balaghah dalam Al-Qur'an. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui makna kinayah yang terdapat dalam Tafsir tersebut dan Bagaimana metode Afifuddin Dimyati dalam menafsirkan ayat kinayah dalam kitabnya serta alasan mengapa Afifuddin Dimyati menafsirkan ayat kinayah dengan berbagai macam makna. Penelitian ini merupakan Penelitian Libr…

title: A Membaca QS Al-Rum/30: 1-5: Dari Tafsir Taḥlilī, Sosial Politik, Hingga Late Antequity / REINTERPRETASI QS AL-RŪM/30: 1-5MELALUITAFSIR TAḤLĪLĪ,LATE ANTEQUITYDAN TEOLOGI POLITIK
authors: Muh. Awaluddin A, Amir Hamzah, Muhammad Tajuddin, Samsuddin Kade, M. Iqbal Nasir
abstract: Abstrak Penelitian ini mengkaji QS Al-Rum/30: 1-5 dengan menekankan pada analisis konteks late antiquity dan sosial politik. Penelitian ini termasuk kategori penelitian kepustakaan (library research) dengan pendekatan kualitatif. Kajian difokuskan pada analisis dan tekstual terhadap ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an dengan menggunakan metode taḥlīlī. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan late antiquity serta teori Gramsci mengenai mobilisasi agama dalam politik. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa analisis QS Al-Rūm/30: 1-5 menunjukkan bahwa ayat-ayat tersebut tidak hanya merekam peristiwa historis peperangan antara Romawi dan Persia, tetapi juga menegaskan prinsip teologis bahwa seluruh urusan berada di t…

title: PARADIGM OF CONTEXTUAL TAFSIR IN MAHMUD SYALTUT’S TAFSĪR AL-QUR’ĀN AL-KARĪM: A METHODOLOGICAL ANALYSIS
authors: Ilyas Thahir, Abd. Bashir Fatmal, Hamka Ilyas, Ekawati Hamzah
abstract: This article examines the paradigm of contextual interpretation in Tafsīr al-Qur’ān al-Karīm by Shaykh Mahmud Syaltut, one of the most influential reformist scholars of the modern Islamic world. The study aims to analyze the methodological foundations that shape Syaltut’s approach to Qur’anic interpretation, particularly in responding to social change, modern challenges, and the need for religious moderation. While classical tafsir often emphasizes linguistic, legal, and theological dimensions, Syaltut introduces a contextual and rational framework that integrates textual fidelity with socio-historical realities. Using a qualitative library-based research design, this study employs a philoso…

title: ULIL AMRI DALAM TAFSIR SUNNI DAN SYIAH ( STUDI KOMPARATIF AN-NUKAT WA AL-‘UYUN DAN AL-MIZAN FI TAFSIR AL-QUR’AN)
authors: Masayu Nisa Malihah, Bukhori Abdul Shomad, Septiawadi Kari Mukmin
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji konsep ulil amri dari sudut pandang tafsir Sunni dan Syiah melalui studi perbandingan antara buku An-Nukat wa al-'Uyun karya Abu al-Hasan al-Mawardi dan buku Al-Mizan fi Tafsir al-Qur'an karya Muhammad Husain Thabathaba'i. Penelitian ini berfokus pada tafsir Surah An-Nisa', ayat 59 dan 83, yang berkaitan dengan kewenangan kepemimpinan dalam Islam. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis persamaan, perbedaan, dan latar belakang pemikiran kedua mufasir tersebut dalam memahami konsep ulil amri. Metode yang digunakan adalah penelitian pustaka dengan pendekatan kualitatif-komparatif. Data primer bersumber dari kedua buku tersebut, sedangkan data sekunder diperoleh dari…

title: TAFSIR HADIS EKOLOGIS: STUDI ATAS HADIS- HADIS PELESTARIAN ALAM SEBAGAI SINTAS KEBENCANAAN
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji tafsir hadis ekologis: studi atas hadis-hadis pelestarian alam sebagai sintas kebencanaan, untuk mengetahui; (1) pandangan Islam terhadap pelestarian alam dalam hadis-hadis Nabi Muhammad SAW; (2) tafsir hadis ekologis dapat menjadi dasar untuk sintas kebencanaan; dan (3) relevansi hadis ekologis sebagai sintas kebencanaan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif berbasis studi pustaka (library research. Metode analisis yang digunakan adalah content analysis (analisis isi) melalui pendekatan tafsir tematik (tafsīr maudhū‘ī). Berdasarkan hasil analisis dapat disimpulkan bahwa pertama, Islam memandang pelestarian alam sebagai bagian dari misi keberagamaan yang u…

title: Tafsir Al-Quran Dalam Serial Film Bida’ah: Analisis Wacana Keagamaan dan Relasi Kuasa
journal: Journal of Ulumul Qur'an and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This study is motivated by the growing representation of Qur'anic interpretive authority in popular cultural products, particularly religious series, which have the potential to shape public religious understanding yet are rarely examined critically in terms of their discourse and power relations. The series Bida'ah was chosen as the object of study because it portrays a singular interpretive practice by the character Walid, which is used to legitimize his domination over his followers. This study describes the forms of Qur'anic interpretation that appear in the series, uncovers the ideological discourse constructed in its interpretive dialogues, and analyzes the power relations operating be…

title: SEMIOSIS SIMBOL KOSMOS DALAM AQSĀM AL-QUR'AN(QS. AL-BURŪJ, AL-FAJR, DAN ASY-SYAMS): Analisis Semiotika Peirce
authors: Dede Kurniawan, Wildan Taufik, Edi Komarudin
journal: Journal of Ulumul Qur'an and Tafsir Studies
abstract: Penelitian ini mengkaji simbol-simbol kosmos yang berfungsi sebagai muqsam bih dalam ayat-ayat sumpah QS. al-Burūj, QS. al-Fajr, dan QS. Asy-Syams. Kajian aqsām al-Qur’ān sebelumnya cenderung menekankan aspek kebahasaan, retoris, dan penafsiran, sedangkan kajian semiotika sering menganalisis simbol secara terpisah. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengungkap makna kosmologis yang terbentuk melalui hubungan antarsimbol dengan menggunakan teori semiotika Charles Sanders Peirce, khususnya konsep representamen, object, dan interpretant. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode studi kepustakaan. Data primer berupa ayat-ayat sumpah yang dipilih dari ketiga surah, sedangkan data seku…

title: Karakteristik Penafsiran Ayat-Ayat Halal dalam Tafsir Unisba
authors: Ahmad Mudakir, Muhammad Fadhli Muttaqien, Muhammad Rafki Razif Kiransyah, Balqies Aulia Zhia Ulhaq
journal: Journal of Ulumul Qur'an and Tafsir Studies
abstract: Ayat-ayat tentang halal dalam Al-Qur'an memuat petunjuk mendasar yang mengatur pelbagai dimensi kehidupan manusia. Kajian mengenai karakteristik penafsiran ayat-ayat halal dalam produk tafsir perguruan tinggi, khususnya Tafsir Universitas Islam Bandung (Tafsir Unisba), masih sangat terbatas. Penelitian kepustakaan kualitatif ini bertujuan menganalisis penafsiran ayat-ayat halal dalam Tafsir Unisba serta mendeskripsikan karakteristik penafsirannya. Peneliti menerapkan langkah metodologis tafsir maudhu‘i Al-Farmawi berbasis analisis isi untuk memetakan korpus 23 ayat kunci dari derivasi akar kata ḥ-l-l. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penafsiran ayat-ayat halal dikelompokkan ke dalam bebera…

title: At-Tikrār sebagai Strategi Komunikasi Edukatif dalam AlQur'an: Analisis Balaghah dalam Perspektif Hermeneutika
journal: Journal of Ulumul Qur'an and Tafsir Studies
abstract: This study examines at-tikrār (repetition) in the Qur’an as an educational communication strategy by integrating the perspectives of Arabic rhetoric (balāghah) and Paul Ricoeur’s hermeneutics. Through a qualitative library research approach, this study analyses Qur’anic verses containing at-tikrār, supported by classical works of balāghah, Qur’anic exegesis, and contemporary hermeneutical literature. The findings demonstrate that at-tikrār functions not merely as a rhetorical device for emphasis and aesthetic expression, but also as an intentional pedagogical mechanism that strengthens memory, internalises values, develops moral awareness, and facilitates cognitive, affective, and behavioura…

title: PERKEMBANGAN TAFSIR FALSAFI DALAM RANAH PEMIKIRAN ISLAM
journal: Jurnal At-Tibyan: Jurnal Ilmu Alqur'an dan Tafsir
abstract: This article will explain about the development of philosophical interpretation from classical to modern era. The emergence of the medieval philosophical interpretation has provided a new insight into the development of interpretation. The existence of this style of philosophical interpretation is also the "gateway" of the advancement of thought in Islam. In the modern century came a new method of interpretation with a philosophical approach that is hermeneutic discourse. In the study, hermeneutical methods contain hermeneutical circles that should not be excluded one of them, namely text (text), author or author (outhor), and reader (reader) with text, context and contextualization. However…

title: Education on Literacy of the Verses of the Qur'an:Mahmud Yunus Perspective on the Book of Tafsir Al-Qur'an Al Karim
authors: Sarah Nur’aeni Khoiriyah, M. Slamet Yahya, Enjang Burhanudin Yusuf
abstract: The Quran has placed great emphasis on educational literacy since the beginning of its revelation, thus establishing Muslims in history as a group that built a great civilisation and played a significant role as a centre of world knowledge. This is evidenced by the emergence of a strong intellectual tradition among Muslims, ranging from mastery of religious knowledge to the development of general knowledge. In this context, literacy is not merely the ability to read and write, but also encompasses the skills to understand, analyse, and critique various issues facing society. This article specifically discusses Quranic literacy education through the perspective of Prof. Mahmud Yunus, a legend…

title: INDONESIAN QUR’ANIC INTERPRETATIONS ON THE CONCEPT OF NUSHŪZ: A COMPARATIVE STUDY OF CLASSICAL AND REFORMIST APPROACHES AMONG INDONESIAN MUSLIM SCHOLARS
authors: Lolla Pitaloka, Kayan Manggala, Hasan Abdul Wafi
abstract: The concept of nusyuz in Islamic family law, particularly as outlined in QS. An-Nisa’: 34 and 128, remains a subject of debate, especially concerning power relations within the household and the potential justification of violence against women. A conservative textual reading tends to portray women as the primary perpetrators of nusyuz, subject to escalating sanctions up to physical punishment, while nusyuz by husbands receives minimal legal attention.
