title: Phonological Interference of the Indonesian Language on the Pronunciation of Arabic Hijaiyah Phonemes in the Early Stages of Quran Learning: Psycho-Phonological Analysis in Kindergarten Students
authors: Muhammad Nashi Huddin Ubaidillah, Rafli Maulana Nst, Khayyarah Alimah, Nabila Ramadhan, Nursukma Suri
abstract: This study examines the phonological interference of Indonesian language on the pronunciation of Arabic hijaiyah phonemes in kindergarten children in Iqra learning. The purpose of the study is to identify forms of phonological interference and explain the psycho-phonological factors behind them. The approach used is descriptive qualitative with a psycho-phonological framework that operationalizes Chomsky's theory of mental representation, Weinreich's interference theory, and Lado's contrastive analysis as analytical instruments. Eight students from Ibnu Al-Akbar Lubuk Pakam Kindergarten who are taking Iqra volume 1 were selected through purposive sampling based on the criteria of native Indo…

title: Social Competencies of Madurese Quran Teachers in the Context of Non-Formal Education at TPA
abstract: This study aims to describe and analyze the social competencies of Madurese Quran teachers in the context of non-formal education at the Al-Quran Education Center (TPA). Social competencies are one of the main pillars of teacher professionalism, including that of Quran teachers, requiring the ability to interact effectively with students, fellow Quran teachers, parents, and the community.This study uses a qualitative methodology in the subject of educational sociology. Participant observation, in-depth semi-structured interviews, and documentation are methods of gathering data. While data validity is guarantyd by source triangulation, methodology triangulation, and extending the research per…

title: Q-STEAM APPROACH; A NEW PARADIGM OF TEACHING BASED ON THE AL-QURAN
authors: Muzakkir Muzakkir, Hutkemri Zulnaidi, Rose Amnah Abd Rauf
abstract: Integrated learning is a pedagogical approach that fosters students' creativity, critical thinking, and their ability to connect classroom knowledge with real-world contexts. Unlike traditional learning, which emphasizes rote memorization of theories and formulas, integrated learning promotes the meaningful association of concepts across subjects, encouraging both teachers and students to perceive the relevance of education to everyday life. When instruction is rooted in real-life problems, students are more likely to apply their knowledge in practical situations, thereby deepening understanding and retention. Project-Based Learning (PBL) offers an effective strategy to address student disen…

title: KALINDAQDAQ IN THE KHATAM QURAN RITUAL OF THE MANDAR COMMUNITY: ANTROPOLINGUISTICS APPROACH
abstract: The Mandar people of West Sulawesi are rich in local culture. One such culture is kalindaqdaq. Kalindaqdaq is a type of Mandar poetry. The type of kalindaqdaq is adapted to the content of the kalindaqdaq, including educational kalindaqdaq, religious kalindaqdaq, entertainment or humor, and satire. Kalindaqdaq has various functions, one of which is as a means of communication for the Mandar people. Kalindaqdaq, as a means of communication for the Mandar people, is used in the ritual of completing the Quran. Children who have completed the Quran are mounted on dancing horses called sayyang pattuqdu. The child who has completed the Quran sits behind a jockey (passawe), usually a beautiful woman…

title: Penerapan Cooperative Learning Tipe Numbered Heads Together Dalam Meningkatkan Hasil Belajar Al-Quran Hadits Siswa
authors: Sania Alfiyani, Sri Puji Rahayu, Siti Sarah, Wahyu Purwasih
abstract: Permasalahan dalam pembelajaran Al-Qur'an Hadis di kelas IV MI Guppi Sumberwulan Selomerto Wonosobo adalah masih rendahnya keaktifan siswa dalam mengikuti proses pembelajaran yang berdampak pada rendahnya hasil belajar, khususnya pada materi bacaan Surah Al-'Ashr. Kondisi tersebut menunjukkan perlunya penerapan model pembelajaran yang dapat mendorong keterlibatan aktif siswa dalam proses pembelajaran. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui penerapan model pembelajaran Cooperative Learning tipe Numbered Heads Together (NHT) dalam meningkatkan hasil belajar Al-Qur'an Hadis siswa kelas IV MI Guppi Sumberwulan Selomerto Wonosobo. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode …

title: Interpreting Qital Verses through Karl Raimund Popper’s Verisimilitude: A Study of Sayyid Qutb’s Exegesis
journal: Al-Mada: Jurnal Agama, Sosial, dan Budaya
abstract: Penafsiran yang salah terhadap suatu ayat Al-Qur'an akan melahirkan sebuah teori yang memberikan dampak buruk dalam kehidupan umat manusia. Oleh karena itu, setiap teori yang ada harus diuji agar ia tidak menjadi sebuah dogma yang menyesatkan. Untuk menguji tingkat terkonfirmasi (corrborated) suatu teori Karl Raimund Popper melahirkan konsep verisimilitude, yakni sebuah metode baru turunan falsifikasi yang berusaha menyingkap truth content dan falsity content dari sebuah teori. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui signifikasi tafsir ayat qital Sayyid Qutub dalam perspektif verisimilitude Karl Raimund Popper. Sedangkan fokus penelitian ini adalah membedah ayat yang pertama kali turun ber…

title: Rūḥ between Revelation and Psychology: Integrating Scientific Qur’anic Exegesis and Transpersonal Psychology
journal: Al-Mada: Jurnal Agama, Sosial, dan Budaya
abstract: The Qur’anic concept of rūḥ remains a central yet epistemologically complex issue in Islamic thought because it concerns life, consciousness, morality, and transcendence while exceeding complete human understanding. This study develops an integrative conceptual model of rūḥ by bringing scientific Qur’anic exegesis into dialogue with Robert Frager’s transpersonal psychology. A qualitative library-research design was employed using thematic Qur’anic interpretation, qualitative content analysis, conceptual mapping, and source triangulation. Classical, modern, and scientifically oriented interpretations of Q.S. al-Isrāʾ [17]:85 were examined alongside literature on Sufi psychology, transpersonal…

title: PENGAJARAN AL-QURAN DALAM TALIAN: ANALISIS KEMAHIRAN PEDAGOGI DAN CABARAN PELAJAR PLUS TAHFIZ DI UITM PERLIS
authors: Noor Azura Zainuddin, Marina Abu Bakar, Syaimak Ismail @ Mat Yusoff, Noraini Ismail, Abdul Salam Zulkifli, Nadiyah Hashim
abstract: Pengajaran al-Quran atas talian merupakan satu pendekatan baru dalam pendidikan Islam yang berkembang selari dengan kemajuan teknologi digital dan perubahan landskap pembelajaran semasa. Dalam konteks ini, penglibatan pelajar Plus Tahfiz di Universiti Teknologi MARA Perlis (UiTMPs) dalam mengendalikan kelas al-Quran secara dalam talian dilihat sebagai satu inisiatif yang bukan sahaja menyokong kelangsungan pendidikan al-Quran, malah menyumbang kepada pembangunan kemahiran pelatih. Namun demikian, keberkesanan pelaksanaan serta cabaran yang dihadapi masih memerlukan kajian khusus dari perspektif tenaga pengajar. Justeru, kajian ini dijalankan untuk meneroka pengajaran al-Quran atas talian ole…

title: Pseudo-Gregory Shaping Exegesis through aporiae, Hierarchy, and Porphyry’s Criticisms of Scripture: Michael Psellos on Job 1:6 (Th. I.32 Gautier)
abstract: Abstract This article analyzes Michael Psellos’ interpretation of Job 1:6 (Th. I.32 Gautier), focusing on his exegetical strategy in addressing the paradox of Satan’s presence before God. It shows that Psellos seeks to clarify the slanderer’s position within the hierarchy of being, primarily drawing on pseudo-Dionysios’ conception of celestial order. In doing so, Psellos elaborates on the roles of angels and demons, emphasizing how Satan’s fall from grace fits into the broader cosmic structure. Additionally, the article explores Psellos’ nominal reference to Porphyry and, in relation to it, the philosophical argument against Job 1:6 grounded in the Platonic understanding of incorporeal entit…

title: اعتماد الأقيسة العقلية الصحيحة والأمثال المضروبة في القرآن لتقرير مسائل الاعتقاد / The Adoption of Correct Rational Analogies and Parables in the Quran to Establish Matters of Creed
journal: مجلة القلم للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية (علميَّة - دوريًّة - محكَّمة)
abstract: يتناول البحث الحديث عن الأقيسة العقلية والأمثال المضروبة في القرآنية، ومكانتها في الاستدلال العقلي النقلي على قضايا الاعتقاد، حيث تميّز بالأخذ به أهل السنة في مسالكهم في النظر في الألفاظ الواردة في الكتاب والسنة إضافة إلى مسالك أخرى كإثبات ظواهر النصوص وأنها حق، والعمل بالمحكم والإيمان بالمتشابه، والتماس تأويل المتشابه بالرد إلى المحكم، واعتماد ما ورد عن الرسول × مورد التفسير والبيان للنصوص، وأنه قاطع في تلك الموارد. وأبرز أهداف هذا البحث هو دفع فرية أن منهج أهل السنة في الاعتقاد منهج خطابي مما يصلح للعوام فقط، وأما المنهج البرهاني الذي يثبّت تأصل مسائل الاعتقاد فهو من اختصاص الفلاسفة والمناطقة وأهل الكلام المذموم. وقد سلكت في بيان هذا الموضوع المنهج الاستقرائي بتتبع جزئياته، والمنهج التحليل…

title: الإصلاح بين الناس في القرآن الكريم: دراسة موضوعية / Reconciliation Between People in the Holy Quran: an Objective Study
journal: مجلة القلم للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية (علميَّة - دوريًّة - محكَّمة)
abstract: يهدف هذا البحث إلى بيان حقيقة الإصلاح بين الناس، في ضوء القرآن الكريم؛ وذلك من خلال دراسة الآيات القرآنية، المتعلقة بهذا الموضوع، وقد اعتمدت في هذا البحث على المنهج الوصفي الاستقرائي؛ من أجل الوصول إلى ما يهدف إليه هذا البحث. وقد جاء هذا البحث في مقدمة، وتمهيد، فيه بيان مصطلحات البحث، وثلاثة مباحث، المبحث الأول فيه ذكر أهمية الإصلاح بين الناس وبيان فضله، والمبحث الثاني فيه ذكر أنواع الإصلاح بين الناس، والمبحث الثالث فيه ذكر صفات المصلحين بين الناس، في ضوء القرآن الكريم. وقد توصلت من خلال هذا البحث إلى عدة نتائج، منها: الإصلاح بين الناس له فضائل كثيرة جاء ذكرها في كتاب الله تعالى. ذكر الله تعالى في كتابه الكريم أنواعا من الإصلاح بين الناس، تتمثل هذه الأنواع في الإصلاح بين الناس المتقاتلين، وا…

title: REPRESENTATION OF ECOLOGICAL EXEGESIS IN ISLAMIC WEBSITES: A CRITICAL STUDY OF THE NU ONLINE AND BULETIN DAKWAH KAFFAH ACCOUNTS
abstract: The interpretation of ecological verses disseminated through media with different ideological bases has an impact on the construction of meanings that tend to be contradictory. In this context, the ideological configuration of each media influences the way ecological verses are interpreted. The NU Online and Buletin Dakwah Kaffah accounts are Islamic media that actively respond to ecological issues with the content of religious text interpretations that appear significantly different. Therefore, this study aims to analyze the representation of ecological interpretations in the two accounts which are strongly suspected of reflecting their idiological preferences in producing religious discour…

title: Criteria for an Ideal Preacher in Islam: A Living Quran Analysis of Contemporary Da'wah
authors: Muhammad Hakim Parta, Muhammad Yazid Ahda, Muhammad Rayhan Hidayatullah, Anushka Mardhiah binti Mohd Nafi
abstract: Da'wah is an important means of disseminating Islamic teachings that extends beyond the transmission of religious messages to encompass character formation and social transformation. In contemporary contexts characterized by advances in information technology, cultural plurality, and increasingly complex social issues, the personal qualities of preachers are particularly important because they serve as representatives of Quranic values in lived practice. This study aims to analyze the personal criteria of an ideal da'i in Islam through a Living Quran approach, focusing on how Quranic values are understood, internalized, and actualized in da'wah practices. The study employed a qualitative met…

title: Tabayyun in the Digital Era: A Living Quran Analysis of News Dissemination
authors: Samiullah Adel, Muhammad Numan, Busmayaril Busmayaril
abstract: The rapid development of digital technology has transformed the ways individuals receive, access, and disseminate news across contemporary society. While digital platforms facilitate the swift exchange of information, they also contribute to the widespread circulation of misinformation, disinformation, and unverified content. In this context, the Quranic principle of tabayyun (verification) serves as a fundamental ethical framework for evaluating and responding to information in the digital era. This article aims to analyze the concept and practice of receiving and disseminating news through the perspective of Living Quran studies in order to understand the actualization of tabayyun values w…

title: Concept of Livelihood in Islam: Living Quran Analysis of Material and Spiritual Dimensions
authors: Ahmad Nabil Alkahfi, Elgusmaini Elgusmaini, Mudhiyatul Huda
abstract: The concept of livelihood in Islam is not merely regarded as a worldly obligation but also as an integral part of worship when conducted in accordance with Sharia principles, where work embodies a spiritual dimension emphasizing legality, justice, and the blessing of sustenance; this study aims to analyze the notion of livelihood through the Living Quran approach by highlighting its foundational principles, values to be upheld, and relevance to contemporary socio-economic challenges; employing a qualitative method, the research draws upon Qur’anic verses related to livelihood, complemented by scholarly ijtihad, expert opinions, and previous studies published in reputable international journa…

title: Oversharing on Social Media from the Perspective of Maqasidi Exegesis
authors: Fadel Muhammad, Hamdan Halomoan, Akmal Syah, Mustapha Almasi, Aldi Muhammad Alfin, M. Hidayat Ediz
abstract: The rapid growth of social media has facilitated individuals in sharing information quickly and extensively, but it has also given rise to the phenomenon of oversharing, namely the excessive disclosure of personal information without due consideration of privacy boundaries and its psychological and social consequences. This article aims to analyze the phenomenon of oversharing on social media from the perspective of tafsir maqasidi in order to identify Quranic ethical principles relevant to contemporary digital communication. This article employs a qualitative method with a content analysis design. The primary data source is the Quran, supported by literature on Quranic exegesis, maqasid al-…

title: MAROUF AL-RUSAFI’S RELIGIOUS VIEWS ON THE HOLY QURAN IN HIS BOOK “THE MUHAMMADAN PERSONALITY”, A CRITICAL INTELLECTUAL STUDY
authors: Dr. Nizar Amer Hussain, Nada Ayed Saad

title: Tafsīr al-Mīzān as a Representation of Shī‘ī Exegesis
authors: Ahmad Sayyid Al Adam, Adam Azizi, Nur Arfiyah Febriani
abstract: This article examines the development of Qur’anic exegesis within the Shī‘ī tradition, focusing its analysis on the book al-Mīzān fī Tafsīr al-Qur’ān by Muḥammad Ḥusayn Ṭabāṭabā’ī. Rather than treating Shī‘ī exegesis only as a by-product of early political conflict, this research also foregrounds the tradition’s own theological self-understanding, in which the imām’s authority as naṣṣ grounds a periodization running from the era of the imāms through ghaybah ṣughrā and kubrā, shaping the shift from riwāyah-based to ijtihādī-rational exegesis. Al-Mīzān emerges as the pinnacle of this trajectory, employing tafsīr al-Qur’ān bi al-Qur’ān, in which verses are read against other verses while ḥadīth…

title: From Text to Transformation
abstract: This study examines how millennial Muslims in Banten interpret Qur’anic hijrah verses and how these interpretations drive spiritual transformation and identity construction. Focusing on two communities—Ta‘lim Cloud Al Bantani and Bikers Subuhan Banten—this qualitative phenomenological study involved ten informants. The findings reveal that members interpret hijrah not merely as physical migration but as a holistic spiritual transformation encompassing four dimensions: cognitive restructuring (fikriyyah), faith reinforcement (i‘tiqādiyah), emotional change from reluctance to longing for worship (shu‘ūriyyah), and moral improvement (sulūkiyyah). Their interpretation of Q.S. Ar-Ra‘d [13]:11 und…

title: From Domestic Confinement to Public Agency
authors: Ilzam Hubby Dzikrillah Alfani, Siti Hajar, Muhammad Mufti Najmul Umam Assondani, Nushrotun Nida, Nilna Faiziya
abstract: This study examines the interpretation of Q.S. Al-Aḥzāb [33]: 33, particularly the phrase waqarna fī buyūtikunna (remain in your homes), which has traditionally been used to restrict women’s public participation. The research problem centers on the tension between literal readings that confine women to domestic spaces and the need for contextual interpretations responsive to modern social dynamics. The study aims to re-examine Q.S. Al-Aḥzāb [33]: 33 through Abdullah Saeed’s contextual approach, an analytical framework previously underexplored in existing scholarship. Using a qualitative methodology with Saeed’s contextual framework, the analysis proceeds through six stages: classical to cont…

title: Al-Bakhs in Tafsīr al-Munīr
authors: Muhammad Sufiyan, Abdul Aziz Ali Fikri
abstract: Justice in the Qur’an is expressed through both commands to fulfil rights and prohibitions against their unjust diminution. This study examines the contextual meanings of al-bakhs in Wahbah al-Zuḥaylī’s al-Tafsīr al-Munīr and reconstructs a specific anti-bakhs principle. It employs qualitative library research, theory-guided content analysis, Charles J. Fillmore’s Frame Semantics, and limited exegetical comparison. The primary corpus comprises al-Zuḥaylī’s interpretations of seven Qur’anic occurrences of the root term al-bakhs. Each occurrence is analyzed through its grammatical construction, participants, object, standard of comparison, realization relationship, polarity, and normative eval…

title: Al-Mīzān Conceptual Framework for Ecological Mitigation
authors: Abdul Zaenuri, Rismawati Rismawati, Abdul Mufid, Muhammad Syaiful, Wilhanul Haq
abstract: The hydrometeorological crisis in Indonesia, marked by the catastrophic flash floods and landslides that struck Sumatra and Aceh in late 2025, has been demonstrated to originate primarily from large-scale deforestation and upstream land-use conversion rather than from extreme rainfall anomalies alone. Although disaster mitigation studies in Southeast Asia have advanced substantially in their technical, infrastructural, and institutional dimensions, the spiritual and religious values that motivate community behavior toward ecosystems remain largely overlooked. Likewise, existing studies on Islamic ecotheology have yet to be operationalized into a systematic disaster mitigation framework. This…

title: The Illusion of Control and Human Fragility
abstract: The present-day fragility of humans raises a Qur’anic issue of attribution: people are mandated to exert effort, reflect, and engage, yet they often misinterpret their limited agency as control over consequences. This article outlines a Qur’anic paradigm of theocentric attribution by exploring the connections among human exertion, divine decree, triumph, defeat, appreciation, pride, endurance, tawakkul, and aspiration. It applies qualitative library research through thematic Qur’anic commentary (al-tafsīr al-mawḍū‘ī), semantic-contextual reading, inter-verse synthesis, and comparative analysis with al-Ṭabarī, Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī, Ibn ‘Āshūr, al-Rāghib al-Aṣfahānī, and M. Quraish Shihab. The…

title: Dhikr and Cognitive Neuroscience
authors: Wildanul Kholis Alhadi, Ikhwan Arfa' Bimantoro, Winka Ghazi Nafi, Fariz Istiqlal Harahap, Afifah Anwari Mattali Ahmad
abstract: The increasing prevalence of anxiety and psychological distress in the post-pandemic era has intensified interest in spiritual and religious sources of mental tranquility. Although previous studies have discussed the psychological and spiritual benefits of dhikr, the relationship between the Qur’anic concept of tranquility and its cognitive-neuroscientific mechanisms remains insufficiently explored through an integrated interdisciplinary framework. This study examines the relationship between dhikr and ṭuma’nīnah in Q.S. Al-Ra‘d [13]: 28 by integrating Qur’anic linguistic-semantic analysis, spiritual exegesis, and cognitive neuroscience. Using qualitative library research, the study analyzes…

title: AI Hermeneutic Competence in Qur’anic Exegesis
abstract: The development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has significantly transformed various fields of knowledge, including Qur’anic exegesis. AI can rapidly process Islamic data, analyze language, connect classical and contemporary tafsir sources, and present interpretive information systematically. These advances have raised scholarly debates concerning whether AI possesses the hermeneutic competence required to interpret the Qur’an. This study examines AI’s hermeneutic competence by evaluating it against the qualifications of a mufassir within the tradition of ‘ulūm al-Qur’ān. It employs a qualitative library research approach. The findings reveal that AI demonstrates considerable strengths in p…

title: Power Relations in the Family
authors: Rizamul Malik Akbar, M Mujab, Mohamed Sulthan Mohamed Saleem
abstract: The concepts of qiwāmah, nushūz, and wa-ḍribūhunna in Q.S. An-Nisā’ [4]: 34 remain debated in tafsir studies because they are closely related to household power relations, family leadership, and domestic violence. This study aims to analyze and compare Hamka’s and Husein Muhammad’s interpretations of the verse using Norman Fairclough’s Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA). This qualitative study employs a literature study approach, focusing on Tafsir al-Azhar by Hamka and Islam Agama Ramah Perempuan by Husein Muhammad. The findings reveal three main points. (1) At the textual level, Hamka employs naturalization by presenting qiwāmah as part of a normative family order, nushūz as disobedience, a…

title: Reconstructing the Concept of Syifa' in the Quran: A Comparative Analysis of Spirituality and Holistic Health
authors: Randi Prasetia, Mutathahirin Mutathahirin, Nuha Sufina Binti Saidi
abstract: The concept of syifa' (healing) occupies a significant place in the Quran and remains highly relevant to contemporary discussions on spirituality, mental well-being, and holistic health. Although the Quran explicitly presents itself as a source of syifa', Muslim exegetes have offered diverse interpretations regarding the nature, scope, and function of healing within the Quranic framework. This article aims to reconstruct the concept of syifa' in the Quran through a comparative analysis of the interpretations of M. Quraish Shihab in Tafsir Al-Mishbah and Wahbah al-Zuhaili in Tafsir Al-Munir. Employing a qualitative approach with content analysis and the tafsir muqaran (comparative exegesis) m…

title: Exploring the Semantic Meaning and Pragmatic Functions of Ittaqi in the Quran
abstract: This article aims to analyze the meaning and pragmatic functions of the lexeme ittaqi in the Quran through semantic and pragmatic approaches. The article employs a qualitative method with a content analysis design. The data consist of Quranic verses containing the lexeme ittaqi and were collected through document analysis. Data were analyzed using a semantic approach to identify lexical meanings and semantic relations, as well as a pragmatic approach to explain speech functions within the context of divine communication. The findings reveal that the lexeme ittaqi derives from the root waqā, which denotes conscious self-protection from spiritual, moral, and eschatological harm. From a pragmat…

title: Etiquette of Gender Relations in Islam: A Living Quran Analysis of Contemporary Practices
authors: Muhammad Khatami, Fauzi Akmal, Nurhaya Azzahra
abstract: The etiquette of social interaction between men and women in Islam constitutes a fundamental aspect of religious teachings aimed at preserving dignity, moral purity, and social harmony. This article is written to examine Quranic and Prophetic principles governing gender relations and their relevance for contemporary youth in educational, professional, and social contexts. Employing a qualitative approach with the Living Quran method, the study explores how Quranic values are embodied in daily practices through observation, interviews, and thematic analysis. Findings reveal that while Islam does not prohibit male–female interaction absolutely, such relations must be conducted within ethical b…

title: Sandwich Generation in the Quran: A Maqasidi Perspective on Family Welfare
authors: Samat Abdurahman, Indana Rahmatika Lilirtiqa, Mustaqimah Mustaqimah, Ilyas Daud, Burhanuddin Burhanuddin
abstract: The sandwich generation refers to individuals of productive age who simultaneously bear responsibilities toward their parents and immediate families, often facing economic, social, and psychological challenges. This article aims to analyze the concept of birr al walidayn, or filial piety toward parents, in the Quran and reconstruct the understanding of the sandwich generation from a maqasid perspective. This study employs a qualitative approach using content analysis and thematic interpretation. The primary data consist of Quranic verses related to filial piety, financial support, human capacity, and family protection, while secondary data are drawn from classical and contemporary exegetical…

title: Al-Quran Dan Mukjizat Angka
abstract: The word miracle in the Indonesian dictionary is defined as "a miraculous event that is difficult for the human mind to reach." This meaning is not the same as the meaning of the word in terms of the Islamic religion. In language, the origin of the word miracle or معجزة is عجز which consists of three letters, namely Ain, Jiem and Zay. According to Ibn Faris the word has two meanings. The first is from the word Ajaza or عجز with wazan fa'ala which means al-Dlo'fu or weak, the second meaning is from something. The opposite of the word ajaza which means weak is alhazm or الحزم which means strength of heart. Therefore, the meaning of ajaza can be interpreted as a weakness in the form of inabilit…

title: أثر القرآن الكريم في تنمية المَلَكة النحوية / The Influence of the Holy Quran on Developing Grammatical Intuition
abstract: تتمحور فكرة البحث على أثر القرآن الكريم على تنمية الملكة النحوية من خلال التدبر في معاني القرآن، والتدقيق في دلالة كل كلمة في الآية ومفهومها وموقعها والسياق التي وردت فيه، وما يترتب على كل هذه المعطيات من معاني، فالتدبر والتمحص في الآية وبيان مفهومها مرة بعد مرة في القرآن تتولد منه تنمية للملكة النحوية وهي القدرة على الفهم ومعرفة توجه المعاني من خلال الإعراب والتدبر في القرآن، وبعد المران من كثرة التلاوة التدبر تتولد هذه الملكة ويصبح القارئ له القدرة على الفهم الدقيق للقرآن.

title: الايمان بالرسل وأثره في ترسيخ العقيدة الاسلامية في القرآن الكريم / Belief in the Messengers and Its Impact on Strengthening the Islamic Creed in the Holy Quran
abstract: تناول البحث عن الإيمان بالرسل وأثره في ترسيخ العقيدة الإسلامية في القرآن الكريم، بوصفه أحد وأهم أصول الإيمان التي تقوم عليها عقيدة المسلم، وفي بحثي هذا تطرقت إلى بيان مفهوم الإيمان بالرسل، ومكانته في القرآن الكريم، وبيان الحكمة من إرسال الرسل ودورهم في هداية الخلق وإخراجهم من الشرك إلى التوحيد، وقد أكدت الآيات القرآنية الكريمة أن الإيمان بالرسل جميعًا أصل من أصول العقيدة الاسلامية، وأن التفريق بينهم في الإيمان ينافي حقيقة الإيمان الصحيح. ويبين البحث أن القرآن الكريم عرض سير الرسل ودعوتهم بأساليب متعددة ومتنوعة، ركزت هذه الاساليب على توحيد الله تعالى، وإقامة الحجة على الخلق، وتصحيح انحرافات العقيدة، وترسيخ الأخلاق والقيم، ويخلص البحث إلى أن الإيمان بالرسل ليس مجرد اعتقاد نظري، بل له آثار إيما…

title: Social Manners in Contemporary Children's Exegesis: Exploring Musthafa Khattab's Perspective
authors: Miskah Salsabilah, Mamluatun Nafisah, Moses Adeolu Agoi, Defriyanto Defriyanto
abstract: The digital era has significantly transformed children's patterns of social interaction, as reflected in the decline of language etiquette, the spread of harmful speech, and the increasing prevalence of verbal bullying in online environments. This phenomenon highlights the need to strengthen social manners from an early age as a foundation for character formation and social responsibility. This article examines Musthafa Khattab’s perspective on social manners in contemporary children's Quranic exegesis through his interpretation of Surat al-Ḥujurat (1–13) in The Clear Quran for Kids. Using a qualitative approach and content analysis, the study draws on The Clear Quran for Kids as the primary…

title: The Duality of Method and Horizon in Contemporary Kurdish Qur’anic Exegesis: A Comparative Study of Theological, Jurisprudential, and Linguistic Foundations in the Works of Modarres and Abdulaziz
authors: Farzad Validi, Mehdi  Mehrizi Targhi, Jahangir Valadbeygi, Naser Meryani
abstract: The present study aims to provide a comparative analysis of the exegetical approaches of two contemporary Sunni Kurdish commentators, Abdulkarim Modarres (1905–2005), author of Mawahib al-Rahman, and Osman Abdulaziz (1922–1999), author of Tafsiri Qurani Piroz. Although both exegetes shared common geographical, cultural, and jurisprudential backgrounds as adherents of the Shafi‘i school, their exegetical methodologies exhibit significant divergences. The study adopts an analytical-comparative method based on library research and focuses primarily on comparing their scholarly biographies, theological-jurisprudential orientations, and the structural organization of their commentaries. title: Embodying Strength and Self-Discipline: two Contemporary Sufi Approaches to the Body and Qurʾan Exegesis
abstract: Abstract This article analyzes two contemporary Sufi teachers’ interpretations of corporeality within their respective methodologies of spiritual development. The Ṣūfī Ṭabīb, the leader of the Uzbek Nūrsafardiyya, develops a narrative of a direct correlation between the empowerment of the body and the individual capacity of spiritual growth and insight. Aḥmad Dabbāgh, shaykh of the Ṭarīqa Muḥammadiyya, a Moroccan–Pakistani–British Sufi group, emphasizes the importance of disciplining the senses and organs in order to achieve bodily and mental purification. For this purpose, he presents a program for regulating and refining human behavior. Both Sufis’ approaches are derived from their exegese…

authors: Umi Fatonah, Enni Erawati saragih, Maimunah, Ani Safitri, Iqromi Ridho
abstract: This research is an evaluation study using the Kirkpatrick model. It aims to provide an in-depth overview of the implementation and outcomes of a training program conducted using the UMMI method to improve the quality of Quranic teaching for teachers and also to improve future education. The research method was qualitative, using data collection instruments such as interviews, observations, questionnaires, and documentation. The results showed a very high level of participant satisfaction with the training, indicating that the implementation was effective and met their expectations. Furthermore, participants' attitudes also experienced positive changes, becoming more disciplined and meticulo…

title: POETRY AND POETS IN THE QURAN AND HADITH
journal: Eurasian Journal of Social Sciences, Philosophy and Culture
abstract: The study explores the place of poetry and poets in the Quran and Hadith, focusing on the religious, cultural, and moral perspectives conveyed in Islamic teachings. While pre-Islamic society regarded poetry as a central form of artistic and social expression, the Quran and Hadith adopt a balanced and critical approach, distinguishing between poetry that promotes truth, virtue, and spiritual values and poetry rooted in falsehood, arrogance, and moral corruption. The research analyzes Quranic verses – particularly in Surah Ash-Shu‘ara – and Prophetic traditions to highlight the ethical standards set for poetic creativity and the role of poets in guiding or misleading society. title: Philosophical Analysis of the Relationship Between Reason, Faith, and Insight in the Holy Quran: Its Impact on Islamic Educational and Ethical Systems
abstract: This article analyzes the philosophical relationship between reason, faith, and insight in the Holy Quran and their impacts on Islamic educational and ethical systems. The main objective of this research is to examine the roles of these three fundamental concepts in shaping individual character and behavior within the framework of Islamic principles. Reason, as a tool for thought and analysis, guides individuals to a correct and profound understanding of divine truths. Faith, as a heartfelt and spiritual belief, encourages individuals to adhere to ethical principles and religious values. Insight, as a type of intuitive and spiritual understanding, allows individuals to see beyond appearances…

authors: Maryam Fateminia, Irandokht Fayyaz, Ahmad Salahshoori
abstract: The evolution of the digital age has transformed the Internet into the primary source of pornography. The verses of the Holy Qur’an related to the prevention of pornography can contribute to nurturing individuals’ capacities toward enhancing well-being and achieving the higher objectives of education, and can safeguard societies from sexual deviations and numerous psychological disorders. In the present study, in order to identify the anthropological foundations and principles of education for the prevention of pornography, the exegesis of relev…

title: Ayat-Ayat Quran tentang Manajemen Kesiswaan (Studi Kasus Penerimaan Peserta Didik Baru di SMPN 5 Dusun Selatan)

abstract: This research aims to analyze the application of student management from the perspective of the Koran with a case study of new student admissions (PPDB) at SMPN 5 Dusun Selatan. This research uses descriptive qualitative methods by collecting data through documentation, observation and interviews. The research results show that the acceptance of new students at SMPN 5 Dusun Selatan follows the principles of the Koran, especially in terms of planning, acceptance, orientation, placement, coaching and evaluation of n…

authors: Che Khadijah Hamid, Surita Hartini Mat Hassan, Salimah Yahaya, Sakinatul Raadiyah Abdullah

abstract: Penggunaan wang fiat dalam amalan berwakaf menimbulkan persoalan kerana sifatnya yang tidak stabil, mudah menyusut nilai, serta tiada nilai intrinsik, yang dikhuatiri boleh menjejaskan keutuhan harta wakaf. The implementation of the learning model is carried out using two strategies, The first, namely combining every element that at first glance seems unrelated. title: Tinjauan Kritis Orientalis Pada Teori Christoph Luxenberg Dalam Studi Al-Qur’an Pada Konsep Dakwah
authors: Muhammad Haris Hakam, Siti Nuri Nurhaidah, Muhibudin Muhibudin, Andi Marwan
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: This article discusses the controversial theory put forward by Christoph Luxenberg regarding the origins of the Qur'an. In his work, The Syro-Aramaic Reading of the Koran, Luxenberg argues that many parts of the Qur'an were actually written in the Aramaic dialect and not in classical Arabic. This theory states that many verses have been misinterpreted due to linguistic and cultural shifts. This article examines the linguistic and historical foundations of Luxenberg's theory, and assesses its impact on Islamic studies and acceptance among Muslim academics and scholars. Through critical analysis, this article aims to provide a deeper understanding of the implications of Luxenberg's approach to…

title: Maqāman Maḥmūdan Perspective Ibn ʻAjībah in Tafsīr al-Baḥr al-madīd fī tafsīr al-Qurʼān al-Majīd
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: This study aims to analyze the concept of Maqāman maḥmūdan from Ibn ʻAjībah's perspective as found in the tafsir al-Baḥr al-madīd fī tafsīr al-Qurʼān al-Majīd. Maqāman maḥmūdan is an important concept in Islamic spiritual understanding, referring to the blessed status or place in the journey of human life. Ibn ʻAjībah, a prominent scholar from 19th-century Morocco, developed a profound understanding of this concept in his works. The research methodology involves textual analysis (Semiotic) of Ibn ʻAjībah's tafsir al-Baḥr al-madīd fī tafsīr al-Qurʼān al-Majīd. Primary data is obtained through direct examination of the tafsir texts relevant to the concept of Maqāman maḥmūdan, while secondary d…

title: Sosialisasi pembentukan Unit Kesehatan Pondok (UKP) di lingkungan Pondok Bukit Hidayah Gunungkidul
abstract: Usaha Kesehatan Sekolah (UKS) merupakan salah satu upaya dunia pendidikan dalam menumbuhkan, memupuk, mengembangkan serta meningkatkan perilaku hidup bersih dan sehat, mampu untuk menerapkan di kehidupan sehari-hari serta derajat Kesehatan peserta didik melalui pelaksanaan Trias UKS. title: PROGRAM PENGUATAN LITERASI AL-QUR'AN MAHASISWA MELALUI METODE MENTORING DI LINGKUNGAN PERGURUAN TINGGI TELKOM UNIVERSITY / PROGRAM TO STRENGTHEN STUDENTS' AL-QURAN LITERACY THROUGH MENTORING METHODS IN THE HIGHER EDUCATION ENVIRONMENT AT TELKOM UNIVERSITY
journal: Sivitas : Jurnal Pengabdian dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat
abstract: Program penguatan literasi Al-Qur’an bagi mahasiswa merupakan upaya strategis dalam meningkatkan kemampuan baca tulis Al-Qur’an sekaligus membentuk karakter religius di lingkungan perguruan tinggi. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kemampuan literasi Al-Qur’an mahasiswa melalui penerapan metode mentoring yang dilakukan secara terstruktur, intensif, dan berkelanjutan. Metode mentoring dipilih karena memungkinkan adanya pendampingan langsung antara mentor dan mahasiswa sehingga proses pembelajaran menjadi lebih efektif, personal, dan sesuai dengan tingkat kemampuan masing-masing peserta. title: Memorizing and Improving Children's Quran Reading Through the 3T Method (Tahsin Tilawah Tahfidz) in Tegal Lega Village / MEMORIZING AND IMPROVING CHILDREN'S QURAN READING THROUGH THE 3T METHOD (TAHSIN TILAWAH TAHFIDZ) IN TEGAL LEGA VILLAGE
authors: U Abdullah Mu'min, Aris Gundara, Mia Rahmawati, Mutia Dewi, Neng Suci, Syifa Ulinas
journal: Sivitas : Jurnal Pengabdian dan Pemberdayaan Masyarakat
abstract: Metode 3T (Tahsin Tilawah dan Tahfidz) merupakan salah satu upaya penting dalam meningkatkan kualitas bacaan dan hafalan Alquran khususnya bagi anak-anak yang berada di desa Tegal Lega. Program ini merupakan salah satu program yang bertujuan untuk merealisasikan salah satu motto dari Kecamatan Lengkong Sukabumi yaitu membangun masyarakat yang religius. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengeksplorasi efektivitas metode 3T dalam membantu anak-anak di Desa Tegal Lega dalam menghafal dan memperbaiki bacaan Alquran. Metode 3T merupakan pendekatan yang mengintegrasikan tiga aspek utama dalam pendidikan Alquran, yaitu tahsin (memperbaiki pelafalan dan tajwid), tilawah (membaca Alquran dengan tartil),…

title: Nur 'Ala Nur: A Qur'anic Conceptual Framework for Islamic Research Methodology
abstract: The concept of Nur ‘Ala Nur (Light upon Light) in Surah al-Nur (24:35) has been widely interpreted by Muslim scholars in relation to faith, guidance, knowledge, and divine wisdom. However, its potential as a qur'anic framework for Islamic research methodology has received limited scholarly attention. This study aims to develop a conceptual framework for Islamic research methodology based on the qur'anic concept of Nur ‘Ala Nur. Employing a qualitative conceptual research design, the study analyses classical and contemporary qur'anic exegeses alongside literature on Islamic epistemology and research methodology through document analysis and thematic analysis. The findings identify three inter…

title: The Fragility of Coerced Faith: Deconstructing the Constitutional Court’s Ratio Decidendi via the Aḥmadiyyah Exegesis of Qurʾān 2:256
abstract: This article challenges the legal-theological logic underpinning the Indonesian Constitutional Court (Mahkamah Konstitusi or MK) Decision No. 140/PUU-VII/2009, which upheld the Blasphemy Law on the grounds of maintaining "public order" and "religious purity" (ḥifẓ al-dīn). While existing scholarship predominantly critiques this decision through secular human rights frameworks, this study employs a hermeneutic dialectic method to confront the Court’s reasoning with an internal Islamic counter-narrative: the Aḥmadiyyah exegesis (tafsīr) of Qurʾān 2:256. The analysis reveals a fundamental epistemological divergence. The MK operates on a paradigm of "doctrinal fragility," assuming that religious…

title: Kekerasan Dalam Rumah Tangga Dalam Perspektif Al Quran
authors: Sapri Ali, Achmad Asfi Burhanudin, Tahta Himayatir R
journal: El-Faqih : Jurnal Pemikiran dan Hukum Islam
abstract: Domestic violence (DV) is a crucial issue in modern society, especially for women, as it impacts physical, psychological, and spiritual suffering. In this context, the study of the verses of the Qur'an is important, especially by comparing the classical interpretation approach and the feminist hermeneutic approach of Amina Wadud. Amina Wadud, a feminist Muslim scholar, interprets the verses of the Qur'an by upholding the principles of justice and gender equality. This study uses a literature study method with a descriptive-analytical approach to examine Amina Wadud's thoughts on verses relevant to domestic violence. title: Evaluation of Teacher Performance Programs in Learning Quality Arabic Language at Bakti Ilaahi Quran Elementary School in Bengkulu City
journal: Al-Khair Journal: Management, Education and Law
abstract: Abstrac: The quality of Arabic language learning is still weak, as indicated by many students struggling in practicing daily conversations. This study aims to evaluate the teacher performance program in improving the quality of Arabic language learning at the Quran Elementary School Bakti Ilaahi Bengkulu. It uses a qualitative method with the CIPP evaluation model approach. Data collection techniques were conducted through observation, interviews, and documentation. The evaluation results show that, in general, teachers have prepared learning planning programs in accordance with the applicable curriculum. title: The Contribution of Tafsīr Marāḥ Labīd to the Corpus of Nusantara Exegesis and Arabic Language Education
authors: Muhammad Hanif Fauzi, Putra Nahdi Abiyyu, Mohamad Samsudin, Hamzah Robbani, Misbahuddin Misbahuddin
journal: ALSUNIYAT: Jurnal Penelitian Bahasa, Sastra, dan Budaya Arab
abstract: Sheikh Nawawi al-Bantani’s Marāḥ Labīd is a significant work within the tradition of Quranic exegesis in the Nusantara region While previous studies have focused on its exegetical methodology and intellectual sources, its potential for Arabic language education remains in need of further research and exploration. This study examines the historical and methodological significance of the exegesis and investigates its potential as an authentic resource for learning Modern Standard Arabic. Employing a qualitative methodology based on desk research, the study applies content analysis to the original text and relevant scholarly literature, examining it through historical, exegetical, linguistic, a…

title: Selective Linguistic Approach in Islamic Legal Exegesis: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Ali al-Shabuni's Rawai' al-Bayan on Surah An-Nur
authors: Neli Putri, Syafruddin Syafruddin, Yasrul Huda, Junizar Suratman
abstract: Linguistic approaches constitute fundamental methodology in Qur'anic legal verse interpretation, yet systematic analysis of their application in contemporary exegesis remains limited. This study analyzes the linguistic approach employed in Muhammad Ali al-Shabuni's Rawai' al-Bayan Tafsir Ayat Ahkam, focusing on Surah An-Nur as a case study. Employing qualitative document analysis with Yin's five-stage analytical framework, this research examined nine legal themes across Surah An-Nur, mapping linguistic dimensions against classical lughawi exegesis standards. title: The Shifting Visibility of Tafsīr Authority in the AI Era
authors: Rochmad Rochmad, Miftahul Huda, Ahmad Faris Zein, Mu’adz Ali Murtadho
abstract: The digitization of the Qur’an has reconfigured how Qur’anic interpretation (tafsīr) is produced, mediated, and perceived, particularly as artificial intelligence (AI) enters a tradition grounded in sanad, the chain of scholarly transmission. This study aims to examine the development of AI in digital tafsir, compare algorithmic interpretation with classical tafsir methodology, and assess how algorithmic visibility relates to epistemic authority and the validity of interpretation. Using a descriptive-analytical-critical approach combined with comparative and critical (naqd) methods, this library research draws on scholarly literature on digital religion, AI, and tafsir, including a secondary…

title: Constructing Cosmological Meaning in Q.S. Al-Anbiyā’ [21]: 30
abstract: Studies of Q.S. Al-Anbiyā’ [21]: 30 have largely focused on correspondences between the Qur’anic concepts of ratq (joining or closure) and fatq (opening or separation) and modern cosmological theories, especially the Big Bang, while the linguistic and cognitive processes through which cosmological meaning is constructed remain less examined. This study analyzes the construction of cosmological meaning in Q.S. Al-Anbiyā’ [21]: 30 by integrating al-Jurjānī’s contextual semantics with Lakoff and Johnson’s Conceptual Metaphor Theory. title: From Tawḥīd to Faḍā’il
authors: Moh. Nadhif, Moh. Subthi Buchori, Muh Zamroni, Luthfi Hakim, Mamluatu Solihah
abstract: Digital Qur’anic preaching often places Qur’anic wording, ḥadīth reports, exegetical explanation, and motivational language within one short audiovisual sequence. This study examines how a 10-minute 31-second preaching video transforms Q.S. Al-Ikhlāṣ [112] from a compact declaration of tawḥīd into a sequence of faḍā’il claims and supplication, while asking how source differences remain visible or become compressed. The study uses an artifact-centered qualitative case design that integrates audiovisual content analysis, thematic tafsīr, ḥadīth source criticism, and multimodal framing analysis. The video is reconstructed claim by claim before comparison with Q.S. Al-Ikhlāṣ [112]: 1–4, Q.S. Al-…

title: Ecotheological Interpretation of the Story of the People of Saba’ (Q.S. Saba’ [34]: 15–17) to Minimize the Food Waste Crisis in Indonesia
authors: Suni Subagja, Eni Zulaiha, Olivia Noufal Layla
abstract: This study aims to examine the ecotheological interpretation of the story of the Saba’ people in Q.S. Saba’ [34]: 15–17 to minimize the food waste crisis in Indonesia. The study employs a descriptive qualitative approach, drawing primary sources from the Qur’an (particularly Q.S. Saba’ [34]: 15–17), supported by verses addressing tabdhīr (wastefulness), isrāf (excessiveness), resource reuse, and the prohibition of environmental degradation. Secondary sources include classical and contemporary exegetical works, literature on Islamic environmental jurisprudence (fiqh al-bī’ah), ecotheology, the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), and food waste studies. title: Interpretasi Pendidikan Ayat Al-Quran Sebagai Solusi Krisis Moral Remaja Di Era Modern
authors: Sangkot Abdullah Efendi Harahap, Abdul Vickraam Makau, Azizurahman Azizurahman, Musthofa Husein
journal: Al-Amin: Jurnal Ilmu Pendidikan dan Sosial Humaniora
abstract: The moral crisis among adolescents in the modern era is a serious issue influenced by technological advancements, cultural globalization, and the weakening internalization of religious values. This study aims to examine the educational interpretation of Qur’anic verses as a solution to the moral crisis among adolescents. The research employs a library research method with a descriptive qualitative approach. Data are obtained from the Qur’an, classical and contemporary tafsir, and relevant scholarly journal articles, and are analyzed using content analysis techniques. The findings indicate that Qur’anic verses contain moral educational values such as honesty, responsibility, patience, compass…

journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: The Islamic boarding school (pondok pesantren) is a non-formal educational institution that deepens knowledge of Islamic religious education and puts it into practice as a guide for daily life, emphasising morality in social life. Data in this study were collected through structured interviews with the principal of an Islamic junior high school (Madrasah Tsanawiyah) that also has a pesantren, a deputy principal of an elementary school, pesantren alumni, an employee of LPMP Jakarta, an alumnus of the Tebuireng pesantren in East Java, and parents whose children study at a pesantren. title: AL-QUR’AN DAN EKONOMI: PEMBACAAN SEMANTIKA
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: My aim in this article is to delineate the Quranic intentional in regard with economy which in Marx’s basic assumption lies on the base of structure of society. The position remains a deep impact, that’s how the human attitude determined by one thing, economy. One does not work except for economy. Human daily life or superstructure, Marx said, determined by what called as “base structure” overall. Beside the article want to question the thesis, it also desire to analyse in the scope of Quranic world view concerning economy: does it reside in the base of structure or just as the complement. As the goal is world view, thus, the article will employ semantics to cut open the case.

title: TRADISI QIRA’AT AL-QUR’AN
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: This article analyses how the tradition of qira'at al-Qur'an, as part of the Qur'an itself and of the living Qur'an, also deserves serious reception, since the orality of the Qur'an is a vocal point at which many differences occur across regions and countries. There are several reasons why this study is worth undertaking. First, qira'at al-Qur'an is one of the pillars of the orality of the Qur'an, as every community and region has its own dialect, including the revelation of the Qur'an in Arabia in the seventh century in the Arabic language. Second, it seeks to determine the extent of the reception and influence in society of the study of the book Faid al-Barakat fi Sab' al-Qira'at by K.H. M…

title: MENCARI FORMAT ILMU PENGETAHUAN BERBASIS QURAN
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: Qur'an-based science is an alternative for improving the nation's morality. It approaches knowledge from various angles so that the human personality it forms is integral and whole, oriented towards perfection in this world and the hereafter. There have been efforts to make character-based curricula a guide, including the character-based curriculum of 2010, which expected every subject to contain values of good character, followed by the research- and science-based curriculum of 2013, in which character was framed as a competency, such as K-1 and K-2. However, these efforts were not fundamental enough, because the epistemology of the knowledge used is based on Western ideological values that…

title: HAKIKAT KEBENARAN MENGKAJI TASAWUF AKHLAKI – AKHLAK KENABIAN
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: Truth is the aspiration of every human being. It has a special meaning in life; it is the foundation of all thought, attitude and action, and it gives life its meaning. The essence of truth needs to be examined, and one way of doing so is through Sufism (tasawuf). Sufism is the prophetic character that continues to be a source of inspiration and motivation, giving meaning and direction, and serving as the true guide for the building of human civilisation. It is the main source of the spiritual, moral and intellectual currents, indeed of the whole human soul, in preserving and developing the meaning and function of a person's servanthood and vicegerency. Through Sufism the meaning of humanity…

title: AL-QUR’AN SEBAGAI MUKJIZAT TERBESAR
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: The miracle of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) has distinctive features compared with the miracles of the other prophets. All earlier miracles were bounded by space and time, meaning that they were shown only to particular peoples at particular times, whereas the miracle of the Qur'an is universal and eternal, applying to all humankind until the end of time. The Qur'an is therefore the greatest of all the miracles that God Almighty bestowed upon the earlier prophets and upon the Prophet Muhammad himself. The miracles of earlier prophets and messengers were material and perceptible to the senses, while the miracle of the Prophet Muhammad is spiritual, rational and everlasting, namely…

title: METODOLOGI BACA TULIS AL-QU’RAN: Refleksi Belajar Al-Quran Pada Mahasiswa IAIN Palangkaraya
authors: Zaenap Hartati, Emawati Emawati, Latifah Anum Dalimunte
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: Both upon admission and during the practicum course Qur'an Reading Practice (PMQ), students of IAIN Palangka Raya take a Qur'an reading test, yet their reading ability is still not optimal, and some students have difficulty reading the Qur'an properly and correctly. This study aims to explore the problems students face before and during their learning process in order to find solutions to the problem of Qur'an reading ability among students of IAIN Palangka Raya. The research was conducted at IAIN Palangka Raya using a qualitative descriptive approach, with students as informants. Data were collected through interviews, observation and documentation. The study shows that the students first l…

title: ETIKA BISNIS PELENGKAP CORPORATE GOVERNANCE SYARIAH
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: In 2010 the National Committee on Governance Policy (KNKG) introduced business ethics by interpreting ethical principles for particular business activities. These rather vague general standards have prompted debate among academics and practitioners. Roszaini Haniffa and Mohammad Hudaib found inconsistencies between commitment and business practice. Muhammad Djakfar views ethics and morality literally as a value system of how people should live in society, with ethics being much broader than morality and understood as moral philosophy. By contrast, Sofyan S. Harahap understands ethics both as a branch of philosophy and as a branch of science. These different understandings of business ethics …

title: TAHRIF DALAM AL-QUR’AN
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: The question of tahrif (alteration) in the Qur'an has in fact been part of Muslim intellectual discourse for centuries. Although the issue is no longer widely debated today, some Muslims still raise it as a discourse worthy of attention. This is because the Qur'an, as the Holy Book of Muslims, serves as guidance for all time and must therefore be eternal and unchanging; any claim that it has been altered naturally provokes a critical response. This paper focuses on issues related to tahrif in the Qur'an, namely its definition, an analysis of its types, and the possibility of its occurrence. Each issue is examined critically and analytically so that the problems discussed can be explored and …

title: PEMBAHARUAN HUKUM ISLAM DAN LAPANGAN IJTIHAD
journal: MISYKAT Jurnal Ilmu-ilmu Al-Quran Hadist Syari ah dan Tarbiyah
abstract: Islamic law has been designed by God Almighty to remain relevant in every age, including an age in which human progress reaches its peak. At that stage many new problems will inevitably arise, some of whose rulings are not, or not yet, found in either the Qur'an or the Sunnah (the Prophetic hadith), or have never been discussed by earlier jurists (fuqaha'). The philosophy of Islamic law holds the principle that there must be no legal vacuum in the life of the Muslim community; it is not permissible for a new problem to arise without its ruling being known. For this reason, Islam opens the door of ijtihad as widely as possible.

title: Hukuman Mati Bagi Koruptor dalam Perspektif Al-Quran
journal: Al-Mizan : Jurnal Hukum dan Ekonomi Islam
abstract: Hukuman mati bagi koruptor disinyalir dapat memberikan efek jera dan rasa keadilan bagi masyarakat. Sebab koruptor tidak hanya menghabiskan uang negara, namun secara pelan tapi pasti, sejatinya mereka juga sedang membunuh rakyat yang tidak berdosa. Secara konstitusional, UU No.31/1999 Jo. UU No. 20 Tahun 2001 tentang Tipikor, memang telah memasukkan hukuman mati sebagai salah satu opsi bentuk hukuman bagi koruptor. Namun secara praksis, sampai hari ini, belum satu koruptor pun yang diputus hukuman mati di negeri ini. Karena itu secara spesifik, tulisan ini akan membahas pandangan Al-Qur’an tentang korupsi, isyarat ayat-ayat Al-Qur’an tentang hukuman mati bagi koruptor, dan bagaimana pelaksan…

title: The Role of Digital Innovation in Enhancing Hifz Al-Quran Achievement in Tahfiz Education: A Systematic Literature Review
journal: International Journal of Academic Research in Progressive Education and Development

title: European Christians (the Franks) in the Exegesis of the Quran and Hadiths (14th-18th centuries)
journal: Vostok. Afro-aziatskie obshchestva: istoriia i sovremennost
abstract: Tafsirs and hadith commentaries retransmitted the views of theologians who were among the leading opinion leaders in the pre-Modern and Early Modern Arab world. Therefore, these treatises represent a promising source for studying the perception of Europeans (Franks) in the Arab world during the period between the end of the Crusades and the French invasion of Egypt and Syria under Napoleon's I command. A study of tafsirs and hadith commentaries from this period revealed the following four patterns of representation of the Franks in this kind of sources: antiquation of the conflict with the Franks by placing battles with them into pre-Islamic and early Islamic times such as the First (67…

title: مفهوم التدبر في القرآن الكريم: دلالاته، وكيفية الوصول إليه / The concept of contemplation in the Holy Quran: its significances and how to reach it.
authors: أبو بكر محمد أبو بكر نور الدين
abstract: يتناول هذا البحث دراسة تحليلية في مجال تفسير القرآن الكريم، يتم من خلالها تتبع الآيات التي تناولت جانب التدبر من خلال مفهومه وأوجهه وتصاريفه، وكيفية الوصول إليه، فجاءت الدراسة في أربعة مباحث، المبحث الأول في مفهوم التدبر، ويندرج تحته ستة مطالب من حيث معناه لغة واصطلاحاً، وعرض نماذج ونصوص من تدبّر النبي  وصحابته ، وذكر شيء من أقوال العلماء في مفهوم التدبر بشكل عام، وبيان دعوة القرآن إلى التدبر، ومن ثم عرض الآيات الواردة في التدبر وإمعان النظر في معاني هذه الآيات، والوقوف على أقوال العلماء فيها والمفسرين بالخصوص، أما المبحث الثاني ففيه أربعة مطالب، متضمنة بيان أوجه التدبر التي تم رصها ودعمها بشيء من آراء المفسرين، ومن ثم عرض الآيات التي ذكر فيها لفظ التدبر أو أحد أوجهه، وأما المبحث الثالث فت…

title: Epistemological Continuity and Mediated Authority in Audiovisual Qur'anic Exegesis: A Study of Sheikh As-Sudais's Interpretation of Fasting Verses
authors: Sikha Afiah Nur Afidah, Anisatul Fikriyah Aprilianti
journal: Urwatul Wutsqo: Jurnal Studi Kependidikan dan Keislaman
abstract: The digital transformation of Qur'anic interpretation raises important questions concerning the continuity of scholarly authority in audiovisual religious communication. This study examines the epistemological construction of Sheikh Abdurrahman As-Sudais's interpretation of the fasting verses in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:183–187), focusing on interpretive sources, exegetical methods, validity, and the mediation of religious authority. Employing a qualitative approach through library research and audiovisual content analysis, the study examines lectures published on the Durus al-Masjid al-Haram YouTube channel alongside relevant classical exegetical and hadith literature. The findings reveal an int…

title: أَسْمَاءَ التَّفْضِيلِ الوَارِدَ أَسْمَاءَ التَّفْضِيلِ الوَارِدَةَ مَعَ لَفْظَةِ (الآخِرَةِ)في القرآن الكريم / Elative Nouns Associated with th Elative Nouns Associated with the Word Al-Akhirah (The Hereafter) in the Holy Quran:
abstract: يُعنى هذا البحث بدراسة الظاهرة اللغوية والبيانية المتمثلة في اقتران أسماء التفضيل بلفظة الآخرة في القرآن الكريم ، مسلطاً الضوء على جوانبها التركيبية والدلالية. وتنبع أهمية الدراسة من الحاجة المنهجية لربط علوم اللغة بعلوم التفسير، للكشف عن كيفية إسهام الموقع الإعرابي والوزن الصرفي لاسم التفضيل في توجيه المعنى وإيصاله للمتلقي بدقة. ولتحقيق هذه الغاية، اعتمد البحث على المنهج الوصفي لتتبع هذه الألفاظ في المظان المعجمية والتفسيرية، وتحليلها وفق رؤية استقرائية تستنطق أسرارها البيانية. وقد تتبعت الدراسة هذه الأسماء عبر ثلاثة محاور دلالية رئيسة، شملت: أسماء التفضيل الدالة على الخسارة والعقاب كـ(أخزى، والأخسرون، وأشد، وأشق، وأعمى)، والأسماء الدالة على الفضل العظيم كـ(أكبر، وتفضيلا)، وصولاً إلى الأسما…

title: Ar-Rahman Method in Improving Al-Quran Reading Skills
abstract: General Background: The ability to read the Al-Quran correctly is a fundamental aspect of Islamic education, especially in Islamic boarding schools that integrate classical and modern approaches. Specific Background: Conventional learning methods often fail to address students’ varied abilities, creating a need for alternative strategies that support both accuracy and fluency. Knowledge Gap: Despite the growing number of Quranic learning methods, limited studies have examined the implementation of the Ar-Rahman method within semi-modern Islamic boarding schools. Aim: This study aims to describe and analyze the implementation of the Ar-Rahman method in improving students’ ability to read the …

title: Strategy of Dakwah in Empowering the People: a Thematic Review of the Quran
journal: Busyro: Jurnal Dakwah dan Komunikasi Islam
abstract: This paper examines the strategy of da'wah in empowering the community by thematically examining the verses of the Qur'an. The background of this study is based on the social reality in Indonesia, where by the end of 2022 the poverty rate has increased to 10.25 percent or around 27.54 million people. This phenomenon shows a gap between Islamic teachings that emphasize worldly and afterlife welfare, with the real conditions of some people who still face unemployment, hunger, and increasing crime rates. This study uses a qualitative method with a library research approach, focusing on tracing the verses of the Qur'an related to the principles of empowerment. The results of the study show that …

title: Melacak Makna “Dain” dalam Al-Quran Perspektif Analisis Semantik Toshihiko Izutsu dan Penerapannya dalam Platform Belanja Online
abstract: In Islamic teachings, debt (Dain) is a permissible transaction, but it is mandatory to be careful in implementing and carrying it out so as not to fall into something that is prohibited by Islam, namely Riba. Researchers will examine and trace the concept of Dain in the Qur'an using Toshihiko Izutsu's semantic analysis. In addition, the concept of Dain in the Qur'an has it been implemented correctly in several online shopping platforms that implement loans or debts such as Shopee and Lazada. researchers use a qualitative approach and the method or type of research used by researchers is Library Research. The results show that in the Qur'an, the concept of "dayn" or debt is not just a financi…

title: King Wu’s Political-Religious Vision in Early Zhou: An Exegesis of “Bu Xian Yi Bu Bin Mie” and “Xi Qiu Fu E Bian Cong Yinwang Shou” in Shiji : Zhou Benji
abstract: This study offers a philological analysis of the core passages on King Wu’s political vision, particularly the concepts of “securing Heaven’s protection and relying on the Heavenly Chamber” (“ ding4 tian1 bao3, yi1 tian1 shi4” ). Through meticulous textual collation, philological analysis, and the integration of unearthed bronze inscriptions, this paper reconstructs the original texts and clarifies key disputed terms such as “ tian1 min2” (“Heaven’s people”) and “ bin1 mie4” (“reach a destruction”). The research reveals that King Wu’s primary concern was fundamentally religious rather than purely administrative and rational in the era of early Western Zhou: he sought to align with the anthro…

title: THE QURAN AND SUNNAH ON FAMILY: THE FOUNDATIONS OF ISLAMIC FAMILY CULTURE AND THEIR SIGNIFICANCE FOR PEDAGOGY
journal: New in Psychological and Pedagogical Research
abstract: The relevance of the study is determined by the demographic crisis in Russia, expressed in a declining birth rate, an increase in the number of divorces, and the spread of single-parent families, which requires a rethinking of the priorities of state policy in the field of education and pedagogical science. The paper presents data from domestic and international studies that document significant differences in statistical indicators of family breakdown in different countries and regions of Russia. Special attention is given to comparing regions of the Russian Federation with diverse ethnoconfessional compositions. The study revealed the principles and value foundations of Islamic family cult…

title: Evaluasi Pendidikan Perspfektif Al-Quran (Al-Mas’ul/المسؤل, Al-Ahsha/ الاحصاء , Al-‘Adad/ العدد, Al-Bala/ البلاء, Al-Fitnah/ الفتنة)
abstract: Evaluation is a component of the education system that must be carried out systematically and in a planned manner as a tool to measure success or targets to be achieved in the educational process. Success and failure in learning can be identified through evaluation. Likewise, all human activities, whether individual or group, must be evaluated with the aim of improving performance and achieving better results. The concepts of evaluation in the Quran include Al-Mas'ul, Al-Ahsha, Al-Adad, Al-Bala', Al-Fitnah. This paper aims to understand the concept of educational evaluation from the perspective of the Quran. The results of this study evaluate education contained in the Al-Quran Al-Mas'ul (re…

title: مفهوم الأمن في القرآن الكريم تصاريفه، وأهميته في الحياة / The concept of security in the Holy Quran: Its derivatives, and its importance in life
authors: أبو بكر محمد أبو بكر نور الدين
abstract: يتناول هذا البحث دراسة تحليلية في مجال تفسير القرآن الكريم، تتضمن آيات الأمن وتصاريفها في القرآن الكريم، ومن ثم تدبر هذه الآيات وتوظيف معانيها في بيان أهمية الأمن في حياة الناس، فهو أمر مهم لا محيد عنه، ويعد مطلبًا نبيلاً لاتصاله المباشر بالحياة؛ لما يوفره من استقرار نفسي، ومن ثم الوقوف على العوامل التي كفلت الأمن في المجتمع، ومن أهمها القرآن الكريم الذي جعل مفهوم الأمن شاملاً وكاملاً في حياة الإنسان، ويتم ذلك من خلال بيان مفهوم الأمن ومعناه في اللغة والاصطلاح، وأنه يمثل الحالة التي يكون عليها الإنسان من الطمأنينة والاستقرار، ثم عرض تصاريفه في القرآن الكريم، وإيراد شيء من أقوال العلماء في هذا الشأن، وبيان أوجهه التي وردت في مواطن عدة من القرآن الكريم، ومن هذه المعاني: الطمأنينة، والسكينة، وا…

title: مفهوم الفشل في ضوء القرآن الكريم أسبابه وعلاجه / Definition Failure in the Holy Quran: Its Causes and Treatment
abstract: يتناول هذا البحث مفهوم الفشل، أسبابه، وعلاجه في ضوء القرآن الكريم، حيت تم دراسة مادة (الفشل) في السياق القرآني ودراستها دراسة تحليلية تفسيرية، للتعريف بها، وبيان دلالاتها، والمراد بها في كل موضع، كما يتناول البحث التعريف بأسباب الفشل وطرق علاجه والتعافي منه في ضوء القرآن الكريم، وقد جاءت الدراسة في مقدمة وتمهيد ومبحثين، وخاتمة، واعتمدت على مناهج علمية ثلاثة : هي الاستقرائي والموضوعي والتحليلي .وقد تبين من خلال الدراسة: أن مادة (الفشل) في القرآن الكريم جاءت في أربعة مواضع في القرآن وأنها وردت في سياق التنازع والاختلاف الذي يؤدي إلى الفشل وذهاب القوة، وأن الفشل في الإسلام يعد جزءًا من التجربة الإنسانية وليس نهاية المطاف، بل هو فرصة للتعلم والتطور الروحي والأخلاقي.

title: RÛH IN THE QUR'AN: AN ANALYSIS OF AL-NAISÂBÛRÎ'S EXEGESIS
authors: Siti Salbiyah, Wardani Wardani, Hanafi Hanafi
abstract: The concept of rûh has long been a subject of profound intellectual inquiry within Islamic thought, particularly in the field of Qur'anic exegesis. Although the Qur'an acknowledges the limited knowledge granted to humankind concerning the rûh (Q.S. al-Isrâ'/17:85), various interpretations have emerged to explore its possible meanings. This study examines the concept of rûh through the interpretation of al-Naisâbûrî in his Tafsîr Gharâ'ib al-Qur'ân wa Raghâ'ib al-Furqân. Employing a qualitative descriptive-analytical approach based on library research, this study finds that al-Naisâbûrî provides a multidimensional interpretation of rûh, encompassing meanings such as the soul, divine revelatio…

title: Strategies of Quran and Hadith Subject Teachers in the Tahfidz Program
authors: Nur Astuty Laba, Kasim Yahiji, Sitti Rahmawati Talango, Moh. Sain
journal: Journal of Practice Learning and Educational Development
abstract: This study aims to describe the strategies employed by Al-Qur’an Hadis teachers in the tahfidz program at MAN 1 Kabupaten Gorontalo and to identify the obstacles encountered in its implementation. This research employed a qualitative method with a phenomenological approach. Data were collected through observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation involving the head of the madrasah, Al-Qur’an Hadis teachers, program coordinators, and tahfidz students as informants. The data were analyzed through data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. Data validity was strengthened through source triangulation, technique triangulation, and member checking. The findings sho…

title: The Meaning of Tadzkir and Ta'nits From A Linguistic Perspective Al-Quran
journal: Journal of Practice Learning and Educational Development
abstract: This study discusses the meaning of tadzkir and ta'nīts in the linguistic perspective of the Qur'an using a qualitative approach through literature study. Data were obtained from verses of the Qur'an, tafsir books, Arabic linguistic literature, and related studies. Analysis was conducted using content analysis to identify the forms of tadzkir and ta'nīts as well as their semantic and rhetorical functions. The results show that the use of tadzkir and ta'nīts in the Qur'an not only follows grammatical rules but also contains contextual meanings that reinforce the message of the verse. The mudzakkar form tends to emphasize the meaning of strength and breadth of generalization, while the mu'anna…

title: The Effectiveness of the Halaqah Method in Improving Quran Reading Skills Among Students
authors: Nurul Arifah Zahra, Rosmaimunah Siregar, Samsidar
abstract: This study aims to analyze the effectiveness of the Halaqoh method in improving Quran reading skills among students at Taluban School Mosque in Thailand. The Halaqoh method was chosen because it emphasizes an intensive approach, direct supervision, and personal interaction between educators and students in small groups. This study employs a quantitative approach using a pre-experimental, one-group pretest-posttest design. It utilizes total sampling (saturation sampling), a technique in which the entire population is included as the study sample. The assessed criteria include the accuracy of letter articulation points (makharijul huruf), the application of tajwid rules, reading fluency, and e…

title: Kajian Semantik Kata Qadha dalam Al-Quran: Relevansinya terhadap Koping Religius di Era Modern
abstract: This study examines the semantic dimensions of the Qur’anic term qadha’ by analyzing its basic meanings, derivations, and contextual functions through syntagmatic and paradigmatic approaches. Using a qualitative descriptive method, the research employs semantic analysis as its primary instrument, drawing data from classical and contemporary lexicons, tafsir works, and concordance-based occurrences of qadha’ in the Qur’an, which appear 56 times in various morphological forms. The syntagmatic analysis explores the relational meaning of qadha’ within its surrounding linguistic structures, revealing its functions in expressing divine decree, legal decisions, fulfillment, completion, and finaliza…

title: Examining the Factors for Liberation from Fear and Sorrow from the Perspactive of the Holy Quran
abstract: The value of liberation from fear and sorrow and attaining inner peace in life is undeniable. Modern humans utilize all available means to achieve this virtue and strive by any means to reach tranquility, having realized that happiness and success are not solely achieved through wealth and material gain. For centuries, humanity has wandered in search of this lost treasure, unaware of the true path to its attainment. This divine blessing becomes attainable when one frees themselves from material attachments and sets a higher goal beyond worldly pleasures. In short, one must trade the world for the hereafter and remove the love of worldly things—wealth, family, and desires—from the heart to co…

title: Hermes As The Prophet Idris: An Analysis Of Egyptian And Greek Mythological Archetypes In Classical And Contemporary Exegesis
abstract: This article examines how classical and modern Qur’anic exegetes interpret the identification of the prophet Idris with Hermes and its connections to the Egyptian deity Thoth. Drawing on qualitative library research, it analyzes seven exegetical works by al-Qurṭubī, al-Naisābūrī, al-Shawkānī, Ṣiddīq Ḥasan Khān, Muḥammad Rashīd Riḍā, Ibn ʿĀshūr, and Wahbah al-Zuḥaylī through Mircea Eliade’s concepts of archetypes and illud tempus. The findings reveal a spectrum of interpretive responses, encompassing cautious acceptance, transmission of inherited accounts, critical rejection, and theological differentiation. Al-Qurṭubī and al-Naisābūrī transmit and elaborate on the identification with varying…

title: THE INTERNALIZATION OF AKHLAQUL KARIMAH VALUES IN QURAN MEMORIZATION STUDENTS AT THE AL-RASYID ORPHANAGE TAHFIDZ AL-RASYID PONDOK ALAM BARAJO SUB-DISTRICT, JAMBI CITY
abstract: This research explores and examines efforts to instill, internalize and implement noble moral values and character for students (santri) memorizing the Quran at Pondok Tahfid Yatim Dhuafa al-Rasyid Jambi. These values are taught and implemented in their actual daily lives. This research is qualitative, conducted in a narrative, descriptive and analytical manner, presenting the strenuous efforts of ustazd ustazah in internalizing and implementing the values of akhlaqul karimah in the daily lives of students who memorize the Qur'an at the Pondok Tahfid Yatim Dhuafa al-Rasyid Jambi. The results of this study indicate that the activities carried out by the students are all directed at implementi…

title: PEMBERDAYAAN MASYARAKAT RELIGIUS BERBASIS MANAJEMEN PEMBINAAN DAN TRAINING CENTER BAKAT SENI KEAGAMAAN PADA LEMBAGA PENGEMBANGAN TILAWATIL QURAN (LPTQ) DESA LADANG PERIS
authors: Salman Hasani, Rofiazka Fahmi Huda, Muhammad Sobri, Helmun Jamil, Sahrizal Vahlepi, Warissuddin Soleh
journal: PENDALAS: Jurnal Penelitian Tindakan Kelas dan Pengabdian Masyarakat
abstract: Program pengabdian ini bertujuan untuk memberdayakan masyarakat religius melalui penguatan manajemen pembinaan bakat seni keagamaan pada Lembaga Tilawatil Qur’an (LPTQ) Desa Ladang Peris, Kabupaten Batanghari, Jambi. LPTQ sebagai lembaga pembinaan seni keislaman masih menghadapi tantangan berupa lemahnya manajemen kelembagaan, keterbatasan sarana, minimnya kompetensi pelatih, serta rendahnya keterlibatan generasi muda. Untuk menjawab persoalan tersebut, metode pelaksanaan dilakukan melalui empat tahap, yaitu persiapan, pelaksanaan, pemantauan, dan evaluasi. abstract: This article examines the Qur’anic concept of amar ma‘ruf nahi munkar using a thematic exegesis (tafsīr mawḍū‘ī) approach to explore its relationship with social transformation. abstract: Meşruiyeti önceki ümmetlere kadar uzanan Ramazan orucu, İslam’ın beş temel şartından biridir. abstract: Bu çalışmada Kehf Suresi 66-82. ayetler kötülük problemi bağlamında ele alınmıştır. abstract: Sâdî Çelebî’nin er-Risâletü’s-Sa’diyye başlıklı eseri, Fâtiha Sûresinin tefsirini ihtiva etmektedir. abstract: Arap dilinde belâgat ilminin temel kavramlarından olan hakikat ve me-caz, Kur’an’ın anlaşılması ve yorumlanmasında büyük bir öneme sahiptir. abstract: Fatiha Suresi, bir Müslüman'ın kişiliğinin oluşmasında çok önemli bir rol oynar. title: Dil Ekollerinin İhtilaf Ettiği Yerlerde Taberî’nin Tercih Metodu: Nisâ Suresi Bağlamında
abstract: Bilindiği üzere dil ekolleri Arap dilinin korunması ve gelişmesi adına önemli roller icra etmiştir. abstract: İnsan tek başına yaşayabilme kabiliyetine sahip olmayan, başka insanların varlığına ihtiyaç duyan toplumsal bir varlıktır. title: Soya Aren Drink (Susu Kombinasi Kedelai dan Kolang-Kaling) Sebagai Susu Alternatif Sumber Tinggi Kalsium Pada Anak
authors: Emelia Apriani Tampubolon, Rizky Andriani Bakara, Nila Reswari Haryana, Oktaviana Siregar, Yunisia Gea
abstract: Stunting merupakan kondisi gagal tumbuh pada anak balita. Kondisi ini disebabkan kekurangan asupan gizi, terutama pada 1.000 hari pertama kehidupan, mulai dari janin hingga 2 tahun. Gizi anak dipengaruhi sejak dalam kandungan, yaitu kualitas makanan, minuman dan gaya hidup sang ibu. Tujuan PkM ini adalah untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan ibu terkait manfaat pangan fungsional yang diolah menjadi susu kombinasi kedelai dan kolang-kaling sebagai susu alternatif sumber tinggi kalsium pada anak, susu ini juga dapat menjadi alternatif pengganti susu sapi bagi anak yang alergi pada susu sapi. title: Optimalisasi Kelas Catin dalam Pencegahan Stunting dengan Model Think Pair Share Di KUA Medan Johor
authors: Dewi Sartika Hutabarat, Edisubroto Edisubroto, Cristoboy V Bakara, Grace Lumban Gaol, Devina Devina, Fahrunisa Fahrunisa
abstract: Stunting adalah kondisi gagal tumbuh pada anak balita diakibatkan kekurangan gizi kronis, yang menyebabkan tinggi badan anak lebih rendah dibandingkan dengan usia anak. Stunting masih menjadi masalah kesehatan yang signifikan di Indonesia. Tujuan Pengabdian masyarakat untuk meningkatkan kualitas kesehatan anak bebas stunting melalui model Think Pair Share sebagai Pencegahan Stunting. Mitra Pengabdian adalah Kantor Urusan Agama Medan Johor Kota Medan. title: Implementasi Fungsi Manajemen Dakwah Dalam Pembentukan Karakter Islami Santri di Pondok Pesantren Imam Muslim Serdang Bedagai
abstract: This study aims to analyze the implementation of da’wah management functions in shaping the Islamic character of students at Pondok Pesantren Imam Muslim Serdang Bedagai. The research employed a qualitative case study approach. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, then analyzed using data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing techniques. The findings reveal that the implementation of da’wah management functions has been carried out systematically through planning, organizing, actuating, and controlling. authors: Ester Simanullang, Ribur Sinaga, Sri Muliana Putri Bakara, Lisdayanti Simanjuntak, Nurleni Azizah, Rumondang Sitorus

abstract: Âl-i abâ veya pençe-i âl-i abâ tabirleri, edebî eserlerde çokça kullanılmıştır. title: Âl-i İmrân Sûresi’nin 14. Âyetindeki “Züyyine” Kavramı Bağlamında Fâilin Allah mı Yoksa Şeytan mı Olduğuna Dair Müfessirlerin Görüşleri
abstract: This study examines the concept of "zuyyina" (adorned), which appears as an unknown verb in verse 14 of Surah Al-Imran and expresses how worldly desires are made attractive to people, within the context of the debates on the "agent" (the one who adorns/makes attractive) in the history of Quranic exegesis. abstract: Muhammad ‘Abduh is a pioneer and the founder of the Tafsîr al-Adab al-Ijtimâ’i school, a style of interpretation of the Koran that emphasizes to the beauty of language (literature) as well as to social criticism toward the improvement of society. abstract: This writing is the author’s reflection on one of social phenomena.
